tasks.name: Noxious Foe
tasks.description: Kill an Aberrant Spectre.
context: Noxious Foe is an easy combat achievement which requires the player to kill an aberrant spectre. Killing deviant spectres in the Catacombs of Kourend do not count towards this task.
This achievement requires 60 Slayer to complete. Boosts can be used.
method: Equipping a nose peg or slayer helmet is required when fighting aberrant spectres. With either of these items equipped, the challenge is as simple as killing any aberrant spectre. Aberrant spectres in the Slayer Tower can be killed regardless of whether or not you are on task, whilst the ones in the Stronghold Slayer Cave cannot be killed unless on an aberrant spectre Slayer task. With 67 Sailing, the aberrant spectres on Deepfin Point can be killed without a slayer task. Notably, this location is the only place where skillers can obtain this combat achievement.

tasks.name: Abyssal Adept
tasks.description: Kill the Abyssal Sire 20 times.
context: Abyssal Adept is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Abyssal Sire 20 times.

tasks.name: Abyssal Veteran

tasks.name: They Grow Up Too Fast
tasks.description: Kill the Abyssal Sire without letting any Scion mature.
context: They Grow Up Too Fast is a hard combat achievement requiring the player to kill the Abyssal Sire before any spawns mature into a scion.
method: This is considered one of the more difficult of the hard combat achievements.
Spawns can appear during each phase of the fight, have 15 hitpoints and mature after 12 seconds. These will appear throughout the fight.

In phase 1, spawns will appear if the Sire is within attack range (~10 spaces), though it tends to frequently launch miasma pools. This should not be an issue as players should be using shadow spells to disorient it, and will mostly remain outside of this range.

In phase 2, spawns will appear rather infrequently, but will have a much greater chance of being launched if the player is out of melee distance. As such, stay within melee distance to minimise the chances of spawns appearing. At this stage or before the end of phase 3, it may be beneficial to use Emberlight or Bandos godsword special attacks to drain the Sire's defence, to reduce the chance of attacks missing before he can be killed.

In phase 3, part 1, four spawns will appear immediately once the Sire roots itself to the ground and becomes attackable again. These spawns must be killed immediately, and can be stacked by moving a few tiles back. After these spawns are killed, the player can take a short breather, as no further spawns will appear until the next part begins.

Once the Sire reaches 140 or lower health, it will begin the second part of the phase, summoning a large cluster of spawns directly underneath it while more appear from both it and the surrounding area. These spawns will need to be ignored, as they appear rapidly until the cap of 15 is hit. The spawns are also linked to the phase's miasma pools; if the minion cap is not reached, then the Sire will continually launch miasma pools until the cap is met. Enough damage must be dealt in 12 seconds; using the tips below can also be helpful in obtaining the achievement.

Without access to chinchompas or barrage spells it is still possible to kill all 4 spawns in phase 3 via ranged or magic, with some luck. With access, try to target the central spawn of the pack. Some ways to kill the spawns are using Venator bow, Hallowfell, or Dinh's bulwarks special attack. After the 4 spawns are killed, no more will appear until after the teleport, giving an opportunity to prepare. The teleport will occur when the Sire goes down to 139 hitpoints, and the following explosion can hit the player for up to 96 damage. If using Vengeance, overheal with an anglerfish and cast Vengeance right before reducing the Sire below 139 hitpoints. If the explosion reduces you to low health beware of dying from the spawns and miasma pools. After the explosion run back to the Sire and dump specs while continuing to run 2 tiles back and forth to avoid the miasma pools. The best special attack weapons for this in order are dragon claws, Voidwaker, burning claws, crystal halberd (final attack only), and dragon dagger. It is not completely necessary to kill the spawns in phase 3-1, especially if his defence has been lowered. By entering phase 3 quickly and attacking during his animation, the spawns can appear as phase 3-2 begins and special attacks can be dumped all at once before any have a chance to mature.

tasks.name: Respiratory Runner
tasks.description: Kill the Abyssal Sire after only stunning him once.
context: Respiratory Runner is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Abyssal Sire after only stunning him once.

This task fails whenever Sire wakes up from a stun; killing the respiratory systems via safespotting or tanking the tentacles must be done before stunning Sire. Likewise, enough damage to the Sire must be dealt or a shadow spell cast to disorient it exactly once.
Leaving the nexus will fail the achievement attempt unless you don't wake up the Sire.
method: The scorching bow trivialises this achievement, as it will always kill the respiratory systems in one shot, regardless of Ranged accuracy and ammo used.

For players without a scorching bow, note that upon a successful hit, players will always hit at least 50% of their maximum hit on the systems, meaning a setup with a maximum hit close to 50 will always kill the systems in 2 shots. Additionally, the bonuses from a Slayer helm apply to the respiratory systems. With high levels in either Magic or Ranged and late-game gear (such as a bow of Faerdhinen and full crystal armour), it is possible to kill all four in a single stun, but it will require minimising the time taken to travel between systems, such as running to the next system immediately after the player receives an experience drop that confirms they killed the previous system.

A Magic or Ranged weapon that can fire at a range of 10, including those that can use the longrange attack style, can be used to safespot the respiratory systems in the south-west and north-east of each boss chamber without the tentacles being able to attack. To do this, wake up Sire but do not stun it. Safespot the first two respiratory systems, then stun Sire and quickly kill the remaining systems before Sire can wake. If three systems can be killed in the duration of one stun, then only one system need to be safespotted.

Alternatively using thralls; either Resurrect Greater Ghost or Resurrect Greater Skeleton from the Arceuus Spellbook, can slowly, but reliably take down the vents, even when the Abyssal Sire is not disoriented and without using shadow spells.

tasks.name: Don't Whip Me
tasks.description: Kill the Abyssal Sire without being hit by any external tentacles.
context: Don't Whip Me is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Abyssal Sire without being hit by any external tentacles.

This achievement is easily obtained by only attacking the vents after having successfully disoriented the Abyssal Sire with a shadow spell, preferably Shadow Barrage as it is 100% effective. Once the Abyssal Sire roots itself after having reached 200 HP, the player should only stay in the three centremost rows of squares to avoid any damage from the tentacles.

tasks.name: Demonic Rebound
tasks.description: Use the Vengeance spell to reflect the damage from the Abyssal Sire's explosion back to him.
context: Demonic Rebound is an elite combat achievement requiring the player to use Vengeance against the Abyssal Sire's explosion attack.
method: In order to cast shadow spells to disorient the Sire, the player must use Spellbook Swap to swap to the Ancient spellbook. The explosion attack can deal up to 96 damage, so it is highly recommended to have as many Hitpoints as possible and boost it with a Saradomin brew or Anglerfish. It is also recommended to kill the four spawns that appear when the Sire roots itself to avoid having them waste Vengeance.
Staying alive is not required for successfully completing the achievement, so you can also try this without a lot of health.

Another account can also cast Vengeance Other on you, and it will count toward this combat achievement, eliminating the need for a way to change spellbooks. The other account does not have to be on an Abyssal demon Slayer task to do this.

Since the fight does not stop if you teleport out, another strategy is to start the fight with the Ancient spellbook, kill the scions at the beginning of phase 3, teleport out, switch to the Lunar spellbook, come back and cast the vengeance. It is recommended that you have a Lunar Altar in your POH if doing this strategy, since taking too long to come back can make the fight reset.

tasks.name: Don't Stop Moving
tasks.description: Kill the Abyssal Sire without taking damage from any miasma pools.
context: Don't Stop Moving is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Abyssal Sire without taking damage from any miasma pools.
method: Miasma pools have a one second delay before they damage the player and have a 3x3 AoE from their initial spawn point. They will disappear after a few seconds.

During phase 3, the player should trigger the pool on a location other than the south-west safe tile prior to starting the next stage when the Sire falls below 140 health, as it will perform its explosion attack once this threshold is triggered. While the player is safe from damage for a few seconds, it also locks them in place slightly longer, which could result in damage from a pool.

tasks.name: Perfect Sire
tasks.description: Kill the Abyssal Sire without taking damage from the external tentacles, miasma pools, explosion or damage from the Abyssal Sire without praying the appropriate protection prayer.
context: Perfect Sire is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Abyssal Sire without taking damage from the external tentacles, miasma pools, explosion or damage from the Abyssal Sire without praying the appropriate protection prayer.

tasks.name: Kree'arra Adept
tasks.description: Kill Kree'arra 50 times.
context: Kree'arra Adept is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to kill Kree'arra 50 times.

tasks.name: Kree'arra Veteran
tasks.description: Kill Kree'arra 100 times.
context: Kree'arra Veteran is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill Kree'arra 100 times.

tasks.name: Collateral Damage
tasks.description: Kill Kree'arra in a private instance without ever attacking him directly.
context: Collateral Damage is a master combat achievement which requires the player to kill Kree'arra in a private instance without ever attacking him directly.
method: This can be achieved with chinchompas easily. Recoil damage through Vengeance, especially enhanced with Dharok the Wretched's equipment with amulet of the damned, ring of suffering, and barrage spells may also be used, but they are less effective overall. Beware that simply targeting Kree'arra, even while on attack cooldown, to prevent him from using his melee attack will automatically fail the task.

tasks.name: Airborne Showdown
tasks.description: Finish off Kree'arra whilst all of his bodyguards are dead.
context: Airborne Showdown is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to finish off Kree'arra whilst all of his bodyguards are dead.
method: A good method to complete this task solo, alongside the similar tasks for each of the respective God Wars Dungeon bosses, is to use a Toxic blowpipe alongside a Serpentine helm to envenom the bodyguards between kills, so that when the boss is low on health all of the minions are also low/dead, allowing them to be killed easier.

tasks.name: Swoop No More
tasks.description: Kill Kree'arra in a private instance without taking any melee damage from the boss or his bodyguards.
context: Swoop No More is a master combat achievement which requires the player to kill Kree'arra in a private instance without taking any melee damage from the boss or his bodyguards.
method: Although killing Kree'arra using Protect from Melee would complete this task, Kree'arra consistently hits high damage with ranged so this is not recommended.

Kree'arra only closes in for melee attacks if he is not presently targeted, so if distance is maintained while using Protect from Missiles, the only threat for melee damage will be Flight Kilisa. Flight Kilisa only has level 50 Magic and no magic defence, so she can be bound with magic fairly reliably.

If you're having trouble binding Flight Kilisa, it's possible to toggle Protect from Melee only while Flight Kilisa is alive and killing her by immediately stepping under Kree'arra. Once Flight Kilisa dies, quickly turn your prayers back to Protect from Missiles and Rigour and step out of Kree'arra to damage him. Repeat the previous process when Flight Kilisa respawns, 2 or 3 repetitions should be enough to complete the combat achievement. Tagging Flight Kilisa and Kree'arra using RuneLite makes this process easier by showing you their tiles and helping you quickly noticing respawns.

Alternatively, players will usually complete this task passively by the time they get to 100 kills, as long as Kree'arra is fought in a private instance each time. Simply stay out of Kree'arra's melee range and minimize Kilisa's accuracy against the player by using strong armour and a super defence or bastion potion.

tasks.name: The Worst Ranged Weapon
tasks.description: Kill Kree'arra by only dealing damage to him with a salamander.
context: The Worst Ranged Weapon is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to kill Kree'arra via damage inflicted by salamanders.
method: The tecu salamander is recommended, as it is the strongest salamander available, requiring irit tar as ammo and level 80 Attack, Ranged, and Magic to use. Players should use the salamander in melee mode, as it hits significantly harder than ranged and Kree'arra has slightly less melee defence compared to ranged.

It is also very recommended to bring a mix of strong defensive equipment with high defence bonuses in all three styles, while also trying to maximise strength and slash bonuses, as Ranged accuracy will only be around 20% with a salamander. Oathplate armour and the bellator ring should be used over other options in order to increase slash accuracy.
The inventory should consist of about 200 irit tars, multiple super combat potions, a crossbow and grapple, and as many Saradomin brews and super restores as possible.

Players should keep Protect from Missiles and Piety on at all times. It is also advised to walk under Kree'arra after every attack to minimise his overall attacks, as he has an attack speed of 3, whereas the salamanders have an attack speed of 5 when used on the scorch (melee) style.
With an aviansie slayer task, using a slayer helmet will make the achievement much easier.
Note: As the players can only use salamanders to kill Kree'arra, any other types of damage such as thralls or recoil damage will automatically fail the achievement.

tasks.name: Feather Hunter
tasks.description: Kill Kree'arra 30 times in a private instance without leaving the room.
context: Feather Hunter is a grandmaster Combat Achievement which requires the player to kill Kree'arra 30 times in a private instance without leaving the room.
method: It is recommended to use either a Tumeken's shadow or the chinchompa method. Having an aviansies slayer task will be a huge benefit. Kree is the only God Wars Dungeon boss not to drop any prayer restoration, so players will need to bring at least eight prayer potions/prayer regeneration potions. Expect the achievement to take around 65 minutes.
First, pre-pot with an anglerfish and a super defence potion.

If using a Tumeken's shadow, also bring runes for blood barrage and bones to peaches tabs; optionally take an eldritch Nightmare staff and ice barrage. Start each kill in the south-west corner of the room and freeze Flight Kilisa whenever possible (or alternatively step under Kree after each attack). If you need to heal during a kill, step under Kree. Once Kree dies, blood barrage both Kilisa and Flockleader Geerin to restore any lost health and use the eldritch staff's special attack on Skree to restore prayer. Bring bones to peaches tabs, as the resulting peaches will restore 32 health per spawn cycle.

If the player does not have a Tumeken's shadow or chinchompas, it is also possible to complete the achievement with a bow of Faerdhinen or twisted bow; however, since the player has lower damage in this setup, a Slayer task is necessary. Properly prayer flicking the bodyguards when the boss is dead to fully heal with blood barrage after every kill is important, since you take a lot of damage. Walking under the boss when your weapon is on cooldown or when eating reduces damage taken from Kree'arra. Bones to peaches tabs are also important, and the blood ancient sceptre allows you to overheal for each kill. Since the player deals less damage than with the recommended setups, the player must rely more on healing in the room and bring more Prayer restoration. 12 super restores, 4 ranging potions, and 2 prayer regeneration potions are enough to last 30 kills, if the player utilises the Armadyl altar that restores Prayer fully every ten minutes. Bring 4 or 5 Saradomin brews to allow for more healing and boost your Defence, depending on if you have an ecumenical key or killcount to access the boss.

Kree'arra's bodyguards drop the occasional batch of manta rays and mushroom potatoes, but don't fully rely on these to last the entire trip. Super defence potion drops can be useful to tank during kills.

tasks.name: General Graardor Adept
tasks.description: Kill General Graardor 50 times.
context: General Graardor Adept is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to kill General Graardor 50 times.

tasks.name: General Graardor Veteran

tasks.name: Ourg Freezer
tasks.description: Kill General Graardor whilst he is immobilized[sic].
context: Ourg Freezer is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to kill General Graardor while he is immobilised. The task will be completed if the final attack would have immobilised Graardor.
method: For the purposes of this task, bind spells from the standard spellbook or ice spells from the ancient spellbook are recommended. The Zamorak godsword could also be used for this task, although if the player is aiming for Ourg Freezer II, it is recommended to use ice spells to complete both achievements at once.

tasks.name: Ourg Freezer II
tasks.description: Kill General Graardor without him attacking any players.
context: Ourg Freezer II is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill General Graardor without him attacking any players.
method: This achievement is best combined with Ourg Freezer, as the player has to bind Graardor to kill him anyway.
Alternatively, the Ranged method using an Armadyl crossbow or Bow of Faerdhinen will complete this task if performed flawlessly. This option will not complete Ourg Freezer.

tasks.name: General Showdown
tasks.description: Finish off General Graardor whilst all of his bodyguards are dead.
context: General Showdown is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to finish off General Graardor whilst all of his bodyguards are dead.
method: A good method to complete this task solo, alongside the similar tasks for each of the respective God Wars Dungeon bosses, is to use a Toxic blowpipe alongside a Serpentine helm to envenom the bodyguards between kills, so that when the boss is low on health all of the minions are also low/dead, allowing them to be killed easier.

tasks.name: Defence Matters
tasks.description: Kill General Graardor 2 times consecutively in a private instance without taking any damage from his bodyguards.
context: Defence Matters is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to kill General Graardor two consecutive times in one trip in a private instance without taking damage from his bodyguards.
method: Prayer Flick Method

Prayer flick the bodyguards' attacks; ideally try to make Sergeant Strongstack hit on the same tick as Graardor so both attacks are blocked. Make sure that Sergeant Steelwill and Sergeant Grimspike also attack on different ticks. Graardor has an attack speed of 6 (3.6s) while the bodyguards have an attack speed of 5 (3.0s). Walking under Graardor can help resync off-ticks.

An adaptation that might be easier but requires extended focus is to keep the minions alive after killing Graardor once, then focus on flicking them correctly without killing them as Graardor respawns. By wearing powerful defensive armour such as Justiciar armour or Torva armour, and using an Osmumten's fang with a strong shield such as the elysian spirit shield or dragonfire shield, it should be possible to tank and kill Graardor twice with a decent amount of healing supplies.

Players with knowledge of the 5:0 Tumeken's shadow strategy may opt to do a modified version of it for the achievement: Kill Graardor normally, then kill Strongstack and Grimspike. First kill: As Graardor respawns, kill Steelwill, then pray Protect from Missiles and do the 5:0 method to avoid both Graardor and Strongstack. Continue to 5:0 after Graardor is dead in order to kill Strongstack. Second kill: As Graardor respawns, kill Grimspike, then pray Protect from Magic and do the 5:0 method again.
Setup (No-Flick) Method
This method is less dependent on execution but depends heavily on a DPS check. An active slayer task/helm on top of maximum dps mage gear are key to succeeding.
Ice ancient sceptre and Tumeken's shadow are highly recommended.

Kill General Graardor normally, leave alive Sergeant Steelwill (Mage) with the minimum HP possible. Wait for General Graardor to respawn while sitting in the north east corner. This is the setup before your first perfect kill. When General Graardor spawns, switch to ranged prayer and freeze him immediately. Failures to freeze make success unlikely. With your prayer now on ranged, you are relying on your max mage bonus and defence bonuses to negate a few mage attacks. When Sergeant Strongstack spawns, freeze him as well. Failures to freeze make success unlikely. Kill the low-health Sergeant Steelwill. Failures to kill him on the first hit (before he damages you) make success unlikely. With Sergeant Steelwill dead, you must race against his respawn timer to kill Graardor. Graardor and strongstack will likely need a re-freeze before he is dead Kill Seargent Strongstack. To prep for the second perfect kill, leave Sergeant Grimspike alive with minimum health and wait in the north east corner with ranged prayer active. When Graardor spawns, freeze him. When Sergeant Strongstack spawns, freeze him as well. Failures to freeze make success unlikely. Kill the low-health Sergeant Grimspike, switch to magic prayer. Kill general Graardor before Sergeant Grimspike respawns. Graardor and Strongstack will likely need a re-freeze before he is dead By setting it up this way, players frontload the hardest of the RNG checks and set up for the safest second kill. By leaving Grimspike weakened and waiting in the North-East tile, players have additional time and a chance at Steelwill (the mage) being slow to aggro entirely, due to his south wall spawn.

tasks.name: Keep Away
tasks.description: Kill General Graardor in a private instance without taking any damage from the boss or bodyguards.
context: Keep Away is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to kill General Graardor in an instance without taking any damage from him or his bodyguards.
method: This achievement requires Ranged or Magic in order to complete, since Graardor's melee attacks are accurate even with best-in-slot melee armour. Use Ice Barrage and the best magic equipment available to quickly kill Graardor, or try to flick the minions while using one of the methods that prevents Graardor from attacking (e.g., 5:0 with a Tumeken's shadow). Freezing Sergeant Strongstack is helpful but not needed, since he will usually be trailing with Graardor.

Make sure that both Sergeant Grimspike and Sergeant Steelwill are attacking on different ticks, so their attacks can be flicked against, since both are fairly accurate even with good defensive bonuses.

One method that can be used to make this achievement easier is to keep the minions alive but at low health after killing Graardor. Just as Graardor respawns, kill whatever spawns closest to the player's position, then freeze Sergeant Grimspike in a good location so the remaining long-ranged minion has to be prayed against. If the kill seems to be dragging on, the remaining minion can be killed before the other long-ranged minion respawns.

tasks.name: Ourg Killer
tasks.description: Kill General Graardor 15 times in a private instance without leaving the room.
context: Ourg Killer is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to kill General Graardor 15 times in a private instance without leaving the room.
In order to rent a private instance, the player must have the Hard Combat Achievements completed.
method: Using either the magic freezing method, ranged method or even just face-tanking with an elysian spirit shield and Justiciar armour, this task can easily be completed with very little prior experience in fighting General Graardor. If melee is being used, flicking the mage minion every other attack, might increase chances for success. Since General Graardor drops super restores relatively commonly, having a little bit of luck should be enough to complete this task without much practice.

tasks.name: Barrows Novice
tasks.description: Open the Barrows chest 10 times.
context: Barrows Novice is an easy combat achievement which requires the player to open the Barrows chest 10 times.
Completion of the quest Priest in Peril is required to complete this task, as this quest is required to enter Morytania.
method: This combat achievement can be finished quickly by running through the barrows and finding out which sarcophagus enters into the tunnel, disregarding any brother that appears. This method yields around 30-50 chest openings per hour. Note that almost no loot will be received using this method. It is the fastest way to get killcount, however. With the Strange old lockpick, players can ignore the random path and head straight into the middle room, making trips faster at the cost of a charge when passing through a locked door.

tasks.name: Barrows Champion
tasks.description: Open the Barrows chest 25 times.
context: Barrows Champion is a medium combat achievement which requires the player to open the Barrows chest 25 times.
method: This combat achievement can be finished quickly by running through the barrows and finding out which sarcophagus enters into the tunnel, disregarding any brother that appears. This method yields around 30-50 chest openings per hour. Note that almost no loot will be received using this method. It is the fastest way to get killcount, however. With the Strange old lockpick, players can ignore the random path and head straight into the middle room, making trips faster at the cost of a charge when passing through a locked door.

tasks.name: Can't Touch Me
tasks.description: Kill Dharok, Verac, Torag and Guthan without letting them attack you with melee.
context: Can't Touch Me is a medium combat achievement which requires the player to kill Dharok, Verac, Torag, and Guthan without letting them attack the player with melee. Using Protect from Melee to block damage will not count.
If you have killed 0 of the brothers and get hit by the first brother you try to kill, leaving and re-entering the crypt will NOT reset the task, so you will need to open the chest and start over.
After killing the 4 brothers without being hit, the combat achievement will not unlock until after opening the chest.
method: To complete this task, it is recommended to keep doing Barrows runs, starting with Ahrim and Karil, until one of these two is in the entrance to the tunnels. After that, the exact same strategy can be applied to all four remaining brothers. For these melee brothers, the general strategy is to search the coffin and then immediately run to the opposite side of their coffin. Due to the small delay before a brother attacks, it is even possible to run through the brother when running to the other side of the coffin. The special attack of a dragon spear can be used to stun the brothers should this prove difficult.

Turn off run energy, and cast the best freezing spell available, such as Ice spells or Entangle. Then immediately run back, in case the freeze splashes. If the freeze succeeds, cast a few damaging spells, and be sure to hide behind the coffin before it runs out. Repeat this strategy every time the freeze runs out. Then repeat the strategy for all four brothers, and open the final chest to complete the task. The combat achievement is awarded once the chest is opened after killing all four melee-based brothers without being hit.

Note that the brothers will prefer to walk east-west, meaning that it is generally easier to trap the brother on either the north or the south side of the coffin. It can also be useful to use the 'Ctrl+click' command to run when run is turned off.
If the player gets hit, the player cannot simply leave the crypt and try again, as the hit counter is only reset once the chest is looted.

Another strategy, without freezing, consists in using a trident of the swamp with a serpentine helm. Start the kill and run to the opposite side of the coffin. Get some distance, hit once, and run again to the opposite side of the coffin. Then let the venom kill each brother.

tasks.name: Pray for Success
tasks.description: Kill all six Barrows Brothers and loot the Barrows chest without taking any damage from any of the brothers.
context: Pray for Success is a medium combat achievement which requires the player to kill all six Barrows Brothers and loot the Barrows chest without taking any damage from any of the brothers.
method: As the name suggests, the task is easiest completed by using protection prayers during the fights.

Using Protect from Magic when fighting Ahrim the Blighted, Protect from missiles when fighting Karil the Tainted, and Protect from Melee when fighting Dharok the Wretched, Guthan the Infested, Torag the Corrupted and Verac the Defiled. It is however possible for Verac to hit through Protect from Melee, thus players should consider binding him with binding spells like Entangle or ice spells to minimise the chance of him landing a damaging hit. When spawning Verac, use a Dragon spear special attack to stun him or immediately run behind the coffin to avoid getting hit.

Once the player has taken damage from a brother, the chest must be found and looted before another attempt is made. This applies even to the first brother fought; leaving the room to reset the fight does not allow this task to be completed even if all six brothers are subsequently killed without damaging the player.
Players should also take the prayer-drain effect in the Barrows into consideration and bring some means of prayer restoration like Prayer potions.

tasks.name: Defence? What Defence?
tasks.description: Kill any Barrows Brother using only magical damage.
context: Defence? What Defence? is an easy combat achievement which requires the player to kill any Barrows brother using only magic damage.
Completion of the quest Priest in Peril is required to complete this task, as this quest is required to enter Morytania.
method: Dharok the Wretched and Guthan the Infested both have negative magic defence. Torag the Corrupted and Verac the Defiled are also very vulnerable to magic attacks. Killing these brothers with magic is highly advisable, so completing this task is in line with the recommended strategy for killing the Barrows Brothers.

tasks.name: Just Like That
tasks.description: Kill Karil using only damage dealt by special attacks.
context: Just Like That is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to kill Karil the Tainted using only damage dealt by special attacks.
method: Using a lightbearer is recommended. Players can also have a friend cast Energy Transfer on them to restore their special attack energy for this achievement, or wait in a safespot for their special attack energy to naturally recover. Poison damage (from a Dragon dagger p++ for example), venom damage, as well as a charged Dragonfire Shield attack may be utilised. The burn from burning claws or the Arkan blade will fail this achievement.

For lower levels, or Ironmen, the rune thrownaxe delivers moderate, reliable damage for only 10% special attack energy per throw. Players should turn off auto-retaliate and click away after each throw as the rune thrownaxe has a relatively fast attack speed and it is easy to accidentally auto-attack Karil.
Normal attacks that do not deal damage do not count against this combat achievement.

tasks.name: Faithless Crypt Run
tasks.description: Kill all six Barrows Brothers and loot the Barrows chest without ever having more than 0 prayer points.
context: Faithless Crypt Run is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to kill all six Barrows Brothers and loot the Barrows chest without ever having more than 0 Prayer points.
method: If the player enters the first coffin room with any amount of prayer points, it will not count, even if all prayer points are drained before summoning the first brother.
The melee brothers can be frozen to reduce the amount of damage taken, leaving only Karil and Ahrim able to damage the player.
Note that the player cannot hop worlds when doing this achievement, as it checks both digging to enter the crypt, and the kill itself.
If the player dies while attempting this achievement, their stat reset on respawn will result in more than 0 prayer, causing the achievement to fail.

tasks.name: Reflecting on This Encounter
tasks.description: Kill a Basilisk Knight.
context: Reflecting on This Encounter is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill a basilisk knight. Basilisk knights are only found in the Jormungand's Prison on the Island of Stone. In order to access the dungeon, the quest Fremennik Exiles must be completed.

tasks.name: Big, Black and Fiery
tasks.description: Kill a Black Dragon.
context: Big, Black and Fiery is an easy combat achievement which requires the player to kill a black dragon. While the King Black Dragon and brutal black dragons count towards this task, baby black dragons do not.
method: It is recommended to kill the King Black Dragon because it is part of another easy combat achievement, King Black Dragon Novice, to progress in two at once. Players with level 77 Slayer may also opt to kill a brutal black dragon to complete medium task Brutal, Big, Black and Firey at the same time.

tasks.name: The Demonic Punching Bag
tasks.description: Kill a Bloodveld.
context: The Demonic Punching Bag is an easy combat achievement which requires the player to kill a bloodveld or Mutated Bloodveld.
A Slayer level of 50 is required to damage bloodvelds. Boosts can be used.
method: Bloodvelds require no specific equipment to be killed, but as their attacks are magic-based melee attacks, it is advisable to bring dragonhide gear if the player's combat stats are low. The bloodvelds in the Stronghold Slayer Cave and Morytania Slayer Tower basement can only be hurt while on Slayer task, so unless the player's task is to kill bloodveld, another location has to be chosen.

tasks.name: Brutal, Big, Black and Firey
tasks.description: Kill a Brutal Black Dragon.
context: Brutal, Big, Black and Firey is a medium combat achievement which requires the player to kill a brutal black dragon. A Slayer level of 77 is required to damage a brutal black dragon.

tasks.name: Bryophyta Novice
tasks.description: Open Bryophyta's chest once.
context: Bryophyta Novice is an easy combat achievement which requires the player to kill Bryophyta and loot her chest with a mossy key once. The regular strategies can be followed to complete this task.

tasks.name: Bryophyta Champion
tasks.description: Open Bryophyta's chest 5 times.
context: Bryophyta Champion is a medium combat achievement which requires the player to kill Bryophyta and loot her chest with a mossy key 5 times.

tasks.name: Protection from Moss
tasks.description: Kill Bryophyta with the Protect from Magic prayer active.
context: Protection from Moss is an easy combat achievement which requires the player to kill Bryophyta with the Protect from Magic prayer active.
To activate the Protect from Magic prayer, a Prayer level of 37 is required. Boosts will not work.
method: The prayer doesn't have to be used throughout the fight, but it has to be active when Bryophyta finishes her death animation and the loot appears on the ground.

tasks.name: Quick Cutter
tasks.description: Kill all 3 of Bryophyta's growthlings within 3 seconds of the first one dying.
context: Quick Cutter is a medium combat achievement which requires the player to kill all 3 of Bryophyta's growthlings within 3 seconds of the first one dying.
method: To kill the growthlings, make all three of them stand directly adjacent to the player, then wield magic secateurs or an axe and attack all three in quick succession.
With sufficient food and/or prayer points, this achievement can be attempted multiple times during the same fight with Bryophyta.

tasks.name: Preparation Is Key
tasks.description: Kill Bryophyta without suffering any poison damage.
context: Preparation Is Key is an easy combat achievement which requires the player to kill Bryophyta without suffering any poison damage.
method: Bryophyta does not poison on free-to-play worlds, so killing her on a free-to-play world will automatically complete this task. This will also complete the Fighting as Intended II task.
Alternatively, if the player wishes to do this task on a members world, they can choose to bring an antipoison potion or protect from poison in another way.

tasks.name: A Slow Death
tasks.description: Kill Bryophyta with either poison or venom being the final source of damage.
context: A Slow Death is an easy combat achievement which requires the player to kill Bryophyta with either poison or venom being the final source of damage.
method: Players can wear a serpentine helm alongside a toxic blowpipe or trident of the swamp to guarantee that Bryophyta is inflicted with venom on the next successful hit, attack her until her health is low, and then wait for the venom to take effect. Alternatively, any poison weapon can be used to apply regular poison. If the player's combat stats are low, make sure to bring some extra supplies to outlast any extra attacks Bryophyta might inflict while waiting for the venom or poison to take effect.

tasks.name: Fighting as Intended II
tasks.description: Kill Bryophyta on a free to play world.
context: Fighting as Intended II is an easy combat achievement which requires the player to kill Bryophyta on a free to play world.
method: Level 37 Prayer or higher for the Protect from Magic prayer If using Melee: Level 50 Attack or higher Level 50 Strength or higher Level 50 Defence or higher If using Ranged: Level 60 Ranged or higher Level 40 Defence or higher If using Magic: Level 59 Magic for Fire Blast or 35 Magic for Fire Bolt Level 40 Defence or higher

In order to reach Bryophyta, players will need a knife or slash weapon to slash the web to get to the lair if they are reaching her via the Varrock Sewers. Members with level 51 Agility do not need this as they can access an agility shortcut by Vannaka in the Edgeville Dungeon before switching to a free-to-play world. Members may also use a Giantsoul amulet to teleport directly to the lair.

Unlike Obor's chambers (where he is confined in a small pit), players are immediately taken to Bryophyta's chambers, where she will attack them on sight - prior to entering the room, or immediately after entering, activate Protect from Magic.

During the fight, she may summon three growthlings - they are fairly weak, but they must be killed, as Bryophyta is immune to all damage while they are alive. In order to kill them, either equip an axe and attack them or use the axe item on the growthlings. Players can grab a bronze axe from the pile of logs if they didn't bring one. She can only have one batch of growthlings in the chambers at a time, but can summon more if the previous batch have been killed. If using Ranged to kill Bryophyta, it is recommended to remain at a distance in order to prevent her from attacking with melee.

tasks.name: Callisto Adept
tasks.description: Kill Callisto 10 times.
context: Callisto Adept is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to kill Callisto 10 times. Both Callisto and his singles-plus variant Artio kills count towards this task.

tasks.name: Callisto Veteran
tasks.description: Kill Callisto 20 times.
context: Callisto Veteran is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill Callisto 20 times. Both Callisto and his singles-plus variant Artio kills count towards this task.

tasks.name: Skotizo Champion
tasks.description: Kill Skotizo once.
context: Skotizo Champion is a medium combat achievement which requires the player to kill Skotizo once.

tasks.name: Skotizo Adept
tasks.description: Kill Skotizo 5 times.
context: Skotizo Adept is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to kill Skotizo 5 times.

tasks.name: Demonic Weakening
tasks.description: Kill Skotizo with no altars active.
context: Demonic Weakening is a medium combat achievement requiring the player to kill Skotizo with no altars active.
method: Altars that activate after Skotizo is killed do not fail the task. However, altars can activate immediately before the kill, failing the task. Minimise this chance by verifying they are all down while dealing the last blow.

When an altar is destroyed, there is a one minute cooldown before that altar can re-activate again. By letting all altars activate and then quickly destroying them, you can then safely finish off Skotizo with no risk of the altars reactivating.

tasks.name: Demon Evasion
tasks.description: Kill Skotizo without taking any damage.
context: Demon Evasion is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill Skotizo without taking any damage.
method: In order to not take any damage the player must pray Protect from Magic and stay out of melee distance from Skotizo, the three reanimated demon spawns, and the dark ankou. The dark ankou will only start following the player if the player gets too close. Using a ranged weapon with a high attack range will make it easier to keep distance from the enemies while running. Take Arclight or Emberlight to quickly kill the Awakened Altars. Multi-target binds such as ice burst or ice barrage can be cast when the 3 demon spawns are grouped together in order to freeze them and allow the player to briefly stop and attack Skotizo. Since this achievement requires a lot of running, several stamina potions should be taken. The self-damaging effects of ruby dragon bolts (e), ruby bolts (e), and divine potions will not cause the achievement to fail.

When the reanimated demon spawns are following you in a line, you can also bind the first one in the line which stops them all as they cannot go through each other. They can go through Skotizo, however. You will still need to deal with the reanimated demon spawns as they will still spawn after 3 minutes. Killing two of the reanimated demon spawns also prevents re-spawning them, so you only have to kite one of them.
Note: The awakened pillars no longer stop spawning after being active for 3 minutes.

tasks.name: Demonbane Weaponry
tasks.description: Kill Skotizo with a demonbane weapon equipped.
context: Demonbane Weaponry is a medium combat achievement which requires the player to kill Skotizo with a demonbane weapon equipped.
Holy water does not count as a demonbane weapon for the purpose of this achievement.

tasks.name: Up for the Challenge
tasks.description: Kill Skotizo without equipping a demonbane weapon.
context: Up for the Challenge is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill Skotizo, or Awakened Altars without equipping a demonbane weapon.
method: The most effective way to complete this achievement is to use the twisted bow, for its increased power and accuracy against monsters with high Magic bonuses, such as Skotizo. Players who do not own a twisted bow may instead opt to use regular melee attacks.

While this task prohibits equipping the Silverlight, Darklight, Arclight, Emberlight, Scorching bow or Burning Claws, it does not prohibit casting Demonbane spells, since those are not equipped weapons. Additionally, Purging staff and Holy water are not considered to be demonbane weapons for this task.

The hardest part of this challenge is keeping the number of altars down to one or zero. However, with sufficient stats and gear it can be navigated without too much difficulty, as the awakened altars have a cooldown of one minute once destroyed before they can reactivate.

Some tips: Death charge does NOT work on the awakened altars. Greater corruption can be valuable when attacking Skotizo. Having a demonbane weapon in the inventory to finish him off if you fail does not fail the challenge so can be worth it. The Dark demonbane spell has a decent hitrate on Skotizo but the Undead Grasp spell does not, so planning on using the Blue Moon special attack on a frozen Skotizo is not a great idea; special attack energy is better spent on the pillars instead. Thralls can also be helpful in killing Skotizo. Neither the pillars nor Skotizo regain health, so for the pillars, it can be helpful to drain all of their health and kill them all at once in order to give time to kill Skotizo without worrying about the pillars defending him.

Also as a reminder, there are teleports out of his lair on all four corners in case you need them, and the spawns die at the end of the fight so you don't need to worry about clearing them. Good luck!

tasks.name: Precise Positioning
tasks.description: Kill Skotizo with the final source of damage being a Chinchompa explosion.
context: Precise Positioning is a master combat achievement which requires the player to kill Skotizo with the final source of damage being a chinchompa explosion.

It is possible to complete this achievement and Demonbane Weaponry on the same kill by equipping a demonbane weapon after throwing the chinchompa that deals the finishing blow but before Skotizo takes damage from the explosion.
method: The attack must not be targeted against Skotizo directly, but must be collateral damage from a reanimated demon spawn or dark ankou that is underneath or directly adjacent to Skotizo's south-west tile. This is because Skotizo is larger than 1x1 so it will only receive collateral damage from area-of-effect attacks that hit its south-western tile.

The Scorching bow's special attack, Scorching shackles, will bind Skotizo in place for 20 ticks(12 seconds). This can aid in positioning Skotizo to easily receive collateral damage from the reanimated demon spawn or dark ankou, but be careful that the burn damage does not accidentally deal the finishing blow.

tasks.name: Cerberus Veteran
tasks.description: Kill Cerberus 75 times.
context: Cerberus Veteran is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill Cerberus 75 times.

tasks.name: Cerberus Master
tasks.description: Kill Cerberus 150 times.
context: Cerberus Master is a master combat achievement which requires the player to kill Cerberus 150 times.

tasks.name: Arooo No More
tasks.description: Kill Cerberus without any of the Summoned Souls being spawned.
context: Arooo No More is a master combat achievement which requires the player to kill Cerberus without her summoning any Summoned Souls during the battle.
method: Cerberus summons souls every 7 attacks from the start of her attack rotation, but only when below 400 health. With an attack speed of 6, or 3.6 seconds between attacks, she must be flinched and walked under in order to obtain the achievement; otherwise there won't be enough time to kill her within seven attacks.

Alternatively, the player can wait for Cerberus to attack 14 times before dropping her below 400 health, as the souls only appear when she falls below that threshold. The next occurrence of this attack, attack 21, is overridden by her triple attack, which occurs every ten attacks from the first. This means that the player has ~46.8 seconds to defeat Cerberus before the next set of souls appears with minimal walking. With maximum flinching and walking, additional time can be provided at the start of the encounter.

Cerberus has a 10% chance to use a standard attack instead of summoning souls on her 7th attack, so if the player is able to consistently complete the kill before her 14th attack, eventually, this achievement will be completed passively.
See the Dharok's armour 'red-click' strategy for an additional method of completing this combat achievement.

tasks.name: Ghost Buster
tasks.description: Kill Cerberus after successfully negating 6 or more attacks from Summoned Souls.
context: Ghost Buster is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill Cerberus after successfully negating 6 or more attacks from Summoned Souls.
This task counts attacks from each individual Summoned Soul, so negating two sets of three is sufficient to complete this achievement.

tasks.name: Unrequired Antifire
tasks.description: Kill Cerberus without taking damage from any lava pools.
context: Unrequired Antifire is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill Cerberus without taking any damage from her lava pool attacks.
method: The lava pool attack is indicated when Cerberus growls "Grrrr", launching three markers around the arena - one on the player's position at the time the mechanic was initiated, and two around it. It is recommended to use Ranged when attempting this achievement as the markers have a delay when launched at a distance, allowing the player to quickly move out of the way. This attack is initiated when Cerberus falls below 200 health and is performed on every attack that ends in 0 or 5 on her attack rotation.
Alternatively, the player can simply kill Cerberus before she has a chance to use the mechanic.

tasks.name: Anti-Bite Mechanics
tasks.description: Kill Cerberus without taking any melee damage.
context: Anti-Bite Mechanics is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill Cerberus without taking any melee damage.
method: This achievement is best done with Ranged as Cerberus does not actively move in to attack the player with melee. This leaves her triple combo attack as the only threat, as the last hit deals melee damage and does not take distance into account.

tasks.name: Chaos Elemental Adept
tasks.description: Kill the Chaos Elemental 10 times.
context: Chaos Elemental Adept is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Chaos Elemental 10 times.

tasks.name: Chaos Elemental Veteran
tasks.description: Kill the Chaos Elemental 25 times.
context: Chaos Elemental Veteran is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Chaos Elemental 25 times.

tasks.name: Hoarder
tasks.description: Kill the Chaos Elemental without it unequipping any of your items.
context: Hoarder is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Chaos Elemental without it unequipping any of their items.
Much like The Flincher, if any player has their equipment unequipped, everyone involved in the kill will fail.
method: The Chaos Elemental cannot unequip items as long as the player does not have the required inventory space for them to be unequipped. Because of this, it is recommended to bring pies, stews, or curry as food, as they will leave behind a pie dish or bowl upon being eaten. Alternatively, Saradomin brews can be brought instead, as long as the "smash vials" ability is not activated. Note that Saradomin brews drain stats so bringing super restores would be advisable.

Failure only occurs if a player has an item removed from their equipment slots from the madness projectile. If the player hit by the projectile does not have anything equipped, the combat task is still achievable. This can be used with the Solo Safe Spot Method to guarantee task completion if the luring is done without any items equipped, even if there are slots available in the inventory.

tasks.name: The Flincher
tasks.description: Kill the Chaos Elemental without taking any damage from its attacks.
context: The Flincher is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Chaos Elemental without taking any damage from its attacks.
If any player takes damage from its attacks, everyone involved in the kill will fail.
method: Given that the Chaos Elemental has a very long range and its attacks dealing either magic, ranged or melee damage with no distinction, it is quite difficult to draw its attention without getting hit. Attacking with a 10-square attack range weapon while the Chaos Elemental is not facing the player and quickly running behind a safespot is an effective way to achieve this.

Wearing a full set of Verac the Defiled's equipment with the Protect Item prayer turned on is an excellent way to complete the achievement, since the full set allows players to bypass the Chaos Elemental's defences. Praying Protect from Magic, the player should try to get the attention of the elemental, with a little luck, they should take no damage from potential ranged or melee attacks, whilst luring the Chaos Elemental towards the small trees outside the Rogues' Castle walls. When the Chaos Elemental is in place, the player should start flinching it by attacking the elemental once, then immediately step back behind the tree, then wait for the elemental's HP bar to disappear before landing the next attack. This should ensure that the Chaos Elemental has no chance to retaliate.

Alternatively, a Dwarf multicannon can be used to trigger the Chaos Elemental's aggression; in this case, it won't be necessary to step out of the cover of the tree except to make flinch attacks once the Chaos Elemental is trapped. Depending on the specific position where the Chaos Elemental is trapped, it will also be possible to place the cannon such that its firing range is aligned with the Chaos Elemental's southwest tile; this will allow you to kill it significantly faster by virtue of double cannon shots.

Few supplies should be needed for this task, a prayer potion and combat potions plus some emergency food and teleport should be brought. The rest of the inventory should be filled with cheap food that leaves items behind, like apple pies, in case the player gets hit by the Elemental's disarming attack, whilst not risking too much if attacked by a PK'er.

tasks.name: Chaos Fanatic Champion
tasks.description: Kill the Chaos Fanatic 10 times.
context: Chaos Fanatic Champion is a medium combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Chaos Fanatic 10 times.

tasks.name: Chaos Fanatic Adept
tasks.description: Kill the Chaos Fanatic 25 times.
context: Chaos Fanatic Adept is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Chaos Fanatic 25 times.

tasks.name: Sorry, What Was That?
tasks.description: Kill the Chaos Fanatic without anyone being hit by his explosion attack.
context: Sorry, What Was That? is a medium combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Chaos Fanatic without anyone being hit by his explosion attack.

tasks.name: Praying to the Gods
tasks.description: Kill the Chaos Fanatic 10 times without drinking any potion which restores prayer or leaving the Wilderness.
context: Praying to the Gods is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Chaos Fanatic 10 times, without drinking any potion which restores prayer, or leaving the Wilderness.

Warning: Entering Ferox Enclave will reset the kill count for this combat task. Even though it is technically in the Wilderness, it is not considered wilderness for the purpose of this task. In general, only places where you risk losing items count.
The altar east of Ferox can be used to recharge prayer, or the Chaos Altar for a closer and more dangerous method.
method: This task prohibits the consumption of only the following items: Prayer potion Prayer regeneration potion (Consuming this will reset the task, but you are allowed to have the regeneration effect active while getting kills) Zamorak brew Super restore Sanfew serum Ancient brew Moonlight moth mix Stat Restore Pot Share of any of the above

This means it is allowed to make use of several other prayer-restoring items, which notably includes the Falador shields, and Moonlight moths (non-mix version). Jangerberries, Bluefin, yellow spicy stew, and another player sharing a Moonlight moth mix can also be used, however these items are not recommended for practical use. Players can also use the special attack on the Saradomin godsword or ancient mace to recharge their prayer, however due to the fanatic's high melee defences this is an unreliable way to restore prayer points.

The suggested strategy for completing this task is to make use of the Wilderness Obelisk network, after having completed the hard Wilderness Diary which allows players to set a custom destination. Using these obelisks, players can teleport to the level 13 obelisk, then recharge their prayer at the altar just outside the Ferox Enclave, and then return to the level 44 obelisk to continue on the task. Note that entering the Enclave does reset progress, so the altar just east of it needs to be used.

Players may opt instead to use the Chaos altar found in the deep Wilderness Chaos Temple, which is just south-west of the Chaos Fanatic. However, due to this location being commonly patrolled by PKers and being a multicombat area, it is recommended to take more caution when using this altar.

F2P worlds don't have the problem of PKers in and around the chaos altar as using bones on altar is a member only feature. The altar functions as a simple prayer altar instead. Hopping to a f2p world is a viable option as a result. Just note, members food items will not work on f2p worlds. Also, if you're an Ironman, the first attack on the Chaos Fanatic after world hopping will not count as yours, so if it dies on that hit, the kill will not count. Logging out or hopping worlds does not reset your progress.

tasks.name: Corporeal Beast Veteran
tasks.description: Kill the Corporeal Beast 25 times.
context: Corporeal Beast Veteran is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Corporeal Beast 25 times.

tasks.name: Corporeal Beast Master
tasks.description: Kill the Corporeal Beast 50 times.
context: Corporeal Beast Master is a master combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Corporeal Beast 50 times.

tasks.name: Hot on Your Feet
tasks.description: Kill the Corporeal Beast without anyone killing the dark core or taking damage from the dark core.
context: Hot on Your Feet is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Corporeal Beast without killing or taking damage from the dark energy core.
method: This can be accomplished by moving 2 tiles whenever the dark energy core jumps towards the player. Solo players should not bring a cannon as it will end up killing the core.
If the core would have damaged the player but the damage is nulled through teleporting, the achievement is still failed, and no failure message is received.

If teleporting out of the room mid kill, it is recommended to move away from the core first or to time the teleport such that the core could not have damaged the player throughout the length of the teleport animation.

tasks.name: Finding the Weak Spot
tasks.description: Finish off the Corporeal Beast with a Halberd special attack.
context: Finding the Weak Spot is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to finish off the Corporeal Beast with a dragon halberd or crystal halberd special attack.
For this task to completed successfully, the halberd has to be using the stab attack style.

tasks.name: Chicken Killer
tasks.description: Kill the Corporeal Beast solo.
context: Chicken Killer is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Corporeal Beast alone.
method: For non-ironmen players, it is recommended to complete the achievement using an instance - while this will cost money and requires another player to hold the instance, the Corporeal Beast has a lot of health and the player might get crashed by other players, particularly griefers, while attempting the task. Ironmen players do not have to worry as much as they get their own room if they have a combat level of 90 or higher, although the room is still shared on that world with all other ironmen.

tasks.name: Crazy Archaeologist Champion
tasks.description: Kill the Crazy Archaeologist 10 times.
context: Crazy Archaeologist Champion is a medium combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Crazy Archaeologist 10 times.

tasks.name: Crazy Archaeologist Adept
tasks.description: Kill the Crazy Archaeologist 25 times.
context: Crazy Archaeologist Adept is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Crazy Archaeologist 25 times.

tasks.name: Mage of the Ruins
tasks.description: Kill the Crazy Archaeologist with only magical attacks.
context: Mage of the Ruins is a medium combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Crazy Archaeologist with only magical attacks.
Damage inflicted by a ring of recoil or by the special attack of a dragonfire shield also counts as magical for the purpose of this task.

tasks.name: I'd Rather Not Learn
tasks.description: Kill the Crazy Archaeologist without anyone being hit by his "Rain of Knowledge" attack.
context: I'd Rather Not Learn is a medium combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Crazy Archaeologist without anyone being hit by his "Rain of Knowledge" attack.

tasks.name: If Gorillas Could Fly
tasks.description: Kill a Demonic Gorilla.
context: If Gorillas Could Fly is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill a demonic gorilla.
method: This task can be completed during the Monkey Madness II quest by damaging a demonic gorilla and having Nieve finish it off. Alternatively, demonic gorillas can be found in the Crash Site Cavern after completing Monkey Madness II.

tasks.name: Hitting Them Where It Hurts
tasks.description: Finish off a Demonic Gorilla with a demonbane weapon.
context: Hitting Them Where It Hurts is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to finish off a demonic gorilla with a demonbane weapon.
method: This task can be completed very easily by using Arclight or Emberlight, and any of the demonbane spells with or without a purging staff, as both are easily accessible and ensures the gorilla can be dealt the last blow with a demonbane weapon regardless of what it prays against. If using Ranged instead of Magic, it is possible that the last blow on the gorilla has to be done with a ranged weapon, in which case the scorching bow may be used instead. If the player does not have either the bow or demonbane spells, killing just a few will likely result in being able to kill one with melee as the last attack style.

tasks.name: Deranged Archaeologist Novice
tasks.description: Kill the Deranged Archaeologist 10 times.
context: Deranged Archaeologist Novice is an easy combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Deranged Archaeologist 10 times.

tasks.name: Deranged Archaeologist Champion
tasks.description: Kill the Deranged Archaeologist 25 times.
context: Deranged Archaeologist Champion is a medium combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Deranged Archaeologist 25 times.

tasks.name: Mage of the Swamp
tasks.description: Kill the Deranged Archaeologist with only magical attacks.
context: Mage of the Swamp is a medium combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Deranged Archaeologist with only magical attacks.
Damage inflicted by a ring of recoil or by the special attack of a dragonfire shield also counts as magical for the purpose of this task.

tasks.name: I'd Rather Be Illiterate
tasks.description: Kill the Deranged Archaeologist without anyone being hit by his "Learn to Read" attack.
context: I'd Rather Be Illiterate is a medium combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Deranged Archaeologist without anyone being hit by his "Learn to Read" attack.
method: The easiest way to get this achievement is simply to choose two points in the boss area to run between special attacks. Whenever he shouts "Learn to Read!", run to the opposite point in the area. While it is possible to get unlucky and be hit by one of the smaller books, there's a good chance that the attack will be avoided entirely by giving a wide enough berth.

tasks.name: The Walking Volcano
tasks.description: Kill a Fire Giant.
context: The Walking Volcano is an easy combat achievement which requires the player to kill a fire giant.
method: Fire giants are very easy to kill for low-level players with fairly decent food and equipment. Players with a Prayer level of at least 43 can utilise Protect from Melee to negate all damage given from them.

Fire giants have a significant elemental weakness to water spells. Players may also opt to safespot them with magic. There are many areas with fire giants that include convenient safespots, such as the Brimhaven Dungeon, Stronghold Slayer Cave, and Waterfall Dungeon.

If all easy combat achievements are planned to be completed, it is efficient to kill a fire giant, moss giant, and a hill giant in the Giants' Den within the Shayzien region to complete this achievement and Into the Den of Giants at the same time.

tasks.name: Galvek Speed-Trialist
tasks.description: Kill Galvek in less than 3 minutes.
context: Galvek Speed-Trialist is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill Galvek in less than 3 minutes. The fight can be attempted at the Pool of Dreams to the east on the Myths' Guild's .
The player must deal 1200 damage to Galvek in 300 ticks, or 49 possible Dragon hunter crossbow (Rapid) attacks averaging 24.48 damage per attack.
method: The recommended strategy is to use a dragon crossbow (or better) with ruby dragon bolts (e), and a strong special attack weapon, such as a zaryte crossbow, voidwaker, or burning claws. As Galvek's defence resets between phases, defence reduction is generally less effective here. For players with weaker range equipment, using a strong melee weapon such as Osmumten's fang or a Dragon hunter lance for Galvek's final phase might be more effective.

For highest odds of successful completion, start the Galvek fight and instantly start clicking on where his character will spawn during the dark transition screen. If the ruby bolts do not activate their special effect on the first attack, teleport back to the Myths' Guild with the mythical cape and restart. When the ruby bolt special is activated on the first attack, prepare for an attempt at the goal time. Use any special attacks immediately, and continue to range Galvek.

Food such as Guthix rests or Saradomin brews will avoid losing ticks As Saradomin brew and Galvek both drain combat stats, Menaphite remedy is strongly recommended to passively restore stats. A Surge potion for an extra special attack

For Ultimate Ironmen attempting this Combat Achievement, the fight against Galvek via Pool of Dreams in Myths' Guild is considered safe so excess items can be stored in death bank safely during this encounter.

tasks.name: Grotesque Guardians Adept
tasks.description: Kill the Grotesque Guardians 25 times.
context: Grotesque Guardians Adept is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Grotesque Guardians 25 times.

tasks.name: Grotesque Guardians Veteran
tasks.description: Kill the Grotesque Guardians 50 times.
context: Grotesque Guardians Veteran is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Grotesque Guardians 50 times.

tasks.name: Don't Look at the Eclipse
tasks.description: Kill the Grotesque Guardians without taking damage from Dusk's blinding attack.
context: Don't Look at the Eclipse is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Grotesque Guardians without taking damage from Dusk's blinding attack.

context: Perfect Grotesque Guardians is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Grotesque Guardians whilst completing the Don't Look at the Eclipse, Prison Break, Granite Footwork, Heal No More, Static Awareness, and Done before Dusk tasks.

This means the player must kill the Grotesque Guardians without doing the following: Taking damage from Dusk's blinding attack. Taking damage from Dusk's prison attack. Taking damage from Dawn's rockfall attack. Letting Dawn receive any healing from her orbs. Being hit by any lightning attacks. Letting Dusk use his prison attack for a second time.

tasks.name: Perfect Grotesque Guardians II
tasks.description: Kill the Grotesque Guardians 5 times in a row without leaving the instance, whilst completing the Perfect Grotesque Guardians task every time.
context: Perfect Grotesque Guardians II is a master combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Grotesque Guardians five times in a row without leaving the area, whilst satisfying the conditions for Perfect Grotesque Guardians.

This means the player must avoid the following: Taking damage from Dusk's blinding attack. Taking damage from Dusk's prison attack. Taking damage from Dawn's rockfall attack. Letting Dawn receive any healing from her orbs. Being hit by any lightning attacks. Letting Dusk use his prison attack for a second time. Leaving the instance.
method: The hardest part of this achievement is avoiding the lightning attacks that come after reducing Dusk's health below half. To avoid the attacks, it is recommended to stay still on a tile and have run turned on, so that one can escape to two tiles away in a single tick if needed. If the player is using special attacks such as that of the crystal halberd or dragon claws, it is recommended to use these on the final phase of the fight, as not killing Dusk in time will allow him to use a second prison attack. Being trampled by Dusk does not fail the achievement.

tasks.name: Grotesque Guardians Speed-Trialist
tasks.description: Kill the Grotesque Guardians in less than 2 minutes.
context: Grotesque Guardians Speed-Trialist is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Grotesque Guardians in 2:00 or less. Despite the official description, a time of exactly 2:00.00 will count for the achievement.
method: For strategies on this achievement, see Grotesque Guardians Speed-Runner.

tasks.name: Grotesque Guardians Speed-Chaser
tasks.description: Kill the Grotesque Guardians in less than 1:40 minutes.
context: Grotesque Guardians Speed-Chaser is a master combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Grotesque Guardians in under 1 minute and 40 seconds.
method: For strategies on this achievement, see Grotesque Guardians Speed-Runner.

tasks.name: Grotesque Guardians Speed-Runner
tasks.description: Kill the Grotesque Guardians in less than 1:20 minutes.
context: Grotesque Guardians Speed-Runner is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Grotesque Guardians in less than 1 minute and 20 seconds.
method: Players have two options for this achievement; pure melee, or a melee/ranged hybrid.

As hybrid, players are recommended to bring both the toxic blowpipe with dragon darts and a venator bow with dragon arrows. At the start of the fight, the player can get 4-6 hits with a blowpipe before needing to swap to the venator bow. Make sure that Dusk is next to Dawn while hitting the latter so that the bow will bounce twice on her.
For Dusk, a scythe of Vitur is highly recommended due to Dusk's near non-existent Defence, allowing it to hit very hard and frequently.

During phase 3, the player can get 3-4 hits with a blowpipe before needing to switch to the venator bow. As soon as Dawn reaches 10 or less health, immediately smash her with the rock hammer to save a tick.

During phase 4, the player can save a tick by immediately manually smashing Dusk when his health becomes critical. The player should dump as many special attacks as possible during this time. Allowing for the smashing to occur automatically will cause an extra tick or two to pass before the player actually finishes off Dusk, which can be delayed even longer with gear swaps. The boss kill time is recorded as soon as Dusk dies, not when the drops appear, although the achievement is not marked as complete until they do.

As pure melee, a noxious halberd is mandatory as Dawn can only be hurt with melee weapons classified as polearms. The polearm can hit even harder than ranged options, and with good luck can easily cause phase transitions in a few hits. A crystal halberd special attack can be used as a finisher before phase transitions since the 7-tick speed isn't a detriment due to the bosses being immune to damage, but burning claws are recommended to be dumped solely on Dusk because failing to deal sufficient damage or missing will result in more ticks wasted from the crystal halberd's 7-tick speed. Despite Dusk's immunity to burn damage, his lack of Defence means that every special is likely to hit. If accuracy is still a problem, players can bring oathplate armour over other armour.

tasks.name: From Dusk...
tasks.description: Kill the Grotesque Guardians 10 times without leaving the instance.
context: From Dusk... is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Grotesque Guardians 10 times without leaving the instance.
method: This task can be completed with relative ease by bringing 12-14 super restores, a Saradomin godsword, and Guthan the Infested's equipment to serve as food. While not necessary, an amulet of blood fury can also restore some health while using melee. Flick Piety and Rigour to conserve prayer points.

The Guardians do not deal a lot of damage through prayer, and any unprotected hits can usually be healed back with the Saradomin godsword or Guthan's equipment. They can also drop mushroom potatoes and prayer potions to help prolong trips. Having a lightbearer will double the usage of godsword specials to restore stats.

Without healing equipment you need to minimize damage by avoiding mechanics and off-ticking the Guardians so you can pray against both as described in strategies. Supply drops are helpful but unreliable; you should use Saradomin brews for healing, so bring an extra Super combat potion and Ranging potion to refresh your divine potion boosts, as well as excess Super restores for prayer restoration and in case the bosses drop brews.

tasks.name: ... 'til Dawn
tasks.description: Kill the Grotesque Guardians 20 times without leaving the instance.
context: ... 'til Dawn is a master combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Grotesque Guardians 20 times in a single trip.
method: Use the following inventory for this task:

Players can swap dragon claws for a saradomin godsword, and the ultor ring for a lightbearer, although these are not necessary unless the player's prayer level is on the lower end. Flick Piety on every attack and turn protection prayers off during various interludes (such as Dusk's charge attack, lightning phase, final phase transition, etc.) to conserve as much prayer points as possible.

Guthan's sustains better than a saradomin godsword in terms of healing, especially if a lightbearer is not being used. The boss also drops mushroom potatoes and one or two 4-dose prayer potions at a time, but don't be too reliant on these for the achievement.
Twenty kills, with an average of 1:30, should take around 30-40 minutes, although kills can fluctuate depending on overall dps and how many times Dawn is allowed to heal on the third phase.

context: Perfect Corrupted Hunllef is a master combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Corrupted Hunllef without taking damage from: Tornadoes, Damaging Floor or Stomp Attacks Also, do not take damage off prayer and do not attack the Corrupted Hunllef with the wrong weapon, within The Corrupted Gauntlet.
