context: Defence Doesn't Matter II is a master combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Corrupted Hunllef without making any armour within The Corrupted Gauntlet.

Focus on increasing your dps by crafting a perfected bow and perfected staff, using Rigour and Augury, attacking while moving, and entering the fight with full health and prayer. You can maximize inventory space for food by decanting into 4-dose potions.

tasks.name: Egniol Diet II
tasks.description: Kill the Corrupted Hunllef without making an egniol potion within the Corrupted Gauntlet.
context: Egniol Diet II is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Corrupted Hunllef without making an egniol potion within The Corrupted Gauntlet.
method: This achievement can be easily completed by not leaving offensive prayers constantly on during the fight. Either flick them or do not use them.

It is not necessary to flick defensive prayers. However, it is required to pray flick the demi-bosses to avoid taking massive and unnecessary damage. Avoid spending run energy unnecessarily during the preparation phase and fight. If you have time remaining before entering the central chamber, wait out this time to replenish any missing run energy. If possible, walk during the first few tornado attacks, as it will be more valuable to have run energy during the later stages of the fight.

As tier 3 armour has the highest prayer bonus, this can be easily done at the same time as Corrupted Warrior, although some care must be taken to conserve stamina for players with lower agility levels.

tasks.name: Corrupted Warrior
tasks.description: Kill the Corrupted Hunllef with a full set of perfected corrupted armour equipped.
context: Corrupted Warrior is a master combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Corrupted Hunllef with a full set of perfected corrupted armour equipped.
method: The following materials are required for a full set of perfected armour: 13 linum tirinum 13 phren bark 13 corrupted ores 650 corrupted shards

An extra 100 shards are needed for two attuned/perfected weapons, 40 shards for two egniol potions, and 40-80 shards for one or two extra teleport crystals. This makes for a total of 830-870 shards needed.

In order to maximise efficiency during the preparation phase, the player can use the following tactics: Avoid moving through previously explored rooms. Do not make two perfected weapons. Do not collect more than 8 fish. With a full set of perfected armour, very little food is needed for the fight. Attack creatures while moving or collecting resources.

tasks.name: Wolf Puncher II
tasks.description: Kill the Corrupted Hunllef without making more than one attuned weapon.
context: Wolf Puncher II is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Corrupted Hunllef without making more than one attuned weapon, within The Corrupted Gauntlet.
method: Despite the achievement's name, the player is not required to attack the Corrupted Hunllef unarmed. However, if the player is unable to acquire three weapon frames in time, they can make a bow, a staff and punch the Hunllef for the melee hit.
The simplest strategy is to make one perfected and one basic weapon and switch weapons every 6 hits; bring more paddlefish than usual since the fight will take longer.

The achievement can be completed using the 5-1 strategy so that the Corrupted Hunllef never prays against the one perfected weapon the player makes: During the preparation phase, collect three weapon frames and one component for a perfected weapon. Make one perfected weapon (preferably one the Corrupted Hunllef did not spawn praying against) and two basic weapons. Otherwise, prepare normally. During the fight, strike the Hunllef five times with the perfected weapon and once with the basic weapon it is not praying against. Repeat this process until the end of the fight. Example: The Hunllef spawns praying Protect from Magic; the player makes a perfected halberd, a basic bow and a basic staff. When the fight starts, the player hits the Hunllef five times with the halberd, then once with the bow, making it switch to Protect from Missiles. The player hits the Hunllef five times with the halberd, then once with the staff, making it switch to Protect from Magic. Repeat the previous steps. If at any point the Hunllef accidentally switches to Protect from Melee, attack it six times with either of the basic weapons.

method: This combat achievement may be more easily done when attempted alongside the Crystalline Warrior task, due to the Prayer bonus from the tier 3 perfected crystal equipment making prayer flicks less important to perfect while taking less damage.

On the other hand, the resources for tier 3 armour take a long time to gather and may even exhaust your run energy, which cannot be restored with an egniol potion if attempting this task. For players confident in their prayer flicking, it is recommended to use tier 1 armour for this achievement.
For reference, a player with 70 Prayer and tier 1 armour can keep an overhead protection prayer active for 4 minutes and 12 seconds.

In order to maximise efficiency during the preparation phase, the player can use the following tactics:

Avoid moving through previously explored rooms. Do not make two perfected weapons. Do not collect more than 8 fish. With a full set of perfected armour, very little food is needed for the fight. Attack creatures while moving or collecting resources.

tasks.name: Glough Speed-Trialist
tasks.description: Kill Glough in less than 2 minutes and 30 seconds.
context: Glough Speed-Trialist is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill Glough in less than 2 minutes and 30 seconds. The fight can be attempted at the burning brazier in Zooknock's house.
method: Before starting the fight, cast vengeance and spellbook swap to the Arceuus spellbook. When the fight starts, summon a thrall and cast vengeance again. If you are using defence lowering special attack weapons, dump your special attacks at the start of the fight, if not, reserve some special attack energy for the third phase. It is not too difficult to quickly chip through the first two phases with regular attacks, vengeance spells and a thrall. You can disable your prayer after casting vengeance to maximize the recoil damage. Between phases you can heal up as you have to run to the next room. In the last phase, use all your special attack energy and cast vengeance when possible. If you are struggling with melee, consider using a bow of Faerdhinen with crystal armour, or if available, a twisted bow.

Dying in the instance will place the player with all items intact back in Zooknock's house. Special attack energy does not regenerate if you die, so consider bringing a lightbearer ring to recharge special attack energy between attempts more quickly.

Inventory Special weapon of choice 1 Divine super combat potion, Super combat potion or Super set 3-4 Prayer potions One-click teleport (optional) Food (Sharks / Manta rays / Anglerfish / Karambwan) Runes for Spellbook Swap, Vengeance, and Resurrect Greater Ghost

Killing the skeletal hellhound during In Search of the Myreque does not count for this achievement.
Killing Bouncer during the Fight Arena does not count for this achievement.

tasks.name: Hespori Adept
tasks.description: Kill Hespori 5 times.
context: Hespori Adept is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Hespori 5 times.

tasks.name: Hesporisn't
tasks.description: Finish off Hespori with a special attack.
context: Hesporisn't is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to finish off the Hespori with a special attack.

For special attacks that hit multiple times, the last hit needs to be the one that kills Hespori for achievement to be completed. This includes the Arkan blade's special attack, as it immediately hits with a burn along side the regular hit. Additionally, the special attacks of Ancient Warriors' equipment weapons such as Morrigan's throwing axe do not work for the achievement.

Enchanted bolt special effects can trigger this achievement if the bolt effect activates on the last hit, such as Diamond bolts (e). Emerald bolts (e) have the highest chance of activation, making them also effective for this.

tasks.name: Weed Whacker
tasks.description: Kill all of Hesporis flowers within 5 seconds.
context: Weed Whacker is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to kill all of the Hespori's flowers within 5 seconds.
method: Players should use throwing knives to complete the achievement, as they have a fast attack speed. Darts can also be used, but have slightly less range. Flowers have a 100% chance of being hit and dying, so the type of knives or darts being used do not matter. Make sure to have the knives/darts set to rapid. When the fight is beginning, spam-click the first flower. As soon as the experience drop appears, move on to the next flower.
Players with access to Blisterwood stakes set to rapid can hit all the flowers without needing to move.

Alternatively, a combination of a 4-tick powered staff with a built-in magic spell (e.g., Trident of the Swamp) and fast melee weapon can be used. Stand next to one flower and attack the other three flowers using the staff in quick succession, then switch to melee for the fourth flower.

If the flowers are not killed in time, exit the room using the entrance or an emergency teleport, and then return. This will allow for another attempt, instead of killing Hespori and having to grow another one.

tasks.name: Plant-Based Diet
tasks.description: Kill Hespori without losing any prayer points.
context: Plant-Based Diet is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Hespori without losing any prayer points.
method: Players with decent combat stats should be able to kill the Hespori without using Prayer at all. Extra food may be helpful to make up for this.
Prayer drain from Thralls does NOT count, meaning they can be used to aid in the fight.

tasks.name: Hespori Speed-Trialist
tasks.description: Kill the Hespori in less than 48 seconds.
context: Hespori Speed-Trialist is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Hespori in exactly 48 seconds or less.
method: For strategies on this achievement, see Hespori Speed-Chaser.

tasks.name: Hespori Speed-Chaser
tasks.description: Kill the Hespori in less than 36 seconds.
context: Hespori Speed-Chaser is a master combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Hespori in under 36 seconds.
method: Waiting for a new Hespori seed to grow with every attempt is not required; if the attempt begins poorly, simply leave the cave, via the exit or teleporting, to redo the fight from the beginning. Using a crystal halberd special attack when Hespori is just over 200 health can bring Hespori under 100 health, skipping an entire plant phase. Killing Hespori's flowers can be sped up following the strategy section of Weed Whacker achievement. You must wait 1 tick before attacking boss after the last flower's xp drop, else the attack will be nulled and do no damage. With the rite of vile transference unlocked, you can use the upgraded Death Charge on the second set of flowers, along with a dose of surge potion at 81 Herblore, for a total of 155 special attack energy. This allows, for example, a total of three burning claw special attacks and one crystal halberd special attack all in one kill. Kill Flowers. Summon a mage thrall and burning claw spec twice. If Hespori phases, drink surge potion and kill flowers; if not, reset. Burning claw spec twice, attack with a strong weapon once if not phased yet. If Hespori phases, cast death charge; if not, reset. Crystal halberd spec. If it does not kill, reset. Depending on how many ticks you lose throughout a kill, you may need to rely on only special attacks and forgo the regular attack in phase 2. Swapping the surge pot with double death charge and using the strong weapon attack in phase 1 can reduce surge pot consumption and increase odds of getting to phase 3 Note that tying the time (getting a kill of exactly 36:00) seconds will complete the task.

tasks.name: Obor Novice
tasks.description: Open Obor's chest once.
context: Obor Novice is an easy combat achievement requiring the player to kill Obor once and then loot his chest.

tasks.name: Obor Champion

context: Obor Champion is a medium combat achievement which requires the player to kill Obor and open his chest 5 times.

tasks.name: Sleeping Giant
tasks.description: Kill Obor whilst he is immobilized.
context: Sleeping Giant is an easy combat achievement which requires the player to kill Obor whilst he is immobilized. This achievement can be completed without opening Obor's chest at the end, allowing players to repeatedly attempt the achievement without needing to spend another giant key to fight Obor.
method: To complete this task freeze Obor such as by using Bind, Snare, or Entangle before dealing the last hit of damage. Having a high Magic level will make this task increasingly easy, as spells such as Ice Burst, Ice Blitz and Ice Barrage will immobilize Obor for several seconds, allowing the final hit to be dealt more easily.
The Zamorak godsword's special attack cannot be used to complete this task.

tasks.name: Back to the Wall
tasks.description: Kill Obor without being pushed back more than one square by his knockback attack.
context: Back to the Wall is a medium combat achievement which requires the player to kill Obor without being pushed back more than one square by his knockback attack. This achievement can be completed without opening Obor's chest at the end, allowing players to repeatedly attempt the achievement without needing to spend another giant key to fight Obor.
method: If using melee, the player should immediately run to the corner of the room, so Obor cannot push them back any further. If using magic, freeze Obor in place using snare or similar to prevent him from using his knockback attack.

tasks.name: Squashing the Giant
tasks.description: Kill Obor without taking any damage off prayer.
context: Squashing the Giant is a medium combat achievement which requires the player to kill Obor without taking any damage off prayer. This achievement can be completed without opening Obor's chest at the end, allowing players to repeatedly attempt the achievement without needing to spend another giant key to fight Obor.
method: Using Magic and either Snare or freezing spells is recommended for this achievement. Use the Protect from Missiles Prayer and avoid melee damage at all costs. The achievement will still complete if the player takes damage from the falling rocks while praying Protect from Missiles. Remember to enable Prayers before climbing down to fight Obor. Enabling Prayers during the climb-down may cause the achievement to fail. Make sure to enter the room when Obor is far away from the rocks used to enter the lair, to decrease the chance of Obor hitting before he is caught with a Snare or freezing spell. With a high Magic level, Ice Barrage is recommended.

Players with high melee stats may also choose to try and tank the damage by praying range and equipping good crush armour while trying to end the fight quickly with a high damage spec weapon such as the dragon dagger or dragon claws. While this method is less skill intensive, it does require an amount of luck to pull off and may take several tries.

tasks.name: Fighting as Intended
tasks.description: Kill Obor on a free to play world.
context: Fighting as Intended is an easy combat achievement which requires the player to kill Obor on a free to play world. This task does not require you to use a Giant Key to loot the chest.
method: Bring runes for Earth Blast, and optionally, Snare.
Note that stat boosts from members-only items, such as a super strength potion, will be cancelled by logging into a free to play world.

tasks.name: Alchemical Veteran
tasks.description: Kill the Alchemical Hydra 75 times.
context: Alchemical Veteran is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Alchemical Hydra 75 times.

tasks.name: Alchemical Master
tasks.description: Kill the Alchemical Hydra 150 times.
context: Alchemical Master is a master combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Alchemical Hydra 150 times.
method: The minimum amount of Hydras that Konar can assign is 125, so a Bracelet of slaughter is helpful to complete this achievement in a single task.

tasks.name: Unrequired Antipoisons
tasks.description: Kill the Alchemical Hydra without being hit by the acid pool attack.
context: Unrequired Antipoisons is a master combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Alchemical Hydra without being hit by its acid pool attack.
method: Hydra will spit poison blobs in its poison phase and its enrage phase. After the 3rd attack in each phase, the player should prepare to dodge the poison by standing far away or on a location that will not send random poison blobs. After another 9 attacks, be prepared to dodge another poison attack.

tasks.name: Lightning Lure
tasks.description: Kill the Alchemical Hydra without being hit by the lightning attack.
context: Lightning Lure is a master combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Alchemical Hydra without being hit by its lightning attack.
method: This achievement can be completed by running to avoid the lighting when it spawns, skipping the lightning phase altogether, (similar to The Flame Skipper), or by performing a Lightning skip.

tasks.name: Don't Flame Me
tasks.description: Kill the Alchemical Hydra without being hit by the flame wall attack.
context: Don't Flame Me is a master combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Alchemical Hydra without being hit by its flame wall attack.
method: The flame wall attack can be easily dodged by walking away from the flame as it spawns. Otherwise, performing any variation of a 'flame dodge' or The Flame Skipper will be enough to complete the achievement.

tasks.name: Mixing Correctly
tasks.description: Kill the Alchemical Hydra without empowering it.
context: Mixing Correctly is a master combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Alchemical Hydra without empowering it.
method: If the Alchemical Hydra gets sprayed by chemicals from an incorrect vent (relative to its phase), it will become empowered, increasing the damage of its attacks. To complete this challenge, while the Alchemical Hydra is in Green phase (1st phase) it must never be touched by the green or blue vents, the Blue phase (2nd phase) must never be touched by the red or blue vents, and the Red phase (3rd phase) must never be touched by the green or red vents. The Grey phase (4th phase) must never be touched by any of the three vents.

tasks.name: The Flame Skipper
tasks.description: Kill the Alchemical Hydra without letting it spawn a flame wall attack.
context: The Flame Skipper is a master Combat Achievement which requires the player to kill the Alchemical Hydra without letting it spawn a flame wall attack.
This achievement will only count as completed if the Hydra does not reach the middle and stop moving before changing phases.
method: Most players with a twisted bow, dragon hunter lance, or dragon hunter crossbow (with some lucky enchanted bolt effects) will usually complete this achievement at some point during the 150 kill combat task grind, due to high hitting abilities of these weapons. There are a few methods to maximise damage during this phase:

Vengeance can add up to an additional 52 damage. Cast Vengeance during the Hydra's green or blue phase, so the cooldown timer can expire and be recast immediately after it procs during red phase. Lure Hydra onto the blue vent while it is still in blue phase so that it will have its defence reduced as soon as possible after changing to red phase. Without access to the above listed weapons, a toxic blowpipe with dragon darts is recommended. Use a crystal halberd special or other high hitting weapon for a final hit just before it reaches the centre of the room. Optionally, use Spellbook Swap to summon a thrall, which can contribute additional damage, though its impact is negligible. A Bandos godsword and a Lightbearer can be used to reduce the Hydra's defence to 0 and then regenerate special attack energy before starting the red phase.

tasks.name: Alcleanical Hydra
tasks.description: Kill the Alchemical Hydra without taking any damage.
context: Alcleanical Hydra is a master combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Alchemical Hydra without taking any damage.
method: All damage from the boss is avoidable; the only issue is the first attack it uses upon entering the boss room, which cannot be predicted. If it attacks with the opposite style that is prayed against, leave the room and try again.

tasks.name: No Pressure
tasks.description: Kill the Alchemical Hydra using only Dharok's Greataxe as a weapon whilst having no more than 10 Hitpoints throughout the entire fight.
context: No Pressure is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Alchemical Hydra using only Dharok's greataxe as a weapon whilst having no more than 10 Hitpoints throughout the entire fight.
method: Enter the Alchemical Hydra's chamber praying Protect from Magic, as Dharok's armour has higher ranged defence than magic.

If it attacks with ranged: Teleport out immediately and try again (requires very quick reactions). Tick eat the attack with a low-healing food such as purple sweets or cooked meat, which are also useful if you lose track of which attack is coming next. You still have a chance to block the damage with your melee armour stats.

For the rest of the fight, which is the same as a normal melee fight, see Alchemical Hydra/Strategies. Due to the low damage per second afforded by Dharok's equipment, it is likely that the player will face multiple special attacks per phase. This occurs after the ninth regular attack following the first special attack. Make sure to start moving in advance of the second poison blob attacks during the first and fourth phases.
To always avoid the shotgun poison blot after the 3rd/9th attack, run under and through the hydra.

For the lightning attack, start in the north-east corner when the attack goes out, and run west along the northern wall. If the lightning lingers upon reaching the western wall, run south along it. If there is a second round of lightning, do the opposite movement by starting in the north-west corner, run east to the north-eastern corner and if the lightning lingers, run south along the wall.

Thralls can be used to complete this task, meaning it is possible to avoid using the set entirely, though it will be significantly slower if relying only on thralls. However, inflicting recoil damage with a ring of recoil, ring of suffering, or Vengeance is not allowed.

tasks.name: Alchemical Speed-Chaser
tasks.description: Kill the Alchemical Hydra in less than 1 minute 45 seconds.
context: Alchemical Speed-Chaser is a master combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Alchemical Hydra in under 1 minute and 45 seconds.
method: For strategies on this achievement, see Alchemical Speed-Runner.

tasks.name: Alchemical Speed-Runner
tasks.description: Kill the Alchemical Hydra in less than 1 minute 20 seconds.
context: Alchemical Speed-Runner is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Alchemical Hydra in under 1 minute and 20 seconds.
The achievement requires 1100 damage to be dealt in 133 ticks, requiring an average damage of 33 for 4-tick weapons such as Bow of Faerdhinen, and 41.35 for 5-tick weapons such as Twisted bow.
method: The hydra's massive health pool and high Magic level make the Twisted bow the optimal weapon to complete the task, and Dragon claws are helpful in bursting down a phase. With good gear and enough luck, it is possible to complete with dragon hunter lance or even a toxic blowpipe.

Lure the hydra to each respective chemical pool as soon as possible, blue and red phases should start with hydra already standing on the respective pools to be de-buffed. The blue phase should be ended as fast as possible, as getting hit by one of the lightning strikes will bind and damage the player for ~25. Clearing the fire phase early avoids unnecessary damage to the player and lost time from the knockback. Avoid attack delays by using Guthix rests throughout the fight. 80 seconds allows for 4 optimal Vengeance hits, and requires high health at the start of enrage phase:

Vengeance before entering, there's a 50% chance the first attack will be prayed correctly. If prayed correctly, hold until green phase acid pool removes damage reduction. Vengeance after first vengeance is consumed, pray correctly to hold and use in blue phase. Vengeance after second vengeance is consumed in blue phase, pray correctly to hold until enrage phase. Vengeance after third vengeance is consumed in enrage phase, player will take a second large hit and will need to avoid further damage or risk death.

tasks.name: Working Overtime
tasks.description: Kill the Alchemical Hydra 15 times without leaving the room.
context: Working Overtime is a master combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Alchemical Hydra 15 times without leaving the room.
method: The boss itself is not particularly damaging, only enduring - the only time the player would need to eat is at the start of the kill or if an attack/mechanic is improperly dealt with. While not necessary, a twisted bow is helpful in securing faster kills, which means less prayer restoration used per kill. A Toxic blowpipe can be used to regain small amounts of health periodically. The boss also drops sharks and super restores, but don't rely on these too often.
If you're having trouble, consider taking Armadyl brews as these boost the player's Ranged level (unlike Saradomin brews, which drain it) and give 44 health per inventory slot at 99 Hitpoints.

tasks.name: Fight Caves Veteran
tasks.description: Complete the Fight Caves once.
context: Fight Caves Veteran is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to complete the Fight Caves once.

tasks.name: Fight Caves Master
tasks.description: Complete the Fight Caves 5 times.
context: Fight Caves Master is a master combat achievement which requires the player to complete the Fight Caves 5 times.

tasks.name: A Near Miss!
tasks.description: Complete the Fight Caves after surviving a hit from TzTok-Jad without praying.
context: A Near Miss! is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to complete the Fight Caves after surviving a hit from TzTok-Jad without praying.
method: The task requires TzTok-Jad to deal at least 1 damage to the player to be completed. As its max hit is 97, players are highly recommended to use consumables to boost above their base Hitpoints, such as anglerfish and Saradomin brews. At minimum, players looking to complete this achievement should have level 84 Hitpoints whilst drinking a Saradomin brew, which boosts the player's health to 98.

tasks.name: Denying the Healers
tasks.description: Complete the Fight caves without letting any of the Yt-MejKot heal.
context: Denying the Healers is a master combat achievement which requires the player to complete the TzHaar Fight Cave without letting any of the Yt-MejKot heal themselves or any other monster.
method: Yt-MejKot can only heal if they are within melee distance of the player, so players are recommended to use safespots or position them behind other monsters so they cannot reach the player while killing them.

tasks.name: Denying the Healers II
tasks.description: Complete the Fight Caves without TzTok-Jad being healed by a Yt-HurKot.
context: Denying the Healers II is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to complete the Tzhaar Fight Caves without TzTok-Jad being healed by a Yt-HurKot.
Switching worlds during any wave will render this achievement impossible to complete.
method: In general, this achievement is made easier by luring Jad towards the entrance in the north-east corner of the arena. The healers are spawned in areas away from the cave's entrance, so luring Jad here can give more time to either deal with Jad, or to tag the healers. The most common approach is to use a long-range weapon to attack the healers before they reach Jad. Possible 4-tick weapons with a 10-tile attack range are the Bow of Faerdhinen, crystal bow, or Magic comp bow, set to rapid. Another, riskier but faster approach is to reduce Jad to just above 150 hitpoints, the point at which healers will spawn, then cast Vengeance and use two dragon claws special attacks in quick succession while allowing Jad to hit the player, which is likely to quickly finish it off before any Yt-HurKots have the chance to heal.

Do not attempt this combat achievement on Rotation 5 (the "speedrun" rotation) without dragging Jad away from his spawn, as a healer spawns directly adjacent to its spawn. It is advisable to attempt this on Rotation 7, 8 or 11 as Jad spawns in the middle of the cave.

Another approach is to get Jad stuck right next to the rock west of the entrance. This can be done by first luring Jad to the entrance (using the blue tile marker), and when Jad reaches the red tile marker, running to the cyan tile marker in north-western area of the arena. Stay still as far north as possible, and wait for Jad to touch the northern wall. Then in a single run, run towards the grey tile marker on the corner of the rock. This will cause you to stand in melee distance of Jad's south-western tile. This south-western tile is the tile the healers will try to walk to when healing Jad, but your presence there will body block the healers. This way, the healers will be unable to heal Jad, without you needing to tag them and/or deal with their damage.

Note that this strategy requires players to be comfortable with flicking Jad's melee attacks as well as its other two attack styles. Jad's melee attacks are executed without delay, so Protect from Melee should always be up between attacks. Furthermore, Jad attacks at a 4-tick interval when using melee, which may require faster reactions on the prayer switches. However, when correctly switching prayers, this strategy allows players to focus completely on their prayer and prayer potions, without needing to focus on their health.

tasks.name: You Didn't Say Anything About a Bat
tasks.description: Complete the Fight Caves without being attacked by a Tz-Kih.
context: You Didn't Say Anything About a Bat is a master combat achievement which requires the player to complete the TzHaar Fight Caves without being attacked by a Tz-Kih.
method: Tz-Kihs will appear in 32 out of the 63 waves of the Fight Caves. Tz-Kihs are melee enemies and have near nonexistent stats, so the player should take them out with reasonable ranged weapon, such as a toxic blowpipe or Craw's bow. The latter is recommended in the event that the blowpipe misses or fails to hit, so the player can maintain distance from the Tz-Kih until it is dead.
Logging out or hopping worlds between waves may cause the achievement not to be awarded.

tasks.name: Facing Jad Head-on
tasks.description: Complete the Fight Caves with only melee.
context: Facing Jad Head-on is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to complete the Fight Caves with only melee weapons equipped. Players are allowed to log out and back into the same world and still be eligible for the combat achievement, but hopping worlds is not allowed.
method: Equipping a Ranged weapon, Magic weapon, or salamander will cause the task to fail regardless of whether or not they attack anything with it. This includes weapons that primarily have melee bonuses, but can also autocast spells, like the Lunar staff and blisterwood flail. However, manually casting spells with a melee weapon equipped will not fail the task. This means that casting Vengeance, casting blood spells, or summoning thralls with resurrection spells will not fail the task, as long as a melee weapon is equipped.

Using a halberd (preferably a noxious halberd) can make the challenge easier as it allows players to attack from two tiles away instead of one, preventing rangers and magers from attacking with melee.

tasks.name: No Time for a Drink
tasks.description: Complete the Fight Caves without losing any prayer points.
context: No Time for a Drink is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to complete the Fight Caves without losing any prayer points.
method: It is a common myth that 1-tick prayer flicking is required for this task. Lazy flicking the magers and Jad is enough to clear this task, with some room for mistakes.

Players must avoid all Tz-Kihs; getting hit by one will fail the task whether or not it drains a prayer point, automatically disqualifying the player from the achievement. The player will need to safespot as many monsters as possible, especially the Ket-Zeks as these can deal massive damage if their attacks are not protected against. Prayer flicking is still allowed to complete the task. High prayer bonus gear offers a buffer before a prayer point drain, if prayer is left on beyond the first tick.
Thralls can be summoned without failing the task.
The player can be resurrected via the Karamja Elite Diary reward and still be eligible for the task.

The Falador shield 4 resets the player's internal prayer drain counter, which will clear mistakes from leaving prayer on beyond the first tick. The shield cannot be used with full prayer points, but this restriction can be circumvented with thrall spells. Lower tier Falador shields do not work.

The task won't complete if the player hops worlds during the attempt. However, you can log out and back into the same world without failing the task. As logging back in the Fight Caves puts the player in the centre of the cave and gives them a few seconds to move before the wave starts, this can be used to safespot Ket-Zeks at the beginning of most waves without penalty.

To pray against the mages, set a 15-tile radius marker on the Ket-Zek (NPC ID 3125+3126), and position yourself outside the range for when they spawn on the next wave. Let it walk towards you, and enable Protect from Magic the tick you enter the radius. Continue to prayer flick matching the 4-tick attack cycle.
To prayer flick against Jad, enable the prayer on the 3rd tick of the attack animation, and disable on the 4th tick. Setting an 8-tick timer can help visualize the timing.

tasks.name: Fight Caves Speed-Chaser
tasks.description: Complete the Fight Caves in less than 30 minutes.
context: Fight Caves Speed-Chaser is a master combat achievement which requires the player to complete the Fight Caves in less than 30 minutes.
method: For strategies on this achievement, see Fight Caves Speed-Runner.

tasks.name: Fight Caves Speed-Runner
tasks.description: Complete the Fight Caves in less than 26 minutes and 30 seconds.
context: Fight Caves Speed-Runner is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to complete the Fight Caves in less than 26 minutes and 30 seconds.
method: It is highly advised to use rotation 5 if going for this achievement due to it having the best spawns (e.g. wave 62 has both magers spawn close together), although any rotation may be used if learned well enough.

While doing the run itself is relatively simple, there are many minor time saves that should be used throughout: Drink a dose of stamina potion, divine super combat potion, and divine ranging potion before entering. The boost from an imbued heart or saturated heart may also be used for slightly longer thralls during the initial waves, although this is optional. Roughly memorising the spawns of each wave as well as where to stand at the beginning of each wave will help greatly in dealing with every wave properly. The Fight Caves Spawn Predictor plugin on RuneLite's Plugin Hub is especially helpful, as it has an option to display the next wave's spawns. Stand in between the spawn point of the high-HP NPCs and the rest of the NPCs (while still being close enough to attack). When the wave starts, begin attacking and dragging the high-HP NPC towards the weaker NPCs. Killing the large blobs early in the wave allows you to attack something else while waiting for them to split into the two bloblets. While attacking a mob, it's possible to dance other mobs inbetween attacks in order to chin them after the mob you are attacking dies. Always end the wave by killing bats/bloblets, as their death animation is 2 ticks faster than that of the other NPCs, along with the fact that they can be clumped and killed all at the same time with chinchompas. Safespotting the meleer by using other mobs saves time in not having to run to actual safespots along the edges. Use as many claw special attacks on meleers prior to wave 31. After wave 31, blowpipe special attacks should be used when needed to heal chip damage taken. You may also claw special attack the one blob on wave 2 and both blobs on wave 6. They are not needed for the ranger on wave 7, as the blowpipe will kill it quickly regardless. Death charge is procced on all mobs, and should be constantly used throughout the cave, ideally before speccing (also to shorten cooldown, as that timer starts on cast and not proc), in order to restore spec when the mob dies. If using spec as soon as bar is up, spamming death charge on cooldown is sufficient. Mobs die 2 ticks slower if they are moving compared to if they are stationary. While this seems small, ending every wave by killing moving NPCs results in roughly a minute and 14 seconds of time loss. This should generally not be a problem when setting up clumps of bats/bloblets to kill with chinchompas, although this should be kept in mind for waves that lack either of those mobs. Mobs die 1 tick faster if they are hit by multiple hitsplats when dying. Thralls will help in occasionally achieving this. Multiple hitsplat weapons such as the Scythe of Vitur and Dual macuahuitl will result in this happening, although the latter has a faster attack speed and will suffice for bats or blobs. Notable special attacks with this feature are dragon claws and burning claws. Use as many supplies as you can each attempt - Prayer will not be an issue with this setup. As the inventory will be filled with super restores, keep Rigour activated throughout the entire run. Additionally, resummon thralls whenever they are not attacking anything (eg. if they are too far away from any mobs to attack).
Note: These potions should be used before entering, then the inventory refilled in the bank. This gives the benefits of the potions without using extra inventory space.

Ancient mace to go past full prayer points Prayer regeneration potion for prayer regeneration buff Stamina potion for run energy conservation buff Divine combat potion and Divine ranging potion for free potion doses, though these may not be necessary providing you get a good time Anglerfish to go past max hitpoints, or Saradomin brew (Anglerfish overheals more) Restore potion to restore stats lost by Forgotten brew and Saradomin brew (Optional) A Vengeance cast prior to switching to the Arceuus spellbook; or Vengeance other received from a friend. This is likely not necessary, however, as it will probably only make the difference of a few seconds (Optional) Summer pie to increase agility level, allowing for better run maintenance. This effect is small, or even negligible if stamina potions are used.

Webweaver bow/Craw's bow for attacking bats and blobs outside of the blowpipe's range These bows have a range of 9 tiles and an attack speed of 3 ticks on Rapid, which is 4 tiles more than the blowpipe on Rapid (or 2 more if the blowpipe is set to Longrange) while also being 1 tick faster than the bow of Faerdhinen on Rapid. Toxic blowpipe with amethyst or dragon darts for bats, blobs, rangers, and meleers Twisted bow/bow of Faerdhinen for magers and Jad Black chinchompas and a Ranged offhand for clumped bloblets/bats at the end of a wave, as well as for attacking bats stuck near the south-western tile of any bigger NPC Dragon claws or burning claws and a melee switch for their special attack on Jad and meleers prior to wave 31 A book of the Dead with runes for casting Resurrect Greater Ghost and Death Charge Divine ranging potions and a divine super combat potion (for claw special attacks) Two stamina potions (or a single Extended stamina potion) A Saradomin brew and/or a Guthix rest for healing in case of emergency Fill the rest of the inventory with super restores or Sanfew serums It's recommended you use a Surge potion to speed up special attack restoration. Only one is needed as each dose has a 5 minute cooldown. Ferocious gloves swap to supplement the claw special attack, if using Zaryte vambraces (With Barrows gloves, use an Amulet of rancour or Amulet of torture instead)

tasks.name: Kalphite Queen Adept
tasks.description: Kill the Kalphite Queen 25 times.
context: Kalphite Queen Adept is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Kalphite Queen 25 times.

tasks.name: Kalphite Queen Veteran
tasks.description: Kill the Kalphite Queen 50 times.
context: Kalphite Queen Veteran is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Kalphite Queen 50 times.

tasks.name: Chitin Penetrator
tasks.description: Kill the Kalphite Queen while her defence was last lowered by you.
context: Chitin Penetrator is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Kalphite Queen while her defence was last lowered by the player.
method: This task can most reliably be completed by using a special attack from the bone dagger or crossbow, which are guaranteed to hit if used as the first attack on the Kalphite Queen. However, the following special attacks all drain defence upon a successful hit and can be used: Darklight Arclight Emberlight Bandos godsword Dragon warhammer Elder maul Barrelchest anchor Accursed sceptre Tonalztics of Ralos
Additionally, successful attacks with the following also drain defence: Claws of guthix Any shadow spell with the Shadow ancient sceptre Curse or Vulnerability

If attacked by the Kalphite Queen, the following items both have a chance to drain defence levels, if Kalphite Queen still has more than half of her health, assuming they are charged: Black mask Any weapon while a Broodoo shield (poison) is equipped, and only if damaged by the Kalphite Queen

tasks.name: Insect Deflection
tasks.description: Kill the Kalphite Queen by using the Vengeance spell as the finishing blow.
context: Insect Deflection is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Kalphite Queen by using the Vengeance spell as the finishing blow.
Another account can cast Vengeance Other on the player and it will count toward this combat achievement.

tasks.name: Prayer Smasher
tasks.description: Kill the Kalphite Queen using only the Verac's Flail as a weapon.
context: Prayer Smasher is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Kalphite Queen using only Verac's flail as a weapon. Inflicting recoil damage with a ring of recoil, ring of suffering, echo boots, or Vengeance is not allowed. This has to be done solo; damage from another player will invalidate the kill even if they are also using a flail. However, damage from thralls and poison inflicted via the serpentine helm are allowed, and the kill can be completed over several trips.
method: The entire Verac's set is not needed to complete the task, only the flail, though the set effect makes it stronger than some mid and lower level setups even while on task. If not using the full set, strength bonus and crush attack bonus should be prioritised. Kalphite tasks can be assigned by any Slayer master other than Krystilia and Mortimer for the Slayer helmet or black mask bonus. Alternatively, the serpentine helm can be used for its poison chance, allowing you to wait out the poison and avoid taking hits from the Kalphite Queen.

It is also possible to complete this achievement without the use of a Verac's flail at all if A Kingdom Divided has been completed. The task will complete if the Kalphite Queen is killed using only magic thralls. However, after 12 game ticks, the thrall will lose focus on your target so you need to be hitting the Kalphite Queen every 12 game ticks. The best way to do this is with a melee setup with -64 Crush Accuracy, which guarantees that every melee attack will miss. This is easily achieved with a cursed goblin hammer as it has -100 crush accuracy. By combining this with a flinching setup described on the strategies page one can take almost no damage completing this. Let the thrall do four attacks before stepping out to do a non-damaging flinch, step back under and repeat until dead. Splashing with a range or mage setup will also work. If not flinching then stepping under the Kalphite Queen between attacks will help to reduce the total damage taken while attempting the kill.
For accounts with one Defence, bringing an alt account with the Heal Other spell and the flail to kill the first form can make it a singular trip.

tasks.name: King Black Dragon Novice
tasks.description: Kill the King Black Dragon 10 times.
context: King Black Dragon Novice is an easy combat achievement which requires the player to kill the King Black Dragon 10 times.

tasks.name: King Black Dragon Champion
tasks.description: Kill the King Black Dragon 25 times.
context: King Black Dragon Champion is a medium combat achievement which requires the player to kill the King Black Dragon 25 times.

tasks.name: Claw Clipper
tasks.description: Kill the King Black Dragon with the Protect from Melee prayer activated.
context: Claw Clipper is a medium combat achievement which requires the player to kill the King Black Dragon with the Protect from Melee prayer activated. This combat achievement will only be completed if Protect from Melee is the only activated prayer and it must remain activated until the player gets credit for the kill. Turn off all other prayers before finishing the kill.

tasks.name: Hide Penetration
tasks.description: Kill the King Black Dragon with a stab weapon.
context: Hide Penetration is a medium combat achievement requiring the player to kill the King Black Dragon with a weapon using the stab attack style.
method: The weapon only needs to be equipped for the final hit. The weapon must be set to the stab attack style.

tasks.name: Antifire Protection
tasks.description: Kill the King Black Dragon with an antifire potion active and an antidragon[sic] shield equipped.
context: Antifire Protection is a medium combat achievement which requires the player to kill the King Black Dragon with an antifire potion active and an anti-dragon shield equipped.
The dragonfire shield, dragonfire ward, or ancient wyvern shield can be used as alternatives for completing the achievement.

tasks.name: Who Is the King Now?
tasks.description: Kill The King Black Dragon 10 times in a private instance without leaving the instance.
context: Who Is the King Now? is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to kill the King Black Dragon 10 times in a private instance without leaving.
method: The following adjustments may be desired:

Thralls will provide damage that bypasses the King Black Dragon's exceptional defence, allowing for relatively faster kills and less time tanking breath attacks. It is recommended to only bring exactly as many runes as needed (10-15 casts worth) to minimise risk on death in the Wilderness. This consumes inventory slots that could otherwise be used for food. Due to constant damage, a ring of suffering may provide better damage per second than any other ring that can be chosen, for similar reasons as thralls, along with providing significant prayer bonus. However, it will require consideration if it is risked. Praying Rapid heal will generate additional health, though not much, likely equivalent to one unit of food over the entire trip. A regen bracelet can assist further, but depending on what items are protected, it may not be worth the loss of damage. If a friend or an alt can scout the route to the lair, it may reduce risk within the Wilderness, allowing more powerful gear that goes beyond four risked items. This under no circumstances guarantees total safety, especially if forced to make multiple trips to try again after a failure. If an attempt fails, always hop to a different world to make tracking more difficult. Bringing a near full inventory of brews/restores will trivialise this task, in exchange for more expensive supplies. This task can be done while on a Black Dragons slayer task.
Bringing a blood fury instead of an amulet of torture will almost guarantee success. If the blood fury is one of the three/four protected items, it will not lose its charges upon death, even in PvP.

Onyx bolts (e) or onyx dragon bolts (e) will match the level of sustain offered by the blood fury for melee. This will become extremely expensive, though less than the upfront investment into a blood fury. This option poses a monetary risk on the pass-through of the wilderness.

tasks.name: Kraken Adept
tasks.description: Kill the Kraken 20 times.
context: Kraken Adept is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Kraken 20 times.

tasks.name: Unnecessary Optimisation
tasks.description: Kill the Kraken after killing all four tentacles.
context: Unnecessary Optimisation is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Kraken after killing all four tentacles.
The Enormous Tentacles can be killed before waking the Kraken.

tasks.name: Krakan't Hurt Me
tasks.description: Kill the Kraken 25 times in a private instance without leaving the room.
context: Krakan't Hurt Me is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Kraken 25 times in a private instance without leaving or logging out.
method: Players should bring a full inventory of high healing food and the best magic defence equipment available. A trident of the seas or swamp should be enough to complete the achievement on its own, but additional blood spells can help recover hitpoints in a pinch.

tasks.name: Ten-tacles
tasks.description: Kill the Kraken 50 times in a private instance without leaving the room.
context: Ten-tacles is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Kraken 50 times in a private instance without leaving or logging out.
method: The combat achievement is only possible on a cave kraken or Kraken boss Slayer assignment of at least 50 kills. Players should bring a full inventory of high healing food and their best magic defence equipment. A trident of the seas or swamp should be enough to complete the achievement on its own, but additional blood spells can help recover hitpoints in a pinch. It is possible to use blood spells on the whirlpool to heal in between kills without being attacked, and can be utilised as many times as desired between kills.

Note: While the Kraken can drop cooked sharks when killed, the drop rate for them may not be enough to sustain the given kill count. The achievement is possible with good food and enough shark drops from it, but blood spells provide much more reliable healing.
It will take roughly one hour to complete the achievement with decent gear and by casting blood spells on the whirlpool.

tasks.name: One Hundred Tentacles
tasks.description: Kill the Kraken 100 times in a private instance without leaving the room.
context: One Hundred Tentacles is a master combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Kraken a hundred times in a single trip in a private instance without leaving or logging out.
method: Due to the fact that the Kraken can only be fought on task, the combat achievement requires getting a task from either Nieve, Steve, Duradel, or Kuradal for a guaranteed task of at least 100 kills. Konar quo Maten can also give the required amount as her maximum amount. Using the Krack on Slayer task extension will additionally allow both Konar and Chaeldar to be guaranteed to assign the required amount. Bracelets of slaughter can also be used to increase the effective amount of shorter tasks.

It is recommended to bring runes for blood spells as a means of healing as the Kraken's supply drops are not reliable enough to obtain the achievement. Blood spells can be cast on the Kraken while it is submerged without waking it for infinite healing between kills. A Sanguinesti staff will help during kills, or another weapon that can auto-cast ancient magic is beneficial such as the Ancient staff to avoid the need to manually cast repeatedly. If using blood spells, it could be beneficial to bring an Explorer's ring to cast high/low alchemy.

While the Kraken's shark drops may not be enough to sustain the kill count, they may still be kept for later in case players take large amounts of damage (albeit very unlikely) while still fighting. To avoid potential death, players need to have at least 30 hitpoints for taking a max hit from the Kraken on top of damage from each tentacle.
If using a trident of the seas, approximately 1400 charges are used. You can bring extra fire runes to recharge your trident during the trip, as Kraken drops Coins, Chaos and Death runes.

Note - the instance closes when you log out, so all the kills need to be done in the one login session. Due to this, it is also important to be wary of the 6 hour logout timer if you have been playing for a long time already, as the task itself can be fairly long. (The timer can be reset by logging out and logging back in before entering the cave).
It can take roughly two hours to complete the achievement assuming decent gear and blood spells are being used between kills.

tasks.name: Master of Broad Weaponry
tasks.description: Kill a Kurask.
context: Master of Broad Weaponry is a medium combat achievement which requires the player to kill a kurask.
Killing a kurask requires level 70 Slayer. Players must also have leaf-bladed weaponry to kill it. This includes broad ammunition and the Magic Dart spell (requiring a Slayer's staff).
Note: The kurask in the southern cave of the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon can only be harmed while on a kurask Slayer task.

tasks.name: A Scaley Encounter
tasks.description: Kill a Lizardman Shaman.
context: A Scaley Encounter is an easy combat achievement which requires the player to kill a Lizardman Shaman.

tasks.name: Shayzien Protector
tasks.description: Kill a Lizardman Shaman in Molch which has not dealt damage to anyone (excluding its Spawns).
context: Shayzien Protector is an easy combat achievement which requires the player to kill a lizardman shaman in Molch which has not dealt damage to anyone, excluding the damage that its spawns deal.
method: Full Shayzien armour (tier 5) is required to prevent damage from the special attack. One option is to pray Protect from Missiles and use a range attack, such as the Toxic blowpipe, to keep distance from the lizardman shaman.

tasks.name: Mimic Veteran
tasks.description: Kill the Mimic once.
context: Mimic Veteran is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Mimic once.

In order to be eligible to obtain a Mimic, players must first speak to the strange casket upstairs in Watson's house in Hosidius to enable the chance of a reward casket turning into the Mimic. An elite reward casket has a 1/35 chance of being a mimic, while master reward caskets have a 1/15 chance. There is a one-time guaranteed Mimic encounter on either the 10th master or 25th elite casket, whichever is first.

tasks.name: Giant Mole Novice
tasks.description: Kill the Giant Mole 10 times.
context: Giant Mole Novice is an easy combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Giant Mole 10 times.

tasks.name: Giant Mole Champion
tasks.description: Kill the Giant mole 25 times.
context: Giant Mole Champion is a medium combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Giant mole 25 times.

tasks.name: Why Are You Running?
tasks.description: Kill the Giant Mole without her burrowing more than 2 times.
context: Why Are You Running? is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Giant Mole without her burrowing more than two times.
method: After reaching half health (100 HP), each attack the Giant Mole takes may prompt her to dig away to another location in her lair. Circumvent this by using Dharok the Wretched's equipment while staying at low health.

Additionally, by using a superpoisoned weapon, the poison will deal enough damage to kill the mole without her burrowing, provided the final attack reduces her health below 100. Regular weapon poison is a poor choice for this technique, as it only does 50 damage in total before expiring, and considering that even successful melee hits only have a 25% chance of poisoning, it will be unlikely that the player can poison the mole again before she burrows several times.

For Ironmen, who typically do not have access to weapon poison(++) due to the high Herblore level requirement, a great alternative is completing the Tai Bwo Wannai Trio quest and speaking to Tamayu, who will reward the player with a rune spear(kp). This karambwan-poison-coated weapon has the same poison strength as weapon poison(++).

tasks.name: Hard Hitter
tasks.description: Kill the Giant Mole with 4 or fewer instances of damage.
context: Hard Hitter is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Giant Mole within four hits that deal damage.
method: Misses (0 hitsplat) do not count towards the 4 or less hits. The giant mole has 200 Hitpoints, so each hit must deal an average of 50 damage to complete the task. The easiest method is to use Dharok the Wretched's equipment with 1 Hitpoints, a higher Hitpoints level will increase damage, and the highest melee strength items possible — an amulet of rancour, amulet of torture, or amulet of strength, Avernic treads (max) (dragon boots are acceptable), a fire cape/infernal cape or equivalents and barrows/ferocious gloves to hit as hard as possible. The Soulreaper axe will also provide similar possible outcome.
Use the aggressive hack-slash combat option on the Dharok's greataxe against the mole's slightly lower slash Defence compared to crush Defence.

Without access to Dharok's, another option is to use a high hitting special attack weapon with a single hitsplat (Armadyl godsword, Bandos godsword, dragon warhammer, Voidwaker etc.) and teleporting to a player-owned house to recharge special attack energy so that the only 4 hits on the boss are special attacks. If the first 2 hits are not high enough, either kill the boss normally or hop worlds to reset the task. Note that hitting 0 damage on the boss does not count as a hit for the purposes of this task, so if one of the attacks missed, the task can still be completed by going to a house for special attack energy and then speccing again.

Another option is to use a poison weapon since poison splat damage does not count towards the 4 hits. For this method, serpentine helm with toxic blowpipe, trident of the swamp, or toxic staff of the dead works best to guarantee a poison hit. For this method, disable auto retaliate, attack the Giant Mole so there is at least a hit higher than 0, wait until the poison hit goes down to 1, and attack the mole again. Dragon dagger (p++), abyssal dagger (p++), or any other poisoned weapon also work; however, there is no guarantee that the Giant Mole will be poisoned on the first hit. Emerald bolts (e) are especially useful for this task, as they have a 55% chance to poison (compared to 25% for melee poisoned weapons and 12.5% chance for ranged poisoned weapons). Speccing the Giant Mole twice with Bandos godsword or dragon warhammer first, then following up with 2 hits with poison weapon (after waiting for the poison damage to go down to 1) could speed up this process as well. Note: if you have failure notifications turned on, you will get a message on the fourth hit that you have failed the task. If the Giant Mole dies from poison damage after this, you will still complete the task.

Alternatively a player can use the Arkan Blade special attack. This weapon regularly hits over 50 damage per special attack, teleporting out of the mole's lair to restore special attack energy does not fail this achievement.
Damage from a Thrall counts towards the 4 hits and therefore they shouldn't be used.

tasks.name: Whack-a-Mole
tasks.description: Kill the Giant Mole within 10 seconds of her resurfacing.
context: Whack-a-Mole is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Giant Mole within 10 seconds of her resurfacing.
method: The easiest way to complete this achievement is to use a multi-hit weapon that deals damage on separate ticks, as the first hit can cause the mole to dig, applying the second hit immediately when the mole resurfaces. The best option is the Twinflame staff; the mole never digs on splashed magic attacks, so this guarantees a resurface hit on every dig. Some multi-hit special attacks, such as the crystal or dragon halberd, dragon claws, or dragon dagger (p++) also work. Note that a dark bow will not work, as the mole's digging will null the second hit splat. The viability of other multi-hit weapons not listed here has not yet been confirmed.

Another viable option is to use venom or poison. One could time it to use a fast-hitting weapon such as knives right before the venom ticks in an attempt to force the mole to dig. Alternatively, players going for the 25 kill count combat achievement may simply wish to wait and hope to kill the mole after it resurfaces close to them.

tasks.name: Avoiding Those Little Arms
tasks.description: Kill the Giant Mole without her damaging anyone.
context: Avoiding Those Little Arms is a medium combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Giant Mole without anyone taking damage from her.
method: The Giant Mole only attacks with melee. If melee is being used against the Giant Mole, Protect from Melee can be activated to negate all damage. Otherwise, Ranged or Magic can be used while using Protect from Melee, or while safespotting the Giant Mole on corners of the wall in the Mole Hole.

tasks.name: Nightmare Adept
tasks.description: Kill The Nightmare once.
context: Nightmare Adept is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to kill The Nightmare once.

tasks.name: Nightmare Veteran
tasks.description: Kill The Nightmare 25 times.
context: Nightmare Veteran is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to defeat The Nightmare 25 times. Phosani's Nightmare kills will also count towards this achievement.

tasks.name: Nightmare Master
tasks.description: Kill The Nightmare 50 times.
context: Nightmare Master is a master combat achievement which requires the player to defeat The Nightmare 50 times. Phosani's Nightmare kills will also count towards this achievement.

tasks.name: Terrible Parent
tasks.description: Kill the Nightmare solo without the Parasites healing the boss for more than 100 health.
context: Terrible Parent is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to kill The Nightmare in a solo encounter without the Parasites healing her for over 100 health.
method: Parasites only appear in phase 2, so clearing it quickly will prevent too many of them from spawning, though the phase itself can take quite a while due to the Nightmare's durable shield and totems. The parasite will burst from the player in 4-5 of their attacks (depending on weapon used), so it is recommended to walk underneath the Nightmare so that the parasite will not be able to heal her right away.
Drinking Relicym's balm or Sanfew serum is required before the parasite spawns as it will reduce their combat stats significantly, making them easier to kill. The parasite will have 40 health.

Several alternative methods may be more efficient, such as stepping under the parasites and attacking with the dragon claws or crimson kisten special attack, since unlike its hard mode variant, weapons on crush will not max hit the parasite.
Additional options for dealing high damage per second include the following weapons and their respective special attacks: Elder maul Granite maul Dragon dagger(p++) Dragon mace Voidwaker

tasks.name: Explosion!
tasks.description: Kill two Husks at the same time.
context: Explosion! is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill two Husks at the same time.
method: A dragon 2h sword or Dinh's bulwark special attack or a standard attack from Hallowfell, when targeted on the Nightmare, should kill both husks immediately. Husks have 20 hitpoints. Barrage spells or chinchompas can also work if the player doesn't have access to either weapon, though the husks are much more resistant to both styles. As a last resort for Ironmen, the husks can be weakened, then finished off with the special attack from a Rune thrownaxe, though this method is much less consistent and may take multiple attempts. Using the prayer Retribution also triggers completion, if you weaken the husks beforehand.
Note: Even though Husks also appear in Phosani's Nightmare, this achievement is only completable in Phase 1 of The Nightmare.

tasks.name: Perfect Nightmare
tasks.description: Kill the Nightmare without any player taking damage from the following attacks: Nightmare rifts, an un-cured parasite explosion, Corpse flowers or the Nightmare's Surge. Also, no player can take damage off prayer or have their attacks slowed by the Nightmare spores.
context: Perfect Nightmare is a master combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Nightmare without any player taking damage from the following attacks: Nightmare rifts, an un-cured parasite explosion, Corpse flowers or the Nightmare's Surge. Also, no player can take damage off prayer or have their attacks slowed by the Nightmare spores.

tasks.name: Sleep Tight
tasks.description: Kill the Nightmare solo.
context: Sleep Tight is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Nightmare solo. Due to the Nightmare's constant chip damage, an amulet of blood fury is strongly recommended to complete it.

tasks.name: A Long Trip
tasks.description: Kill the Nightmare without any player losing any prayer points.
context: A Long Trip is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires The Nightmare to be defeated with all players in the fight not losing any prayer points.
method: Prayer flicking is recommended to speed up the kill and take minimal damage as the Nightmare's attacks will deal higher damage if not prayed against. While completable solo, it is recommended to attempt the achievement in groups as they result in a faster kill.

It is not recommended to flick stat-boosting prayers alongside protection prayers, as they generally have a higher drain rate compared to protection prayers and a single mistake will disqualify the entire team from the achievement.
Lastly, summoning thralls (which drains prayer points) will not disqualify players.

tasks.name: Nightmare (Solo) Speed-Trialist
tasks.description: Defeat the Nightmare (Solo) in less than 23 minutes.
context: Nightmare (Solo) Speed-Trialist elite combat achievement which requires the player to defeat the Nightmare, solo, in under 23 minutes.
method: For strategies on this achievement, see Nightmare (Solo) Speed-Runner.

tasks.name: Nightmare (Solo) Speed-Chaser
tasks.description: Defeat the Nightmare (Solo) in less than 19 minutes.
context: Nightmare (Solo) Speed-Chaser is a master combat achievement which requires the player to defeat the Nightmare, solo, in under 19 minutes.
method: For strategies on this achievement, see Nightmare (Solo) Speed-Runner.

tasks.name: Nightmare (Solo) Speed-Runner
tasks.description: Defeat the Nightmare (Solo) in less than 16 minutes.
context: Nightmare (Solo) Speed-Runner is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to defeat the Nightmare in a solo encounter within 16 minutes.
method: A Scythe of Vitur is the most powerful weapon for this task, but an Inquisitor's mace or Soulreaper axe are viable alternatives. The relatively low Defence and high Hitpoints of the boss make those weapons' extra accuracy less valuable than the scythe's increased amount of hits, but either weapon is still sufficient for an experienced player.

Eye of Ayak and ancestral robes are beneficial for inflicting extra damage to the totems, with Tumeken's shadow and Sanguinesti staff trailing close behind in DPS. The Arceuus spellbook's ghostly thralls deal double damage on the totems, and Death Charge can be used on husks, parasites, and sleepwalkers to restore special attack more frequently. Use Crimson kisten or Voidwaker specials against the Nightmare. Lightbearer is very useful for spec regeneration.

tasks.name: Nightmare (5-Scale) Speed-Trialist
tasks.description: Defeat the Nightmare (5-scale) in less than 5 minutes.
context: Nightmare (5-Scale) Speed-Trialist is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to defeat the Nightmare in a team of 5 players in under 5 minutes.
Like other tasks requiring a specific number of players, this combat achievement is not required for Group Ironmen with a smaller group size.

tasks.name: Nightmare (5-Scale) Speed-Chaser
tasks.description: Defeat the Nightmare (5-scale) in less than 4 minutes.
context: Nightmare (5-Scale) Speed-Chaser is a master combat achievement which requires the player to defeat the Nightmare in a team of 5 players in under 4 minutes.
Like other tasks requiring a specific number of players, this combat achievement is not required for Group Ironmen with a smaller group size.

tasks.name: Nightmare (5-Scale) Speed-Runner
tasks.description: Defeat the Nightmare (5-scale) in less than 3:30 minutes.
context: Nightmare (5-Scale) Speed-Runner is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to defeat the Nightmare in a team of 5 players in under 3 minutes and 30 seconds.
Like other tasks requiring a specific number of players, this combat achievement is not required for Group Ironmen with a smaller group size.

tasks.name: Dagannoth Prime Champion
tasks.description: Kill Dagannoth Prime 10 times.
context: Dagannoth Prime Champion is a medium combat achievement which requires the player to kill Dagannoth Prime 10 times.

tasks.name: Dagannoth Prime Adept
tasks.description: Kill Dagannoth Prime 25 times.
context: Dagannoth Prime Adept is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to kill Dagannoth Prime 25 times.

tasks.name: Death to the Seer King
tasks.description: Kill Dagannoth Prime whilst under attack by Dagannoth Supreme and Dagannoth Rex.
context: Death to the Seer King is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill Dagannoth Prime whilst under attack by Dagannoth Supreme and Dagannoth Rex.

tasks.name: From One King to Another
tasks.description: Kill Prime using a Rune Thrownaxe special attack, bounced off Dagannoth Rex.
context: From One King to Another is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill Dagannoth Prime using a rune thrownaxe special attack, bounced off Dagannoth Rex.
Ironmen cannot receive help from other players to help tank the Kings.
For the task to count, the special attack must be the last attack made when Prime's death animation finishes.

tasks.name: Dagannoth Rex Champion
tasks.description: Kill Dagannoth Rex 10 times.
context: Dagannoth Rex Champion is a medium combat achievement which requires the player to kill Dagannoth Rex 10 times.

tasks.name: Dagannoth Rex Adept
tasks.description: Kill Dagannoth Rex 25 times.
context: Dagannoth Rex Adept is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to kill Dagannoth Rex 25 times.

tasks.name: Death to the Warrior King
tasks.description: Kill Dagannoth Rex whilst under attack by Dagannoth Supreme and Dagannoth Prime.
context: Death to the Warrior King is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill Dagannoth Rex whilst under attack by Dagannoth Supreme and Dagannoth Prime.

tasks.name: A Frozen King
tasks.description: Kill Dagannoth Rex whilst he is immobilized.
context: A Frozen King is a medium combat achievement which requires the player to kill Dagannoth Rex whilst he is immobilized. Curse spells, grasp spells, and ice spells count towards this achievement.

tasks.name: Toppling the Diarchy
tasks.description: Kill Dagannoth Rex and one other Dagannoth king at the exact same time.
context: Toppling the Diarchy is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill Dagannoth Rex and one other Dagannoth king at the exact same time.
method: The easiest method is to bring another player and attack Dagannoth Rex and a different king on the same tick, causing both to be dealt the killing blow at the same time. To make this even easier, the Voidwaker's special attack is guaranteed to deal at least 50% of the player's normal max hit, meaning using the special attack at the same time as the other player uses it will not leave your final hits up to chance.

For Ironmen and players who wish to complete the task solo, stack Dagannoth Rex and Dagannoth Prime on top of each other and kill them with the dragon crossbow's special attack. Alternatively, black chinchompas thrown at Dagannoth Prime have a similar, but slightly weaker effect. It's recommended to bring both in case the special attack misses. To ensure the best chance of this method working, bring runes for Entangle to keep Rex as close to death as possible, as it can only hit up to 5 damage.
In either case, ensure neither of the two kings move when lowering their hitpoints to 0, as this will cause their death animations to desync and will not grant the achievement.
Ensure you have kill credit on both Rex and the second Dagannoth king for the combat achievement to count.

tasks.name: Sarachnis Novice
tasks.description: Kill Sarachnis 10 times.
context: Sarachnis Novice is an easy combat achievement which requires the player to kill Sarachnis 10 times.

tasks.name: Sarachnis Champion
tasks.description: Kill Sarachnis 25 times.
context: Sarachnis Champion is a medium combat achievement which requires the player to kill Sarachnis 25 times.

tasks.name: Ready to Pounce
tasks.description: Kill Sarachnis without her using her range attack twice in a row.
context: Ready to Pounce is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to kill Sarachnis without her using her range attack twice in a row.
method: This achievement is most easily done with melee in a solo encounter as this makes Sarachnis' attacks very predictable. To avoid damage from her, players should stand in the centre of the room as she spawns (see image), activate Protect from Melee, and wait for her sticky web attack.

Aranea boots will easily allow the player to remain in melee distance, preventing any ranged attacks from occurring. Otherwise, standing in the area marked in the image will ensure players will only get hit once by her Ranged attack after her web attack, as players will be able to move within range of her melee attack from anywhere in the marked area. If done correctly, she should never be able to damage players off prayer, and should allow players to complete the Inspect Repellent achievement as well, if they haven't already completed it.

tasks.name: Inspect Repellent
tasks.description: Kill Sarachnis without her dealing damage to anyone.
context: Inspect Repellent is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to kill Sarachnis without her dealing damage to anyone.
method: This achievement is most easily done with melee in a solo encounter, as this makes Sarachnis' attacks very predictable. To avoid damage from her, the player should stand in the centre of the room as she spawns, activate protect from melee, and wait for her sticky web attack. Once she says "Hsss!", the player should change to protect from missiles and start spam clicking her, and as soon as the player starts moving, change prayer back to protect from melee. If done correctly, she should only use her ranged attack once per web and complete the Ready to Pounce achievement as well.

Alternatively, the achievement can be completed by standing in the centre of the room using a halberd and praying protect from missiles. With running turned off, the player will not accidentally get within Sarachnis' melee range and can thus defeat her without ever switching prayers.

The Aranea boots are invaluable for this achievement. Players with access to the boots will bypass Sarachnis' sticky web every time and will only need to stay within melee range with protect from melee and running on. This method in a solo encounter is by far the easiest way to complete the achievement.
Taking damage from her spawns will not fail this achievement.

tasks.name: Newspaper Enthusiast
tasks.description: Kill Sarachnis with a crush weapon.
context: Newspaper Enthusiast is a medium combat achievement which requires the player to kill Sarachnis with a crush weapon.
method: Other weapons and combat styles can be used during the fight. Only the final blow has to be dealt using the crush attack style.

tasks.name: Commander Zilyana Adept
tasks.description: Kill Commander Zilyana 50 times.
context: Commander Zilyana Adept is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to kill Commander Zilyana 50 times.

tasks.name: Commander Zilyana Veteran
tasks.description: Kill Commander Zilyana 100 times.
context: Commander Zilyana Veteran is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill Commander Zilyana 100 times.

tasks.name: Commander Showdown
tasks.description: Finish off Commander Zilyana while all of her bodyguards are dead.
context: Commander Showdown is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to finish off Commander Zilyana while all of her bodyguards are dead.
method: A good method to complete this task solo, alongside the similar tasks for each of the respective God Wars Dungeon bosses, is to use a Toxic blowpipe alongside a Serpentine helm to envenom the bodyguards between kills, so that when the boss is low on health all of the minions are also low/dead, allowing them to be killed easier.

tasks.name: Animal Whisperer
tasks.description: Kill Commander Zilyana in a private instance without taking any damage from the boss or bodyguards.
context: Animal Whisperer is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to kill Commander Zilyana in a private instance without taking damage from either her or her bodyguards.
method: This achievement is fairly straightforward to achieve with the kiting method. A twisted bow or tumeken's shadow is encouraged to help speed up kills and reduce the amount of time needed to kill Zilyana. The kiting method will ensure that Starlight, the melee bodyguard, should never hit the player. This leaves Growler and Bree, the magic and ranged bodyguards respectively, as the only major threat. It is important to have the two hit on different ticks so their attacks can be protected against.
With some luck, it is possible to kill Zilyana before the bodyguard the player is not protecting against damages the player.

An alternative method to consider is killing either Growler or Bree just after Zilyana respawns, praying protection for the magic/ranged bodyguard that does respawn, then proceeding with the kiting method as normal. This allows time to kill Zilyana for this Combat Achievement without needing to change prayers.

tasks.name: Moving Collateral
tasks.description: Kill Commander Zilyana in a private instance without attacking her directly.
