context: Moving Collateral is a master combat achievement which requires the player to kill Commander Zilyana in a private instance without attacking her directly.
method: The inefficient nature of this achievement encourages setting up for a single kill run.

Using chinchompas to hit Starlight (or other minions) is the fastest method, bypassing Zilyana's high defence via splash damage. The venator bow is a slower method, but can be used similarly on a minion near Zilyana to complete the achievement. Barrage spells can also be used, but are the most inefficient method due to Zilyana's high Magic level.
To avoid accidentally attacking Zilyana, use menu entry swapper to change Zilyana's default click option.
Rings of recoil or the ring of suffering will not fail the task, and can be used for additional damage during the kill.

tasks.name: Reminisce
tasks.description: Kill Commander Zilyana in a private instance with melee only.
context: Reminisce is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill Commander Zilyana in a private instance using only melee.
method: The achievement is made much easier by running away from (or walking under) Zilyana after every hit, as her magic attack leaves her unable to move for a few seconds, allowing players to trade hits one-for-one despite her fast attack speed. Use Protect from Magic and an accurate melee weapon like Osmumten's fang, along with a defence-reducing special weapon, such as the elder maul or dragon warhammer. Ideally, Justiciar armour along with a spectral or elysian spirit shield should be used to greatly reduce damage taken from Zilyana's attacks.

Note: A ring of recoil, Vengeance, and other forms of damage reflection will fail this task. However, zombified thralls are allowed as they use melee. The Voidwaker's special attack will also cause the task to fail, as it is magic based.

tasks.name: Peach Conjurer
tasks.description: Kill Commander Zilyana 50 times in a privately rented instance without leaving the room.
context: Peach Conjurer is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to kill Commander Zilyana 50 times in a private instance, without leaving the room. In order to attempt this task, players will need to have the Hard Combat Achievements done so that they are able to rent private instances.
method: Follow the typical strategies for fighting Zilyana in a solo encounter. Drops in a private instance (barring bones) will remain for 3 hours, more than enough for the achievement.

This task is significantly longer than any other God Wars kill count task, as Zilyana respawns 90 seconds after being killed. With 50 kills being required for the task, the spawn time alone will account for 73.5 minutes, and kill times can be fairly inconsistent, so players should expect to be staying for a minimum of at least two hours for the task. Due to this, it is highly recommended to use the bathroom before attempting the task and to avoid drinking too many fluids. If a bathroom break is necessary, it should be done during minion cleanup, autocasting Blood Barrage on minions to sustain health. Be sure to re-log/world hop before starting the attempt, in order to avoid potentially being six hour logged midway through the attempt.

It is also imperative that the player take care of their physical well being, such as through regular stretches, particularly during the respawn phase after having dealt with the minions which allows for downtime. Ensure to take a reasonable break in between attempts instead of retrying immediately. Turning on a secondary light source can help prevent eye strain if playing at night, as can lowering the in-game brightness seting and/or the brightness of the screen due to the bright nature of the God Wars Dungeon. Be sure to have a source of water on hand and to take regular sips throughout the attempt. Opening a window beforehand can help prevent headaches.
Getting a Zilyana boss task will help shorten the achievement duration due to the bonuses provided from a slayer helmet.
Players can choose between magic or ranged. Magic is highly recommended over range for the following reasons:

Best-in-slot magic is more accurate than ranged and less heavy despite losing out on max hits and defence bonuses Greater healing capability (Blood Barrage on two or even all three minions compared to toxic blowpipe and bones to peaches tabs) Plenty of inventory spaces saved by not having to bring numerous divine bastion potions due to the saturated heart

Following run energy changes on 8 January 2025, players with 77+ Agility are unlikely to run out of sufficient run energy while killing Zilyana. Through use of certain methods, players can sustain run energy without using stamina potions. If run energy is still a problem, a single 4-dose Extended stamina potion should suffice. Purple sweets can also be used but are much more expensive. Furthermore, a Summer pie restores 10 run energy per slice and can be obtained as a drop during the attempt.

Prayer regeneration potions are also useful in restoring some prayer over time, and players should bring at least three of these to supplement their own prayer potions and pre-pot one before starting a trip. Zilyana can drop three sets of four dose prayer potions or super restores. These are a nice bonus to help sustain trips but should not be fully relied on due to their uncommon drop rate.

If using ranged, players will want to bring at least six divine bastion potions, a toxic blowpipe with dragon darts, a rune pouch for Death Charge and a Lightbearer, as Zilyana does not drop ranging potions and healing is more limited.

tasks.name: Scorpia Adept
tasks.description: Kill Scorpia 10 times.
context: Scorpia Adept is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to kill Scorpia 10 times.

tasks.name: Scorpia Veteran
tasks.description: Kill Scorpia 25 times.
context: Scorpia Veteran is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill Scorpia 25 times.

tasks.name: I Can't Reach That
tasks.description: Kill Scorpia without taking any damage from her.
context: I Can't Reach That is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to kill Scorpia without taking any damage from her. This can be done by using Protect from Melee throughout the fight.
Leaving the cave to reset aggression does not fail the achievement.

tasks.name: Guardians No More
tasks.description: Kill Scorpia without killing her guardians.
context: Guardians No More is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to kill Scorpia without killing her guardians.
method: Scorpia's guardians will despawn when they have not healed Scorpia for 15 seconds and will not respawn for the rest of the fight. When the guardians spawn, cast either entangle, ice blitz, or ice barrage on both of them and then lure Scorpia to the other side of the room. If Scorpia is lured far enough, the guardians will despawn before reaching her. Blighted entangle sacks or blighted ancient ice sacks are cheap and convenient to use for this purpose.

tasks.name: Fragment of Seren Speed-Trialist
tasks.description: Kill The Fragment of Seren in less than 4 minutes.
context: Fragment of Seren Speed-Trialist is an elite combat achievement that requires the Fragment of Seren boss fight to be completed in less than four minutes. Completion of Song of the Elves is required to attempt this achievement as the fight during the quest does not count. The fight can be attempted at the Memoriam Device in Prifddinas.
method: Generally, hard foods such as fish or hunter meat should be avoided as the tick delay will consume a significant amount of time while recovering from Seren's special attacks. Saradomin brews could be used, however these drain stats and are not recommended. The key to this achievement is to maximise one’s Magic attack damage and bonus, as well as minimising disruption to attacking the Fragment, mainly eating. Players should also be able to quickly identify the real Fragment when she duplicates herself (being the lighter coloured shadow) as well as bringing a fast weapon, such as darts or blowpipe, to quickly dispose of the crystal whirlwinds to stop her from healing and also to resume attacking her. An accursed sceptre special attack at the beginning of each phase will reduce her defence and help speed up the kill. The Eye of Ayak is the best weapon to use due to its fast attack speed, which is affected less by the damage cap of 24 on the Fragment. The Sanguinesti staff is also a useful staff to gain health back after the max-hitting final special attack.

Players should also bring phoenix necklaces alongside a few divine potions or Zamorak brews, as well as Guthix rests. When the Fragment uses the high damage attack, the player can manipulate the passive effect of the phoenix necklace to heal the player and provide immunity from the high hitting attack. The consumables brought should minimise the delay between attacking the Fragment.

In general, when praying against the fragment's attacks, using the above strategy should not be needed when relying on a combination of snowy knights and Guthix rest(4) in the inventory, combined with some Phoenix necklaces and occasional Sanguinesti staff or Blood Barrage healing. Snowy knights heal for 15 hitpoints per use, while Guthix Rest heals for 5 health per use, for a total of 20 health.

Melee with a multi-hitting weapon (such as the Scythe of Vitur), alongside a defence-draining special attack weapon, is a reliable strategy to complete this task. This is because the Fragment of Seren's damage cap of 24 applies for each hitsplat rather than overall hits, allowing players to deal more than 24 damage if using multi-hit weapons. Since she is not immune to burn, the burning claws are also a good option for special attacks. Do note that, other than the Scythe and your special attack weapons, no melee weapon comes close to the required dps compared to using a modest magic setup and a trident of the seas. This is partly because she is out of melee range during her 4th special attack.

Pre-pot an anglerfish and a dose of super combat potion prior to attempting the fight, then attempt to drain her defence. Note that while her defence cannot be lowered below 60, defence drains apply prior to the damage cap. As such, a hit of 42 from a Bandos godsword will reduce her defence to the lowest possible even if the player appears to hit 22-24. This allows the usage of another special attacking weapon (such as a dragon dagger or dragon claws) to help speed up the fight.

If the defence reducing attacks don't hit, die and restart. If the special attacks do hit, attack the Fragment for the remainder of the fight, taking care to step back after each hit to avoid her multi-hit melee attack.

During the first three max-hit special attacks, 288 damage is typically dealt to players at level 99 Hitpoints. With Protect from Missiles on throughout the fight, chip damage tends to add at most 40 damage per minute, for a total of 448 hitpoints. Using three Phoenix necklaces during the fight, this restores a total of 87 hitpoints. With Guthix Rests healing a total of 20 hitpoints, and snowy knights healing 15 hitpoints, the inventory setup below heals a total of 360 health, which would break even. Substituting more Snowy Knights for Guthix Rests can allow for more leniency with health management, although Snowy Knights can restore health much more quickly. This simplifies the health management by a lot, allowing you to focus on the fight's mechanics. For players using a Sanguinesti staff or bringing Blood Barrage spells, the additional health regenerated from these spells should provide ample healing to survive for the duration of the kill.

Toxic blowpipe or Rosewood blowpipe for destroying whirlwinds Accursed sceptre or Burning claws for special attacks Saturated/imbued heart or forgotten brew to boost Magic level before entering One Phoenix necklace per max-hit special attack. These special attacks are used at the end of every minute of the fight, meaning at most 4 are needed. The fourth special attack is used only a few seconds before the 4:00 minute mark, meaning the challenge is lost if the fight lasts longer than this. Because of this, proccing a 4th phoenix necklace adds no value. One super restore potion, or alternatively a Falador shield 4 with both restore charges remaining At level 84 prayer, with +7 prayer bonus, a single full super restore potion provides enough prayer restoration to last for over 4 minutes. At lower prayer levels, pre-boosting prayer using an Ancient mace may be necessary to have it last for the full 4 minutes. Refer to Calculator:Prayer/Prayer drain to calculate how much prayer restoration is needed. Guthix rests for fine-tuning health if needing to heal, and for higher hp per inventory slot Snowy knights for larger amounts of health per use, allowing players to focus more on the fight. |-| Magic (Phoenix)=

Toxic blowpipe or Rosewood blowpipe for destroying healing whirlwinds Accursed sceptre Saturated/imbued heart or forgotten brew to boost Magic level before entering Locator orb to lower health before and during the fight (enter with 40-50 HP) Note that damage from the orb cannot activate phoenix necklaces Phoenix necklaces and cheap divine potions to activate the necklaces Zamorak brews also work, but note that they lower your Defence level Guthix rests for fine-tuning health if needing to heal Method of restoring prayer points, such as moonlight moth mixes |-| Melee=

Toxic blowpipe (fast attack speed) or magic shortbow/webweaver bow (longer attack range) for destroying clones and whirlwinds Bandos godsword and dragon/burning claws Surge potion Divine super combat potion Anglerfish, cooked karambwan, and Saradomin brews Super restores

tasks.name: A Frozen Foe from the Past
tasks.description: Kill a Skeletal Wyvern
context: A Frozen Foe from the Past is a medium combat achievement which requires the player to kill a skeletal wyvern requiring 72 Slayer.

tasks.name: Zulrah Adept
tasks.description: Kill Zulrah 25 times.
context: Zulrah Adept is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to kill Zulrah 25 times.

tasks.name: Zulrah Veteran
tasks.description: Kill Zulrah 75 times.
context: Zulrah Veteran is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill Zulrah 75 times.

tasks.name: Zulrah Master
tasks.description: Kill Zulrah 150 times.
context: Zulrah Master is a master combat achievement which requires the player to kill Zulrah 150 times.

tasks.name: Snake Rebound
tasks.description: Kill Zulrah by using the Vengeance spell as the finishing blow.
context: Snake Rebound is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill Zulrah by using the Vengeance spell as the finishing blow.
method: Keep in mind that Vengeance has a 30 second cooldown, so plan accordingly. Make sure there are no snakelings present when setting up the kill, otherwise they might hit the player and waste the cast. Once Zulrah is at less than ~15 HP, cast vengeance before an attack hits. To help guarantee damage, the player can intentionally get hit by the tail whip attack during Zulrah's magma form, but must ensure that they are positioned away from any pillars as said pillars will cause the attack to miss. It is possible to use a ring of recoil or a ring of suffering (r) to help as well. The player does not need to survive Zulrah's final attack in order to obtain the achievement.

tasks.name: Snake. Snake!? Snaaaaaake!
tasks.description: Kill 3 Snakelings simultaneously.
context: Snake. Snake!? Snaaaaaake! is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill 3 snakelings simultaneously while fighting Zulrah.
method: Zulrah will usually summon three to four snakelings at a time. The snakelings may either attack with melee or magic, so lure melee-using snakelings near magic ones and hit the pile with an instant damage area of effect attack, such as throwing a chinchompa, casting a burst/barrage spell, or attacking with Hallowfell. Toggle recoil off to avoid killing a snakeling, and try to pile them as quickly as possible as they will die off if left too long, even if in combat with the player.

Alternatively, this achievement can also be passively accomplished with your recoil ring eventually whilst fighting Zulrah. Be mindful not to accidentally die when you are unprepared to receive the achievement notification.

tasks.name: Perfect Zulrah
tasks.description: Kill Zulrah whilst taking no damage from the following: Snakelings, Venom Clouds, Zulrah's Green or Crimson phase.
context: Perfect Zulrah is a master combat achievement which requires the player to kill Zulrah whilst taking no damage from the following: Snakelings, Venom Clouds, Zulrah's Green or Crimson phase.
method: To kill Zulrah without being hit, snakelings need to be killed as quickly as possible. They spawn as either melee or magic users, their high accuracy means that they are likely to hit if their attack is not protected against. Ensure distance is kept, pray Protect from Magic, and use a blowpipe to kill the snakelings as they spawn; their NPC IDs are different (with 2045 being the melee spawns, and 2046 being the magic spawns) so you can highlight them for quick differentiation. Strong defensive (ranged) gear and a defensive prayer will minimise chances of being hit off prayer. One or two well-timed Chinchompas can also take out a snakeling clump and allow the player to quickly continue killing the boss.

In general, killing the boss as quickly as possible reduces your chance of being hit by a snakeling, so following advice for achieving record times will maximize chances of completing this task. If resetting to complete this task by itself, players may find the green/ranged rotation to be beneficial to prioritise, as the snakelings spawn almost all together at the start of the kill, and many can be trapped on the far side of the shrine and killed safely from a distance.

tasks.name: Zulrah Speed-Trialist
tasks.description: Kill Zulrah in less than 1 minute 20 seconds, without a slayer task.
context: Zulrah Speed-Trialist is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill Zulrah in less than 1 minute 20 seconds, without a slayer task.
method: For strategies on this achievement, see Zulrah Speed-Runner.

tasks.name: Zulrah Speed-Chaser
tasks.description: Kill Zulrah in less than 1 minute, without a slayer task.
context: Zulrah Speed-Chaser is a master combat achievement requiring the player to kill Zulrah in less than 1 minute, without a slayer task.
method: For strategies on this achievement, see Zulrah Speed-Runner.

tasks.name: Zulrah Speed-Runner
tasks.description: Kill Zulrah in less than 54 seconds, without a slayer task.
context: Zulrah Speed-Runner is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to kill Zulrah in less than 54 seconds without having it assigned as a slayer task.
method: As a fast speed-kill achievement, the player will want to use thralls, and all damage-boosting equipment and prayers available for both ranged and magic. Any hits that would deal over 50 damage to Zulrah will be reduced to 45-50 damage; however, this only applies to individual hitsplats, meaning a special attack from a weapon such as the crystal halberd will work around this damage cap.

Tumeken's shadow is recommended for Zulrah's ranged and melee forms (as the player will be very accurate despite the high Magic level, due to no Magic defence); for the mage form, a toxic blowpipe with dragon darts is recommended for rapid hits, in part due to the faster attack speed and Zulrah's damage cap. Vengeance can also be useful in rebounding damage back at Zulrah, provided that no Snakelings are present in the arena. As a finisher, the player can use a dark bow with dragon arrows, to expend special attack energy.

Alternatively, Oathplate armour in conjunction with a Noxious halberd and a Crystal halberd for special attacks may be used, as Zulrah possesses no additional melee defence. Furthermore an Eclipse atlatl can be brought to attack Zulrah for when Venom Clouds hinder you from getting close to Zulrah.

Players may cast Vengeance on themselves before the fight begins, then use Spellbook Swap to switch to the Arceuus spellbook to summon a thrall. At level 99 Magic, the thrall will last for the entire fight. Players may then use Vengeance whenever available to maximize reflected damage.

tasks.name: Dagannoth Supreme Champion
tasks.description: Kill Dagannoth Supreme 10 times.
context: Dagannoth Supreme Champion is a medium combat achievement which requires the player to kill Dagannoth Supreme 10 times.

tasks.name: Dagannoth Supreme Adept
tasks.description: Kill Dagannoth Supreme 25 times.
context: Dagannoth Supreme Adept is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to kill Dagannoth Supreme 25 times.

tasks.name: Death to the Archer King
tasks.description: Kill Dagannoth Supreme whilst under attack by Dagannoth Prime and Dagannoth Rex.
context: Death to the Archer King is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill Dagannoth Supreme whilst under attack by Dagannoth Prime and Dagannoth Rex.

tasks.name: Rapid Succession
tasks.description: Kill all three Dagannoth Kings within 9 seconds of the first one.
context: Rapid Succession is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill all three Dagannoth Kings within 9 seconds of the first one. Ironmen cannot use main accounts to help tank the Kings to complete this challenge.
method: The Voidwaker special attack is guaranteed to deal at least 50% of your melee max hit. Use your regular gear to attack two of the Dagannoth Kings until their health is below 50% of your melee max hit (below 20 hitpoints should be enough), then kill the third Dagannoth King. Then, quickly switch to your melee gear and kill the remaining two Kings with Voidwaker special attacks. They should die after one special attack hit each, completing the combat achievement.

To complete this task you should first determine if it's better for you to use Magic or Ranged attacks. Based on your skill levels and gear either method could be more viable for you. For a Magic-based approach bring your strongest Barrage or Burst spell on the Ancient spellbook, and for a Ranged-based approach bring your strongest Chinchompa.

When gearing for this task take full tribrid gear including a non-AoE weapon for all combat styles. In addition, bring your AoE method of choice, whether that be the Magic- or Ranged-based approach. You may also consider bringing Justiciar equipment to tank the Melee and Ranged attacks while praying Protect from Magic. Food and potions for the trip should be balanced for the purpose of staying alive long enough to reattempt this task, and not to continue a long trip after finishing the task.

After entering the cave bring Prime to below 10% health, which is about 25 hitpoints. Next, if you've brought a Ranged AoE attack then begin to attack Rex and bring him to 10% health, or if you brought a Magic AoE attack then begin to attack Supreme and bring him to 10% health.

Next, attack the final King using a non-AoE attack to bring it to 12%-15% health. Then manoeuvre the Kings into a position where attacking this final King with an AoE attack will also attack the other two Kings. If you set the health up correctly you are likely to kill both of the Kings you aren't currently attacking first, and then you can switch to your normal weapon to finish off the final King. If the final King remaining is Supreme then the Crystal Halberd should be able to land a decisive final hit with its special attack.

Safest way to set up the kill situation is to first get into a place where you are only attacking Prime. You can lower Prime's health low, keeping protect from magic on. At that point you can tag Rex and lure it into its safespot, where you can lower its health.

When both Rex and Prime have low health, you can change to your melee gear, keep protect from magic on, and melee Supreme. This way you only need to tank hits from Supreme and Rex, and you can possible even entangle Rex to take even less damage while killing Supreme.

The tribrid solo strategy can be difficult due to all three Dagannoth Kings attacking you at once. To make it easier, a group of players can enter the cave before you and tank the attacks from each King. You can then enter the cave and attack each King without worrying about the Kings attacking you back, since each King is busy attacking another player instead. So long as you are the only player to attack each King, the combat achievement can be completed. Note that this strategy won't work for Ironmen.

tasks.name: Theatre of Blood Veteran
tasks.description: Complete the Theatre of Blood 25 times.
context: Theatre of Blood Veteran is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to complete the Theatre of Blood 25 times. Hard Mode Theatre of Blood completions will also count towards this achievement.
Theatre of Blood: Entry Mode does not count towards the completion of this achievement.

tasks.name: Theatre of Blood Master
tasks.description: Complete the Theatre of Blood 75 times.
context: Theatre of Blood Master is a master combat achievement which requires the player to complete the Theatre of Blood 75 times. Hard Mode Theatre of Blood completions will also count towards this achievement.

tasks.name: Theatre of Blood Grandmaster
tasks.description: Complete the Theatre of Blood 150 times.
context: Theatre of Blood Grandmaster is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to complete the Theatre of Blood 150 times. Hard Mode Theatre of Blood completions will also count towards this achievement.

tasks.name: Two-Down
tasks.description: Kill the Pestilent Bloat before he shuts down for the third time.
context: Two-Down is a master combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Pestilent Bloat before he shuts down a third time.
method: This achievement is very easy to accomplish as long as players are using the best strength gear they can afford, or elite void. Ideally some players should have the Scythe of Vitur, though players should have at least a crystal halberd, dragon claws, and a salve amulet (e) since the Bloat is susceptible to the amulet's effects.

tasks.name: Pop It
tasks.description: Kill Verzik without any Nylocas being frozen and without anyone taking damage from the Nylocas.
context: Pop It is a master combat achievement which requires the player to kill Verzik without any Nylocas being frozen and without anyone taking damage from the Nylocas and without dying yourself.
method: This is best completed in a duo or trio encounter, to limit the amount of nylocas that spawns during the fight.
Nylocas Ischyros should be dealt with using a halberd, as it can potentially kill it without being in range for it to explode.
Nylocas Toxobolos and Nylocas Hagios can be killed from a distance with any weapon.

Alternatively, the player can simply avoid them by being at least four tiles away when they explode. However, this requires a bit more skill to pull off, since the AoE can be large enough to cause collateral to other players if improperly dodged.

tasks.name: A Timely Snack
tasks.description: Kill Sotetseg after surviving at least 3 ball attacks without sharing the damage and without anyone dying throughout the fight.
context: A Timely Snack is a master combat achievement which requires the player to kill Sotetseg after taking at least 3 ball attacks without sharing the damage and without anyone dying in the fight.
method: The large red ball attack deals 121 damage if the damage is not shared, and is launched after every 10 direct magic attacks Sotetseg makes on the team. Simply tank the damage via tick-eating, though players should be wary of incoming projectiles to avoid being killed in the process.

tasks.name: Perfect Theatre
tasks.description: Complete the Theatre of Blood without anyone dying through any means and whilst everyone in the team completes the following Combat Achievement tasks in a single run: "Perfect Maiden", "Perfect Bloat", "Perfect Nylocas", "Perfect Sotetseg", "Perfect Xarpus" and "Perfect Verzik".
context: Perfect Theatre is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to complete the Theatre of Blood without anyone dying while qualifying for the completion of Perfect Maiden, Perfect Bloat, Perfect Nylocas, Perfect Sotetseg, Perfect Xarpus, and Perfect Verzik.
method: Perfect Theatre is considered one of the hardest grandmaster achievements in-game, as the task itself requires that all players complete their master variants at the same time. Even one simple mistake on any of these tasks will immediately disqualify the whole team, thus all players should have sufficient experience and know how to kill the bosses.

It is best to attempt this achievement in a trio scale, as it means less potential to make overall mistakes (as each additional player can potentially compound a mistake and thus disqualify the entire team), though this does mean the nylocas waves may be more tedious with a lack of chinchompas and barrage spells.
More in-depth advice on every relevant boss can be found under their own respective perfect pages, as listed above.

tasks.name: Perfect Maiden
tasks.description: Kill The Maiden of Sugadinti without anyone in the team taking damage from the following sources: Blood Spawn projectiles and Blood Spawn trails. Also, without taking damage off prayer and without letting any of the Nylocas Matomenos heal The Maiden.
context: Perfect Maiden is a master combat achievement which requires the player to kill The Maiden of Sugadinti without taking any damage off-prayer, from her blood splatter projectiles and Blood spawn trails along with letting a Nylocas Matomenos heal her.
method: Standing far away from the Maiden (or being able to predict when the blood splatter is launched) will prevent players from being damaged by the attack and minimise the chances of a blood spawn appearing. As the Maiden only attacks with magic, keeping Protect from Magic on will ensure that no off-prayer hits are received based on her aggro mechanics.

Groups of Nylocas Matamenos will appear when the Maiden reaches 70, 50, and 30% of her health for the first time. Using common freezing tactics for lone and bunched nylocas will help ensure that they can be bound and killed before they reach the Maiden. At the 30% interval, it is possible to skip killing them with very good DPS but should not be relied on.

tasks.name: Perfect Bloat
tasks.description: Kill the Pestilent Bloat without anyone in the team taking damage from the following sources: Pestilent flies, Falling body parts or The Pestilent Bloats stomp attack.
context: Perfect Bloat is a master combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Pestilent Bloat without anyone in the team taking damage from the following sources: Pestilent flies, Falling body parts or The Pestilent Bloats stomp attack.
method: Players should avoid immediately entering the arena if Bloat starts by moving north, as they will be flied upon entering the room. Players entering the room later should also wait until Bloat goes down the first time as he may occasionally send a fly from the far side due to line of sight.

tasks.name: Perfect Nylocas
tasks.description: Kill the Nylocas Vasilias without anyone in the team attacking any Nylocas with the wrong attack style, without letting a pillar collapse and without getting hit by any of the Nylocas Vasilias attacks whilst off prayer.
context: Perfect Nylocas is a master combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Nylocas Vasilias without anyone in the team attacking any Nylocas with the wrong attack style, without letting a pillar collapse and without getting hit by any of the Nylocas Vasilias attacks whilst off prayer.
method: Using barrage spells or chinchompas is not recommended, so players will have to ensure they kill nylos quick enough that pillar health will not be a concern. Highlighting each nylo before you attack can help avoid accidental misclicks or a nylocas changing styles.

tasks.name: Perfect Sotetseg
tasks.description: Kill Sotetseg without anyone in the team stepping on the wrong tile in the maze, without getting hit by the tornado and without taking any damage from Sotetseg's attacks whilst off prayer.
context: Perfect Sotetseg is a master combat achievement which requires the player to kill Sotetseg without anyone in the team stepping on the wrong tile in the maze, without getting hit by the tornado and without taking any damage from Sotetseg's attacks whilst off prayer.
method: The achievement requires players to avoid damage from wrong tiles during the maze mechanic and from Sotetseg's auto-attacks. Sotetseg will attack with all three combat styles, but with either melee or magic as a primary attack style. The magic attack will shatter into either another magic attack or a ranged one. If players are out of melee distance, Sotetseg will only use magic attacks. The melee attack will tend to hit before a ranged or magic hit, but because of its unpredictability, players can alternatively use a halberd or ranged weapons instead and attack from a distance, ensuring that the melee attacks are never used.

The charged ball can be shared or tick-eaten, but players can skip the attack by triggering the maze at 66% and 33% hp instead. Wait at around 70% and 40% hp until the ball is sent, then do enough damage to reach the threshold.
Make sure to Protect from Melee when exiting the maze to avoid accidentally taking a hit off prayer if selected by Sotetseg to enter the Shadow Realm.

tasks.name: Perfect Xarpus
tasks.description: Kill Xarpus without anyone in the team taking any damage from Xarpus' attacks and without letting an exhumed heal Xarpus more than twice.
context: Perfect Xarpus is a master combat achievement which requires the player to kill Xarpus without taking any damage from his attacks and without letting an exhumed heal him more than two times.
method: Learning how to handle exhumed is the only major roadblock in this achievement, as they are the only major issue due to how they spawn around Xarpus. It is recommended to try this in a trio encounter, as the exhumed will spawn significantly faster in 4 and 5-man encounters.

Landing defence draining specials from the bandos godsword and dragon warhammer are essential to completing the task. Players should ideally start together in one corner in a death-dot to minimise the amount of poison splatters across the arena. Each poison splatter has a 3x3 AoE, so it is important to stand two tiles away from the impact zone to avoid taking damage from it.

Once Xarpus is lowered to 25.0% of its health, it will screech and begin the next phase. It is important to watch where Xarpus is focusing at to avoid taking damage, after which the team should move to where he had just looked at as Xarpus can never look at the same direction twice in a row. Assuming that the players were ranging, they should not have any issue with any ragged tiles near him.

tasks.name: Perfect Verzik
tasks.description: Defeat Verzik Vitur without anyone in the team taking damage from Verzik Vitur's attacks other than her spider form's correctly prayed against regular magical and ranged attacks.
context: Perfect Verzik is a master combat achievement which requires the player to defeat Verzik Vitur without anyone in the team taking avoidable damage from Verzik Vitur's attacks.
Specifically, players are not allowed to take damage from:

Magic and ranged attacks during phases 1 and 2 Damage from pillar falling Nylocas explosions Verzik's bounce attack during phase 2 If no damage is taken, this will not invalidate the run Ranged or magic attacks during phase 3 that are not correctly prayed against Being stuck in a web when it expires Yellow projectile when not shielded Green bomb attack without bouncing it to other players as many times as possible Verzik's Tornado attack

Players may take damage from: Nylocas Athanatos landing Lightning attack, it is allowed to tank the zap if the projectile immediately dissipates upon hitting the first player for a large amount of damage, or if the entire chain is handled correctly. However, letting the projectile correctly bounce on the first player and then incorrectly zap subsequent players for large amounts of damage will fail the task. Green bomb attack if it will continue to target another player or it cannot be bounced further
method: No special considerations are needed for this phase as long as teams use enough Dawnbringer special attacks. Players who seek to deal extra damage with melee should be mindful of Verzik's attack speed and time to hide to avoid getting clipped by her attack. Make sure to avoid standing next to a pillar once the phase ends to avoid getting hit as it collapses.

To reduce the chance of a nylocas exploding on a player, wait until nylos spawn and freeze them immediately. The Nylocas Athanatos that spawns will begin to slowly heal Verzik. As long as it is left alive no more nylocas will spawn and it is very easy to out-damage the healing with a Scythe of Vitur. Once the Nylocas Matomenos spawn, the purple nylocas can be killed off. Save any special attacks for Phase 3 enrage. It is very important to time attacks so that Verzik does not bounce a player, as it is possible to take damage (and fail the achievement) from it, and it is more than likely to be hit by a ranged attack while stunned.

Whoever is tanking Verzik should not step under the boss as it reduces the travel time of her projectiles, making them more difficult to correctly pray against. Players should freeze the nylocas that spawn similarly to P2 to avoid any potential explosion damage.

It should be the team's goal to do enough damage to end the encounter before the green ball special attack, as its mechanics require a large amount of coordination. If the players have enough special attack energy and Scythes, they can leave Verzik with just above 20% until the yellow attack. Afterwards, use as many special attacks as possible to end the encounter. With a small team or in teams without a lot of Scythes it may be easier to continue doing damage and start enrage early. Avoiding the tornados while correctly standing on a yellow portal can give a much needed head start to finishing Verzik off before the green ball is launched.

tasks.name: Can't Drain This
tasks.description: Kill The Maiden of Sugadinti without anyone in the team losing any prayer points.
context: Can't Drain This is a master combat achievement which requires the player to kill The Maiden of Sugadinti without losing any prayer points.
method: Dodge the incoming attacks by moving your character before each attack to avoid blood splatters. Freeze or kill Blood spawns as quickly as possible. Flicking prayers can be used if done nearly perfectly to avoid losing any prayer points. Vengeance will help speed up the encounter, as many players will take high damage from Maiden's auto attacks which start with a max hit of 36. Avoid letting any Nylocas reach maiden, as each will raise her maximum hit by 3 or 4.

You will fail the achievement if you (or anyone on your team) stand in blood trails from her blood throw attack or from trails the blobs leave. This will fail the achievement even if you are at 0 prayer, making draining your prayer points before attempting this achievement not useful.

tasks.name: Can You Dance?
tasks.description: Kill Xarpus without anyone in the team using a ranged or magic weapon.
context: Can You Dance? is a master combat achievement requiring the player to kill Xarpus without anyone in the team using a ranged or magic weapon.

tasks.name: Morytania Only
tasks.description: Complete the Theatre of Blood without any member of the team equipping a non-barrows weapon (except Dawnbringer).
context: Morytania Only is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to complete a Theatre of Blood run using only Barrows brothers weapons, barring the Dawnbringer.
method: Players will be limited to Barrows weapons for their run. Non-barrows armour is permitted, though every room will be a significant struggle due to the slow speed and damage output of Barrows weapons. This achievement is possible in any team size, with 4-5 man being highly recommended. Lower team size completions are possible, but means a significant struggle.

Roles are fundamentally the same: Melee DPS, Range DPS, North Freeze and South Freeze, and each player performs the same actions as in regular runs while fighting The Maiden of Sugadinti and Nylocas Vasilias.

Meleers should opt for Guthan's Warspear with strongest melee gear available. Dharok's Greataxe with its respective full set results in higher damage output, however, it requires staying at lower HP thresholds. Rangers and magers are locked with Karil's crossbow and Ahrim's staff respectively.
One or two players should bring Serpentine helm to inflict poison to Nylocas Athanatos. An alternative poison method is casting Smoke spells, although this is highly inconsistent and less practical.

It is possible to bring runes for Surge spells and Vulnerability to considerably speed up the raid, which is only possible with Magic cape. All bosses in the raid are susceptible to Vulnerability's defence reduction, except for Sotetseg and Verzik Vitur.
Main differences with regular Theatre of Blood completions will be listed below.
For the most part this encounter is similar to regular runs. All players should melee except for the ranger, since ranged results in higher DPS compared to any other style.
When attacking Nylocas Matomenos, consider using Torag's hammers instead of the spear for more consistent damage output.
If the player decides to autocast Ice Barrage with Ahrim the Blighted's equipment with Amulet of the Damned, keep in mind that unequipping the staff cancels the autocast setting.
This encounter is almost identical as in regular runs. Make sure to play safe, as each death means less supplies, which will be more noticeable than usual runs during this challenge.

Meleers in this room should use Torag's hammers to deal with both small and large Nylocas Ischyros. Previous strategies involved using Avernic defender and punch/kick them, however, this is a slighly inferior method due to the better hit distribution the hammer's double hitsplats provide.
Rangers should exclusively focus on Nylocas Toxobolos, while magers should Ice barrage their respective Nylocas Hagios and any other Nylocas whenever possible.

Before entering the boss room, make sure each member has their respective corners, while having on each east/west side at least one Serpentine helm user. This will help later on when fighting Verzik Vitur in order to deal with their Nylocas summons. It's possible for just one single player to bring the helmet, although this will make their job harder and might put the completion at risk. Two players bringing the helmet is ideal.
All players should melee, although magers can choose to autocast Ancient magicks, as its damage heavily competes with other roles, potentially surpassing it.
Before proceding, each player should have 7 or 8 Super restore(4). Unlike regular runs, it's imperative all players have one Stamina potion(4).
It's possible to drop Karil's crossbow and Magic cape for additional supplies.

All players should melee. Magers with Magic cape can cast Wind Surge because of Xarpus 50% air elemental weakness (see: Mage (swap spellbook) below). This doesn't require moving back and forth and potentially missing attacks, and gives more breathing room for meleeing players while they're attacking and moving.
Rangers should avoid using Karil's crossbow, unless Xarpus surrounding tiles are completely covered in poison.
Once again all players should melee. Part 1: Torag's hammers is the strongest weapon for this achievement. Players without hammers should punch or kick instead.
Part 2: Magers can choose to either melee or cast spells from a distance, while all other players melee.

Part 3: At this point Verzik has 50% fire elemental weakness, making Fire Surge a strong spell to cast on her. Make sure all players are constantly using Thralls and if needed wait for yellow safespots before pushing below 20% HP to have easier time with the tornadoes.
If a player dies at any point while fighting Verzik, the achievement will not be awarded to the player that died.

Melee= Oathplate armour is the best option for completing this challenge. Dharok the Wretched's equipment offers better melee damage output than Oathplate armour, as long as player health stays lower than 62, although this adds considerable risk while fighting Verzik Vitur, where players must stay alive to succesfully finish the achievement. Bringing full Guthan the infested's equipment, despite granting large amounts of healing, results in poor damage output, thus slowing completion times by several minutes.

Karil's crossbow with Necklace of rupture to deal range damage against Nylocas Vasilias. Additional range switches are not necessary. Torag's hammers double hitsplat results in an exceptional weapon against Nylocas Ischyros and Verzik Vitur first form. Serpentine helm to deal with Nylocas Athanatos. Only one or two players need to bring it. Guthix rest(4) for tick eating. Rune pouch, with runes to cast Resurrection spells and a Book of the Dead. Optional: Locator orb or Dwarven rock cake to maintain low health with Dharok's equipment. Bring 1-2 additional Guthix rest for small healing to preserve low health in order to maximize damage, replacing Saradomin Brews.

|-| Range= Masori equipment offers best ranged DPS, assuming the player only brings few range switches. Elite Void Knight equipment offers higher dps even without defence reduction, but it requires having ranged items in multiple slots to reach this DPS potential, using valuable inventory space. Lastly, Karil the Tainted's equipment in conjunction of Amulet of the Damned offers the highest max hit possible, but it's inconsistent and with lower accuracy than Masori set, resulting in lower DPS overall. Additional switches for cape, hand, and ring slots are optional, however, bringing as many supplies as possible might be more beneficial than the additional damage and accuracy gained from filling them. Melee switches. Either bring Serpentine helm as a main helmet, or a better helmet if serpentines are covered. Optionally bring both. Armadyl brew(4) is a great source of healing without requiring to drink Super restore doses afterward. Use these during The Maiden of Sugadinti and the Nylocas Vasilias encounter, as ranged isn't needed later in the raid. Guthix rest(4) for tick eating. Rune pouch, with runes to cast Resurrection spells and a Book of the Dead.

|-| Mage= Ahrim the Blighted's equipment in conjunction of the Amulet of the Damned offers good damage output, together with the possibility of autocasting Ice barrage. On the other hand, both Ancestral robes and Virtus robes offer slightly higher DPS, but without the possibility of autocasting.

Karil's crossbow to deal range damage against Nylocas Vasilias. Additional range switches are not necessary. Melee switches. Either bring Serpentine helm as a main helmet, or a better helmet if serpentines are covered. Optionally bring both. Guthix rest(4) for tick eating. Rune pouch, with runes to cast Ice barrage and Blood barrage. Optional: Saturated heart.

|-| Mage (swap spellbook)= With the introduction and expansion of Elemental weakness, players can use Wind surge and Fire surge as a primary source of damage when fighting Xarpus (50% air weakness), and Verzik Vitur 2nd and 3rd form (50% fire weakness while on her final form). Considering mager's role is to freeze Nylocas Matomenos during Maiden's encounter, using surge spells is only possible by carrying a Magic cape, allowing to switch from one spellbook to another up to 5 times. This means the method can only be used limited amount of times per day. With Confliction gauntlets, Ahrim the Blighted's equipment set effect together with Amulet of the Damned offers best magic DPS when casting surge spells, while also allowing to autocast ancient magicks. The high accuracy provided from the gauntlets also makes Ice barrage autocasting compete with melee against Sotetseg. Standard spellbook allows the use of Vulnerability, which reduces target defence by 10% (or 15% with tome of water), shortening the raid duration by a reasonable amount. This is the only defence reduction method available during this combat achievement. It cannot be cast against Sotetseg and Verzik Vitur in any of her forms. Bringing Dust runes allows to cast this spell without wasting extra inventory space.

Karil's crossbow to deal range damage against Nylocas Vasilias. Additional range switches are not necessary. Torag's hammers double hitsplat results in an exceptional weapon against Nylocas Ischyros and Verzik Vitur first phase. This will also be the main melee weapon. Serpentine helm to deal with Nylocas Athanatos. Only one or two players need to bring it. Guthix rest(4) for tick eating. A single Divine super combat potion(4) for Bloat and Nylo room. Rune pouch and extra runes to cast Ice barrage, Blood barrage, Fire Surge, Wind surge, and Vulnerability. Optional: Players might consider swapping water runes for tome of water, which boosts Vulnerability defence reduction from 10% to 15%. Keep in mind this means Ice barrage will have to be cast while holding the tome.

method: The next best option behind a scythe is the soulreaper axe, followed by a noxious halberd, blade of Saeldor, Osmumten's fang, and abyssal tentacle. Otherwise, the challenge is simply a matter of finding a team with no scythe-users or players willing to complete the achievement with you.

tasks.name: Thermonuclear Veteran
tasks.description: Kill the Thermonuclear Smoke Devil 20 times.
context: Thermonuclear Veteran is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Thermonuclear Smoke Devil 20 times.

tasks.name: Hazard Prevention
tasks.description: Kill the Thermonuclear Smoke Devil without it hitting anyone.
context: Hazard Prevention is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Thermonuclear Smoke Devil without it hitting anyone.
method: The achievement can be completed by hitting the Thermonuclear Smoke Devil and walking under it to avoid damage, then hitting it again, immediately teleporting out and running back to the cave. Setting NPC attack options to right-click, or using the shift-click walk under feature on the Menu Entry Swapper RuneLite plugin, makes this easier.

This task can be easily achieved alongside Spec'd Out by teleporting to a player-owned house or Nardah and recharging special attack energy. If standing under the boss is too difficult, you can simply hit the boss once and immediately teleport after, but like above, the final attack must be registered while inside the room.

A less click-intensive method involves freezing the Thermonuclear Smoke Devil, preferably with Ice Barrage, and using a powered staff (e.g. the trident of the swamp) set to the Longrange attack style. Attack the Thermonuclear Smoke Devil four times from a distance. Before the effects of the freeze spell wear off, run out of the cave, re-enter and refreeze from max distance again, and attack four times.

If playing on RuneLite, it can be helpful to use the Radius Markers plugin by "Skretzo", setting an entry to have the NPC ID of 499 with a radius of 8 tiles (the boss's max range). Ice Barrage can be landed from 9 tiles, and powered staves set to Longrange are able to hit from 9 tiles as well.

Be aware that simply clicking the boss from 10/12/14/etc. tiles away will cause your character to run to a distance of 8 tiles away before attacking, due to the way run mechanics work (2 tiles per tick). So either make sure you're at exactly 9 tiles (just outside of the radius box) before attempting to freeze or use your powered stave on the boss. If you're struggling with this, you could also simply walk instead. Repeat until the Thermonuclear Smoke Devil dies. This approach requires a high magic level and damage-boosting gear.

With all strategies, hits that land on the player as they are teleporting out or leaving via the crevice do not invalidate the achievement, however they must be inside the room for the final hit or the task will not complete.

tasks.name: Spec'd Out
tasks.description: Kill the Thermonuclear Smoke Devil using only special attacks.
context: Spec'd Out is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Thermonuclear Smoke Devil using only special attacks.
method: Players can teleport out to recharge special attack energy (at a player-owned house's restoration pool or better, the Elidinis statuette in Nardah), and run back to the cave as many times as needed. The boss' health will not reset when you leave.
This achievement can be conveniently completed along with Hazard Prevention if the player walks under the Thermonuclear Smoke Devil after the first special attack and teleports out after the second.

Good weapons for this achievement include the Voidwaker, dragon claws, crystal halberds, and dragon daggers. The burning claws will disqualify the player as its burn effect is not considered special attack damage. Recoil from the ring of suffering and ring of recoil will also disqualify completion of the task.
Weapons that lower defence such as the Dragon Warhammer may be useful for speeding up the kill.

tasks.name: The Walk
tasks.description: Hit Vorkath 12 times during the acid special without getting hit by his rapid fire or the acid pools.
context: The Walk is a master combat achievement which requires the player to hit Vorkath 12 times during the acid special without getting hit by his rapid fire or the acid pools.
method: Completion of this achievement is calculated per acid phase, not per fight. As such, failing once does not prevent the player from attempting again during the same fight. Additionally, every attack counts towards the required 12; they do not need to deal damage.
There are two ways to complete the achievement; both require usage of the Woox Walk:

Stand as far from Vorkath as your weapon range allows (leaving 4 rows between the player character and Vorkath, 3 rows between the character and the exit). A ranged weapon with a two-tick attack speed such as the toxic blowpipe or throwing darts is mandatory for this to work. Keep count of Vorkath's attacks, prepare to act on the seventh attack. On the same tick as he launches the special attack, move backwards one tile diagonally. At this point, there are two possible causes of failure: the special attack may have been a freezing attack, or acid may have landed on the tiles used for Woox-walking. In either case, it is still possible to complete the achievement in the next acid phase. Immediately begin Woox-walking by alternating clicks on Vorkath and backwards on every tick. Players can use the sound of Vorkath's attacks to help maintain the correct rhythm, as they occur every tick. The achievement should be awarded just as the phase ends. With the Combat Achievements Tasks - Failure setting turned on, the player will receive a message for being struck by a fireball or for stepping on acid, but not for performing fewer than 12 attacks.
Players can use the following strategies:

Two dragon claws specials, which lands 8 hits, and thus needing 4 more hits from other weapons. Notably, you can combine this method with methods below (e.g. two dragon claw specials, and 2 hits with Dual macuahuitl). A scythe of Vitur for two hits, with two specials from dragon claws Usage of the dual macuahuitl, glacial temotli, earthbound tecpatl, or sulphur blades, though the player must have the weapon equipped before the acid attack starts.

tasks.name: Zombie Destroyer
tasks.description: Kill Vorkath's zombified spawn without using crumble undead.
context: Zombie Destroyer is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill Vorkath's zombified spawn without using crumble undead.
method: The easiest way to complete this step is to use Void Knight equipment, a salve amulet(ei) and a special attack of a dark bow with dragon arrows. Freezing spells will not work, and the delay between the spawn and the explosion is not long enough to get in multiple magic hits. Using a dark bow special attack will likely kill the spawn within just a few attempts. A Heavy ballista with dragon javelins is another good option. For ironmen, a Magic Shortbow (i) with rune or amethyst arrows is another option, as the Imbued version can spec twice before the spawn hits you.
If Vorkath is killed just as the spawn is launched, the freeze effect will wear off but the spawn will persist, allowing players to kite it if needed.

tasks.name: Dodging the Dragon
tasks.description: Kill Vorkath 5 times without taking any damage from his special attacks and without leaving his area.
context: Dodging the Dragon is a master combat achievement which requires the player to kill Vorkath 5 times without taking any damage from his special attacks and without leaving his area.
method: The player must avoid Vorkath's special attacks for 5 kills in a row; taking damage from his special attacks and getting hit by the Zombified Spawn (regardless of the amount of damage it deals) will reset the streak and fail the task.
It is recommended to count Vorkath's attacks so the player is prepared to react accordingly; every 7th attack will be a special attack.
Start walking right when the acid shoots up in the air. The tile you're standing on will always be coated in acid, and it hits faster than you'd think given the animation.

The easiest, most consistent method is to remain 4 tiles north of the entrance during the initial 6 attacks, and evade the 7th acid pool attack by immediately moving to a tile adjacent to the entrance. Continue moving back and forth along the few tiles adjacent to the entrance to avoid Vorkath's rapid fireballs. The key to this strategy is the short line of tiles adjacent to the entrance which will never be covered by acid pools if you are not standing on them when the attack happens, allowing you to consistently avoid them. Be sure to move onto the tiles during the 7th attack and not start on them.
This is harder than ranged. Technically you can use the same tiles as in the ranged method, but you sacrifice DPS staying away from the boss, and 5 kills may strain your supplies.

You can try to melee and woox walk during it, but the random acid pattern can be difficult to dodge. To give yourself the best odds, rotate your camera to be above your character and facing Vorkath directly, so you can see clearly where the acid droplets are going to land. When the attack begins, move one tile backwards diagonally, and then depending on where the acid looks to be falling, find a location that will be safe to either woox walk and keep attacking, or to walk around while waiting for the special attack to finish.
Ensure you don't eat as the Ice Dragonfire attack is cast as you may incur an eat delay on your attack, causing you to not have ample time to defeat the Undead Spawn.
Equip your staff of choice that has autocast Crumble Undead on, and kill the Undead Spawn. If it hits you and explodes, you will fail the task, even if it deals 0 damage.
Use your best gear with Saradomin brews and super restores instead of normal food.

tasks.name: Stick 'em With the Pointy End
tasks.description: Kill Vorkath using melee weapons only.
context: Stick 'em With the Pointy End is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill Vorkath using melee weapons only.
method: This achievement can be completed simultaneously along with The Fremennik Way.

This task can be easily completed using a melee-setup (can be done with any melee weapon). Do not equip a mage or ranged weapon to kill the undead spawn - just use the Crumble Undead spell on it without a magic weapon equipped. For more info see here.

It is worth using the spellbook filters to only show the combat spells and to have the Enable icon resizing option enabled; i.e. all the other spellbook options are disabled. The crumble undead spell icon will then be very large and this will prevent misclicks in the short time you have to attack the Zombified Spawn. Note if you are using a teleport spell to escape in case of problems you will want the teleport spells enabled as well which will add more icons to the spellbook display but should leave icons big.

tasks.name: Faithless Encounter
tasks.description: Kill Vorkath without losing any prayer points.
context: Faithless Encounter is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to kill Vorkath without losing any prayer points.
method: For players familiar with 1-tick prayer flicking, this achievement is straightforward. Otherwise, the player may simply not use prayers at all; the kill will be longer and more damage will be taken, but with high-end gear and high combat stats, this should not pose an issue. In this instance, be sure to use a shield that protects from dragonfire, as an antifire potion alone will still result in massive damage from Vorkath's dragonfire attacks, and it is not feasible to put prayer up to flick dragonfire attacks.

Resetting the kill until landing at least one defence-reducing special attack can significantly help in reducing the kill time, reducing the amount of damage that must be tanked. Wearing higher defence ranged gear such as Karil's or crystal will also help, if not flicking protection prayers.

tasks.name: The Fremennik Way
tasks.description: Kill Vorkath with only your fists.
context: The Fremennik Way is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to kill Vorkath without any weapons.
method: This achievement can be completed simultaneously along with Stick 'em With the Pointy End.

The player is allowed to use armour (including a defender or a shield) for this task, any attack style , and use the Crumble Undead spell on the zombified spawn (though it must be manually cast on the spawn - equipping a slayer staff or casting a spell on Vorkath himself will fail the achievement). Note: Recoil damage will fail the achievement. A ring of suffering (ri) may be used for its defensive and prayer bonuses, but its recoil effect must be toggled off. When not dodging fireballs you should face hug Vorkath for maximum DPS and tank his melee attacks. It is recommended to maximize crush accuracy, strength bonus and to have a blue dragon or zombie task for the slayer helmet bonus – due to the lowered attack bonuses, a slayer helmet with an amulet of rancour is much more effective than a Neitiznot faceguard with a salve amulet. Attack style should be set to accurate, unless a max hit is gained from using aggressive. , which has the same attack speed as an unarmed player.]] It is also highly recommended that you know how to perform the Woox Walk before trying to do this task, as it will shorten the kill time. With best-in-slot gear, the kill should take around 10 minutes.

Note, you may splash the Crumble Undead spell if your magic attack bonus is -64 or below, so it may be useful to bring a piece of magic armour (e.g. Ancestral robe top) when casting. Blood moon armour and tassets can also be used if you want to avoid bringing a switch, as it has relatively small magic attack penalties.

Your inventory should consist of 3-4 super combat potion, 14-16 Saradomin brews, 1 Extended super antifire potion, 1-2 anti-venom+, 6-8 super restores and a rune pouch containing the runes for Crumble Undead (air, earth, chaos). You may also want to bring law runes to escape or reset, either by using a divine rune pouch or replacing air and earth runes with dust runes.

tasks.name: Vorkath Speed-Chaser
tasks.description: Kill Vorkath in less than 1 minute and 15 seconds.
context: Vorkath Speed-Chaser is a master combat achievement which requires the player to kill Vorkath in less than 1 minute and 15 seconds.
method: For strategies on this achievement, see Vorkath Speed-Runner.

tasks.name: Vorkath Speed-Runner
tasks.description: Kill Vorkath in less than 54 seconds.
context: Vorkath Speed-Runner is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to kill Vorkath in less than 54 seconds.
method: Vorkath has 750 hitpoints, and this achievement is extremely notorious for the amount of damage needed in an exceedingly short amount of time. Avoid eating whenever possible; if absolutely necessary, use guthix rests or snowy knight mixes.
Thralls cannot be summoned within Vorkath's fight arena and Vorkath is also immune to all recoil damage, including Vengeance.

Vorkath has an attack speed of 5, or one attack every 3.0 seconds. A special attack is queued after six auto-attacks (18 seconds), of which he will either use Ice Dragonbreath or Rapid Fire. The former is generally recommended over the latter, since the special attack is quick to clear and allows players to resume dealing full damage to Vorkath. By the time the other special attack is queued, players will have a few seconds after it starts in order to meet the time. If the latter special attack starts, the player's damage will be reduced by 50% for the next ~15 or so seconds, and the time threshold is passed before the other special attack is used.

Like other challenging speed achievements, it can be highly beneficial to start the fight with a crossbow shot that activates the blood forfeit effect of enchanted ruby bolts, as it hits for 100 (or 110 with a Zaryte crossbow) damage, even if using melee. Start the fight with a crossbow shot, and if does not activate the effect, climb over the ice chunks and back to reset the fight. If the effect does activate, continue the fight as normal, switching to melee if using that style.
If Vorkath has more than 50% of its health by the time the first special attack starts, it is highly recommended to reset the fight.

When using ranged, a dragon hunter crossbow is recommended, with dragon thrownaxes as a special weapon swap. While a Zaryte crossbow can deal more damage due to its increased bolt proc effect and special attack, it is slightly less accurate and is not possible to Woox walk with it. Use both ruby and diamond dragon enchanted bolts, using ruby until Vorkath reaches ~300 hitpoints and swapping to diamond afterwards. It is not required to be on-task; the player will be slightly more accurate using a Salve amulet(ei) with best-in-slot compared to one with a slayer task. The advantage with ranged is that it has greater variability, especially if multiple ruby bolts proc early on.

Alternatively, due to the extreme variability of ruby bolt procs, it is also possible to complete the achievement passively over the course of hundreds of kills simply by killing the boss normally with a setup that uses a dragon hunter crossbow. A normal kill with a considerably lucky amount of bolt procs can complete the achievement entirely by chance, without the use of any particular speed strategies or items.

When using melee, a Dragon hunter lance is required, since it is the most accurate of all the stabbing weapons. For maximum damage output, a voidwaker or dragon claws should be used as the special, though the latter is more likely to miss given Vorkath's higher slash defence; if the player is on pace towards the time (less than 50% health after the first special attack), drink a surge potion and use a burning claws special attack. As with ranged weapons with 7 or less range, melee players can woox walk. Being on-task with melee provides slightly better accuracy compared to best-in-slot armour with a salve amulet.

A viable alternative melee strategy uses two special attacks from the Dragon Warhammer to start the fight, the upside being that its max hit is competitive with the likes of the Voidwaker whilst crucially also reducing Vorkath's defence. Two successful hits will reduce Vorkath's defence by 51%, enabling much more consistent damage from the Dragon hunter lance. This method is likely to require a lot of resetting as the Dragon Warhammer hits very infrequently, but if you can deal ~150 damage between the two attacks, your likelihood of getting Vorkath to 50% before the first special attack drastically increases. If using this strategy, it is preferable to see the Rapid Fire special first, as you are more likely to deal enough damage to Vorkath while woox walking that you can complete the fight before seeing the Ice Dragonbreath special, and thus achieving a <54 second kill.

tasks.name: Extended Encounter
tasks.description: Kill Vorkath 10 times without leaving his area.
context: Extended Encounter is a master combat achievement which requires the player to kill Vorkath 10 times without leaving his area.
method: Saradomin brews and super restore should fill the player's inventory instead of the typical solid food and prayer potions that would normally be brought, as Vorkath does not drop any unnoted food or potions to prolong trips.
If you're opting for a melee approach, here's a tried-and-tested strategy:

Wear a slayer helmet and be on Slayer task to kill blue dragons. Equip an amulet of blood fury, which provides a passive chance for life leech on melee attacks. Utilise the special attack of the Bandos godsword to reduce Vorkath's Defence. Equip a dragon hunter lance, a fire or infernal cape, a Bandos chestplate or Torva platebody, Bandos tassets or Torva platelegs, a dragon or avernic defender, barrows or ferocious gloves, primordial boots or avernic treads, and a Berserker ring (i) or ultor ring. For consumables, bring 3 super combat potions, 1 extended anti-venom+, 1 extended super antifire, 1 prayer regeneration potion, 7-8 super restores, 11-12 Saradomin brews, and optionally a sanfew serum. After each kill, prioritise drinking your brews, super restores, and super combat potions to replenish your stats. During the acid phase, employ the "Woox walk" technique and remember to deactivate Protect from Magic.

With this setup, assuming your combat stats are nearly maxed, you should have around 5 Saradomin brews and 1.5 Super Restore potions remaining after 10 kills, leaving plenty of room for error. Change your inventory as you deem necessary; individual performance will vary. To maximize inventory efficiency, you should bank at Lunar Isle to have direct transportation to Rellekka.

tasks.name: Leaving No One Behind
tasks.description: Subdue the Wintertodt without any of the Pyromancers falling.
context: Leaving No One Behind is a medium combat achievement which requires the player to subdue the Wintertodt without any of the pyromancers falling. It is only completed if at least 500 points are earned in the fight. This task can often be achieved passively by playing Wintertodt in the official Wintertodt worlds.
method: Actively attempting this task involves a lot of running, so it is recommended to wear weight-reducing clothing in slots not already filled with warm clothing. Stamina potions may be required if player has low Agility level. Prior to the round starting, collect several unfinished rejuvenation potions and harvest equal amount of bruma herbs from sprouting roots. Add herbs to unfinished potions and get ready for round to start by standing close to any of the four braziers. It might be helpful to choose either of the northern braziers, since there's often enough players at southern braziers keeping pyromancers healthy.

When the round starts light the closest brazier, chop bruma roots few times and add them to burning braziers. Run to all four pyromancers and use rejuvenation potions on them to heal them. Chop bruma roots again, add them to brazier and heal all pyromancers. Continue repeating that until the round ends making sure you finish with at least 500 points.

tasks.name: Cosy
tasks.description: Subdue the Wintertodt with four pieces of warm equipment equipped.
context: Cosy is an easy combat achievement which requires the player to subdue the Wintertodt with four pieces of warm equipment equipped.

tasks.name: Why Fletch?
tasks.description: Subdue the Wintertodt after earning 3000 or more points.
context: Why Fletch? is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to subdue the Wintertodt after earning 3000 or more points during the fight.
method: The player will need to attempt this in either a solo or small group scale setting, since the Wintertodt-designated worlds will always complete before the necessary points are acquired.

This will be a battle of attrition as the player will need to delay reducing Wintertodt's Energy levels to 0 for as long as possible to avoid completing the fight prematurely. In order to do so, the braziers will go largely under utilised, which will make Wintertodt a greater threat than it typically is.

Prior to beginning the fight, make 8-10 rejuvenation potions in the lobby. Each dose restores 30% Warmth, meaning each potion restores a total of 120%. This will be more than enough for both the player and the pyromancers.

As the achievement name implies, Fletching isn't a bad way to gain the 3000 points needed for this achievement. The safest way to fletch is either stand by a single brazier in order to keep it lit for its damage reduction, or to position the player at the borderline between the safe entrance and the arena. Note that you cannot fletch within the safe area as you will get the message stating the player's too cold and need to move closer to the braziers, but staying close to the safe area can be used as a means to take cover after the player's redemption is triggered to safely restore prayer and heal when needed before returning to the arena proper.

The player will need to fletch 120 logs into kindling in order to reach exactly 3000 points, but you can do a little less if choosing to keep Wintertodt's energy high throughout the fight, as the player will earn a significant amount of points just from relighting the braziers and healing the pyromancers.
As the player only has to get 3000 points, the achievement can be tackled in a smaller group setting if needed.

Aside from 4 items of warm clothing, other useful items include the regen bracelet and Hitpoints cape for their improved Warmth recovery rate which will be invaluable as a long term source of recovery. The player will also want to take as many items that increase Prayer bonus as possible for Rapid Heal.
