context: Chambers of Xeric: CM (Solo) Speed-Chaser is a master combat achievement which requires the player to complete a Chambers of Xeric: Challenge Mode (Solo) in under 45:00.
method: For strategies on this achievement, see Chambers of Xeric: CM (Solo) Speed-Runner.

tasks.name: Chambers of Xeric: CM (Solo) Speed-Runner
tasks.description: Complete a Chambers of Xeric: Challenge Mode (Solo) in less than 38 minutes and 30 seconds.
context: Chambers of Xeric: CM (Solo) Speed-Runner is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to complete a Chambers of Xeric: Challenge Mode (Solo) in under 38:30.
method: As with the normal mode variant of this achievement, the player must have extremely good gear in order to make the time required for this achievement.
While possible to obtain with no prep, this will require large amounts of purple sweets to consist of healing and run energy restore. It is possible to make the time with prep.

If you are on Arceuus, summon a thrall in every combat room and constantly use Death Charge. Tekton and Melee hand are only vulnerable to melee(zombie) thralls, Vasa and magic hand to magic(ghost) thralls, and head to ranged(skeleton) thralls. If you are on Lunars, Vengeance when you can.
Staying fully boosted through Overload and offensive prayers is vital in making time. Anytime you are attacking, post Tekton, be sure to be overloaded.

Overload boosts your stats every 15 seconds. Only brewing right before the 15 second intervals will ensure you are fully boosted throughout the raid. If you are in lethal range from unavoidable damage, such as the average muttadiles, and need to spam heal, try to restore back to full stats in time so you are fully boosted again on the interval. Combat potions dropped from Vanguards and the Twisted from Vasa can help boost stats back up when you are forced to heal.

Prepot a dose of divine super combat potion and start Tekton with two elder maul or dragon warhammer specials. Ideally, both should hit. Oathplate with a scythe will generally outperform Torva with Inquisitor's. Tekton should be defeated before the second cycle ends, if not, it may be beneficial to reset. Pick up an overload.
Crabs should be handled with care, as any mistake will set back time. If an orb is going to take a fair amount of time to despawn, run into it if nearby so a fresh orb is sent.

Killing scavenger beasts are optional, but one should be killed if needed for planks to create a chest. If prepping, light ~2 loads and scav. If not, the player should have enough time to get ~2.5 loads (70 kindling) before the ice demon thaws out. On the ice demon, use Demonbane weapons, Dark Demonbane, or Fire spells and Magic cape to afterwards swap to Lunars or Arceuus (runes required for Arceuus spells also allow you to cast Fire Wave without any extra slots on runes). Having higher Woodcutting levels will reduce the time needed to "pop" the demon out.
Stick near the edges. Letting a shaman jump will set the time back a few seconds if you are not attacking the other one.

If prepping, pick up the buchu seeds dropped by the shamans and grow them in the next room. Try to keep prep as minimal and as efficient as possible. Clean herbs in-between picking them, always be making potions when you are moving.
Kill the Vanguards quickly. It is not worth it to chance resets for the purpose of making this time.

Loot cavern grubs from the chests in a manner that minimizes time waste. Dump grubs upon reaching 10-20 grubs to ensure it is always eating, depending on thieving level. Having higher Thieving levels will increase the rate of grubs per chest, resulting in an overall speed up.
Use the Redemption method on Vespula. If the player dies, reset the raid, as the abyssal portal will likely be healed back to full from the freshly hatched vespine soldiers.
Players can clear tightrope room as normal or use the skip method. If skipping, phoenix necklace(s) are required to survive.
Kirby skip, utilizing a single phoenix necklace:
Skipping is not required to make time, but would significantly help, consistently shaving off at least a minute through the room time alone, and resulting in less prep needed.

Move to the safe tile that you drag from when fighting Vespula with redemption. Turn on Rapid Heal and click the passage, do not miss or stall any ticks getting to the tightrope. On the way there: Get as close to 1 hp as possible, a locator orb or purple sweets combined with an overload can achieve this. If you are 1 or 3 hp, switch to low defence armour such as mage robes, Inquisitor's armour, or no armour. If you are 2 hp, switch to your armour with the highest tank stats. Turn on redemption. Cross rope. Rapid heal will tick heal the first wave of attacks and proc redemption. When you can move, click next to the crystal. Optionally, to slightly improve success rate: if you started at 2hp, eat a sweet on this tick if you started at 3hp, use a brew instead Click crystal, wait a tick to finish grabbing it. Click to tile next to rope (or rope itself), equip phoenix necklace and eat the lowest healing food you have access to, typically a purple sweet or a brew. The food will tick eat the first wave of attacks, proccing the phoenix necklace to null the rest. Click rope. Clear barrier, leave room. If you wish to incorporate, practice by clearing the first two floors with minimal gear and lots of phoenix necklaces. You can pick up multiple keystone crystals in a single raid, don't dissolve the barrier when practicing. Success is indicated by not dying immediately (and being able to move for a few ticks) when you cross back.
Grab a Zamorak godsword and the pickaxe brought into the raid.
Kill guardians with the step-back method to avoid damage from rockfalls. Having higher Mining levels will increase your max hit, reducing the time needed to kill them.
If the player is on Lunars, heal to full and cast Vengeance. Otherwise, health will not be a concern when entering the next room.

Fight Vasa Nistirio as normal. Set the Inquisitor's mace/Voidwaker to stab and destroy the glowing crystals as they appear. Players should be able to attack Vasa 3-5 times with the twisted bow on rapid before needing to attack the crystal. Pick up Vasa's two brews before leaving the room.
Try to have one Skeletal Mystic attack at a time and force them into using melee to help conserve supplies.

Muttadiles can be a do-or-die situation depending on the player's overall luck. Kill the small muttadile with magic by the entrance and freeze it with the Zamorak godsword when it nears the 55% health threshold. Swap back to magic after it is bound and kill it as quickly as possible before it heals off the meat tree. For the large muttadile, use the safespot in normal mode and try to freeze it when it reaches 55% health. If the special misses, simply finish it off with ranged, as the twisted bow generally keeps up with the healing provided from the meat tree, though the room will be delayed as a result. Dying here is a significantly worse time sink than during Olm's first two phases. Large Muttadile's range attacks can hit in the high 30's through prayer.

Try to clear the first three phases within 2 minutes and 30 seconds or less. This will be dependent on if the elder maul/dragon warhammer lands, but a Lightbearer will be enough to restore special attack energy back to full if they miss. An ideal Olm kill should take around 9 minutes or less. If supplies are low, dying directly after either of the first two phases ends will result in minimal or no time loss and will allow you to bank.

tasks.name: Together We'll Fall
tasks.description: Kill the Vanguards within 10 seconds of the first one dying.
context: Together We'll Fall is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill all three Vanguards within ten seconds of killing the first one.
method: For solo-run attempts, be sure raid scaling is set to "0" for the easiest fight, as scaling a raid to "1" doubles boss health.

After the Vanguards are at critically low health and perform a shuffle, dump high-damaging attacks on them as the health threshold will no longer exist to force a heal. This task is best completed in group encounters. If attempting in a solo encounter, it is recommended to kill the melee, magic and then ranged Vanguard in that order. One effective tactic is to kill the magic vanguard and then use the Voidwaker special attacks to quickly dispose of the remaining two.

tasks.name: No Time for Death
tasks.description: Clear the Tightrope room without Killing any Deathly Mages or Deathly Rangers.
context: No Time for Death is a master combat achievement which requires the player to clear the tightrope room without killing any of the deathly mages or rangers.
method: Players will need to cross the tightrope, pick up the keystone crystal, return across the tightrope, and interact with the magic barrier to dispel it. The mages and rangers are unaggressive at first, but immediately attack anyone crossing the tightrope, resulting in a large stack of damage being applied at once. Dying does not fail the achievement; if a player dies with the keystone in their inventory, it drops to the floor where they died.
In groups, the mages and rangers should be distracted by other players to prevent them from attacking the crosser.

In solo encounters, it is recommended to maximise ranged defence and use Protect from Magic to minimise damage taken. Even though the deathly rangers have a higher max hit than the mages, they are far less accurate when wearing Torag's or Justiciar armour compared to the mages with Karil's or fortified Masori armour.

Using an anglerfish or a phoenix necklace can help survive the stack of damage when crossing. The achievement can be easily completed over multiple runs by moving the crystal as far as possible before dying, then returning and picking it up from the ground, repeating as necessary. Telekinetic Grab can also be used once the crystal is on the ground to safely reacquire it without crossing the rope again.

tasks.name: Putting It Olm on the Line
tasks.description: Complete a Chambers of Xeric solo raid with more than 40,000 points.
context: Putting It Olm on the Line is a master combat achievement which requires the player to complete a solo Chambers of Xeric raid with 40,000 or more points.
Challenge Mode cannot be used for this task.
method: The easiest way to get this achievement is to select a "Full" layout for all rooms. Otherwise, in order to get the minimum points needed for the achievement, the player will need to toggle large raids on as it ensures the first two floors are filled to the brim with four combat/puzzle rooms. As the points can be slow to obtain, players should take their time and prepare early to gain more points. Large raids can also cause duplicate puzzle rooms to appear on each floor.
If using a large layout, avoid the following rooms:
Tekton, shamans, Jewelled Crabs - these rooms provide ~1,600 points.
Look for the following rooms:

Vasa Nistirio - focus on the glowing crystals more than the boss, as they provide plenty of points. A good strategy is to reach the point cap on the glowing crystals then finish off the boss before leaving the room. Tightrope - each tightrope room provides ~4,000 points on average; double tightropes basically knock out 20% of the required total. Ice demon - gather 6 piles of kindling then light each brazier and double lighting two. This will yield ~6000 points before combat. A 7th pile will yield 50% points ~600. Thieving - Gather 39 grubs to hit the point cap, yielding ~4750 points. Bats will yield an extra 300 points. Guardian (Chambers of Xeric) - Keeping one guardian alive and having them shove you away from the door gives 40 points. This can be done indefinitely until you reach a comfortable point cap if you do not feel comfortable doing this task without dying. This strategy can be done as long as the guardians are not the first room in the raid.

Players without 90+ Herblore may also want to have a layout that contains an Overload (+) dropping boss, of which Tekton, Vasa, the Muttadiles and Vanguards drop. Ideally one of the latter two should be selected for this as they provide slightly more points.

Potions give full points for 5 doses then half points for the next 5. If possible drink only Overload (+) potions before entering Great Olm. It should be possible to drink 3-4 doses granting 450-600 points.

The Great Olm will provide roughly 18,500 points and thus it is recommended players ensure that the first two floors will give them at least 22,000 points. Deaths after getting over 5,000 points will likely prevent the player from completing the achievement, although the raid should be completed anyways for the potential rewards. As a result, it is important not to die, which will also unlock the Undying Raider and Undying Raid Team if not completed.

tasks.name: A Not So Special Lizard
tasks.description: Kill the Great Olm in a solo raid without letting him use any of the following special attacks in his second to last phase: Crystal Burst, Lightning Walls, Teleportation Portals or left-hand autohealing.
context: A Not So Special Lizard is a master combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Great Olm in a solo raid without letting him use any of the following special attacks in his second-to-last phase: Crystal Burst, Lightning Walls, Teleportation Portals or left-hand autohealing.

tasks.name: Mutta-diet
tasks.description: Kill the Muttadile without letting her or her baby recover hitpoints from the meat tree.
context: Mutta-diet is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill the muttadiles without letting them heal from the meat tree.
method: For solo-run attempts, be sure raid scaling is set to "0" for the easiest fight, as scaling a raid to "1" doubles boss health.

It is possible to complete the achievement without cutting the tree. By using ice spells, or a Zamorak godsword the muttadiles can be frozen when they reach 50% hp. This stops them from reaching the tree if they can be killed quickly.

If chopping the tree instead, pray accordingly to the smaller muttadile's attacks as it will navigate around the tree to melee the player. Ensure the tree is completely chopped before the small muttadile reaches 50% hp.

tasks.name: Redemption Enthusiast
tasks.description: Kill the Abyssal Portal without forcing Vespula to land.
context: Redemption Enthusiast is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to destroy the Abyssal portal without letting Vespula land.
method: Despite the name, redemption is not required to complete the achievement.

By attacking the portal, Vespula will fly into an enraged state and rapidly jab everyone next to her for heavy melee damage. Players underneath her will be spared from this attack, but she will apply rapid stomp damage dealing up to 8 damage per tick until they leave. By using Redemption with level 90 Hitpoints or higher, the player can use Redemption to restore health instead of using actual food. Using Redemption will drain all of the player's prayer points when they fall below 10% of their maximum Hitpoints level (9 or lower at level 90). To restore prayer, either drink prayer restoration potions or drink a dose of Prayer enhance (+). The latter has to be made with 78+ Herblore or be obtained as a drop from the magic vanguard, Tekton, or the Muttadiles. Set quick prayers to Redemption and magic/ranged boosting prayers depending on the combat style being used.

Attack the portal once and then run out of Vespula's melee range. The portal is 8 tiles away from the movable area and will require the use of the long range setting for crossbows and powered staves. The player should be out of Vespula's range after Redemption activates, upon which they restore prayer points, activate quick prayers and run back in, repeating until the portal is destroyed. If Redemption is not being used, it is important to heal up upon reaching <30 health, although this is only done when the player has made potions beforehand.
For solo-run attempts, be sure raid scaling is set to "0" for the easiest fight, as scaling a raid to "1" doubles boss health.

tasks.name: Stop Drop and Roll
tasks.description: Kill Vasa Nistirio before he performs his teleport attack for the second time.
context: Stop Drop and Roll is a master combat achievement which requires the player to kill Vasa Nistirio before he performs his teleport attack for the second time.
method: For solo-run attempts, be sure raid scaling is set to "0" for the easiest fight, as scaling a raid to "1" doubles boss health.

Successful dragon warhammer or Bandos godsword hits will help increase the player's accuracy against Vasa. Use powerful ranged weapons to take him down as quickly as possible - either a twisted bow with dragon or amethyst arrows, a crystal armour set with the bow of Faerdhinen or a toxic blowpipe with dragon darts.

A strong stab weapon is also encouraged to deal with the glowing crystals quickly, as not disabling them fast enough will cause Vasa to perform his teleport attack. Vengeance at high health can be used against the teleport attack to rebound massive amounts of damage back onto him.

tasks.name: Anvil No More
tasks.description: Kill Tekton before he returns to his anvil for a second time after the fight begins.
context: Anvil No More is a master combat achievement which requires the player to kill Tekton before he is able to use the anvil a second time.
method: Defence-draining weapons such as the bandos godsword or dragon warhammer are recommended for this achievement due to their accuracy and ability to hit high. Tekton will automatically return to the anvil if no one is in range when he scans or after attacking for a while, restoring some of his health and drained stats in the process. Try to avoid forcing Tekton returning to the anvil as it will reduce the amount of hits the team can land.

Tekton is weakest to crush attacks so using an elder maul, or inquisitor mace is recommended, with a zamorakian hasta/dragon hunter lance as last-ditch alternatives. Inquisitor's armour helps complement the crush-based style with accuracy and damage bonuses, which should help deal plenty of damage to Tekton if he has been successfully debuffed.
For solo-run attempts, be sure raid scaling is set to "0" for the easiest fight, as scaling a raid to "1" doubles boss health.

tasks.name: Dancing with Statues
tasks.description: Receive kill-credit for a Stone Guardian without taking damage from falling rocks.
context: Dancing with Statues is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to receive kill credit for one of the stone guardians without taking damage from their falling rocks attack.
Use a flinch method to reduce the chances of the guardians attacking. The falling rock attack has a 3x3 AoE centered on the tile it would fall on, so run two spaces away to avoid getting hit.
While regular accounts only need to do more than 50% of the damage to receive kill credit, Ironmen accounts need to do 100% of the damage for the achievement to count.

tasks.name: Undying Raid Team
tasks.description: Complete a Chambers of Xeric raid without anyone dying.
context: Undying Raid Team is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to complete a Chambers of Xeric raid without anyone dying.

tasks.name: Undying Raider
tasks.description: Complete a Chambers of Xeric solo raid without dying.
context: Undying Raider is a master combat achievement which requires the player to complete a Chambers of Xeric solo raid without dying.
This task will also complete Undying Raid Team.

tasks.name: Shayzien Specialist
tasks.description: Receive kill-credit for a Lizardman Shaman without taking damage from any shamans in the room.
context: Shayzien Specialist is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to receive kill-credit for a lizardman shaman without taking any damage from them. Poison damage does not fail the task.
method: Only one shaman needs to be killed to complete the achievement.

The simplest strategy is to use Ranged with Protect from Missiles, staying out of melee range while running around to avoid their attacks. Players should run from their previous position whenever a shaman jumps (move at least 2 tiles), shoots a green poison blob (move at least 3-4 tiles), and whenever the shamans' purple spawns get near. Bring a superantipoison and a stamina potion. This can be made easier in a solo by waiting until one of the two shamans is on the farthest side of the room as it may not aggro onto the player for a while, allowing the other one to be killed on its own.

Alternatively, safespots can be used to kill the shamans without them being able to retaliate back. However, they will often need to be engaged first and one of the three potential layouts has very poor safespotting that will likely result in both shamans aggro'ing a player in the process. Manipulate the shamans into performing their jump attack (3x3 AoE centred on the target at the time of the mechanic) at the designated area; once the shaman has been lured, use a weapon with a range of 10 to kill them off.

As the raid does not need to be completed, the player can choose to reload the raid until Shamans appear as the first room and use a full set of Shayzien armour while praying Protect from Missiles in order to trivialize this combat achievement.

tasks.name: Playing with Lasers
tasks.description: Clear the Crystal Crabs room without wasting an orb after the first crystal has been activated.
context: Playing with Lasers is a master combat achievement which requires the player to clear the Crystal Crabs without wasting a single orb after activating the first crystal.
This task is best completed in a group as solo encounters require the player to bind the crabs in place repeatedly with a hammer and the layout of the room may be unfeasible for completing it.

tasks.name: Cryo No More
tasks.description: Receive kill-credit for the Ice Demon without taking any damage.
context: Cryo No More is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to receive kill-credit for the Ice Demon without taking any damage.
Iron players must kill the Ice Demon solo to be eligible. For solo-run attempts, be sure raid scaling is set to "0" for the easiest fight, as scaling a raid to "1" doubles boss health.

tasks.name: Perfect Olm (Solo)
tasks.description: Kill the Great Olm in a solo raid without taking damage from any of the following: Teleport portals, Fire Walls, Healing pools, Crystal Bombs, Crystal Burst or Prayer Orbs. You also cannot let his claws regenerate or take damage from the same acid pool back to back.
context: Perfect Olm (Solo) is a master combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Great Olm without taking damage from his crystal burst, teleport, fire wall, healing pool, crystal bomb and prayer orb attacks. The player must also not let his hands regenerate during phase 3 and not take consecutive damage from the same acid pool.
method: Olm starts off each phase beginning with two auto-attacks before performing its first special attack, Crystal Burst. The most dangerous threat for this achievement are the fire walls and teleport portals; if the player is on the Arceuus spellbook, they won't have any ideal means of dispelling the fire walls apart from carrying a water source (e.g watering cans) on them. Teleport portals can also have a range of 10 tiles from the player, which when focused on Olm may make them hard to spot in time.

In order to successfully pull off the achievement, the player must utilise the safespots as shown by the picture to the right. These spots will always force the head to turn accordingly based on its location:

Spots 1 and 8 always force the head to turn right. Spots 4 and 5 always force the head to turn left. When running from spot 4, running to spot 2 will ensure the head turns right as long as the right hand has been damaged. If the right hand is not damaged, it will turn to the middle. Due to this, the player can then run from spot 2 to spot 3 to land an additional attack and force Olm's head to the middle after it turns right. The same also applies when running from spot 5 to 7. Running from spot 1 to spot 3 forces the head to turn to the middle. The same also applies when running from spot 8 to 6.
When Olm is forced to turn his head around to find the player, he will skip an attack in the process. However this shouldn't be much of an issue with a smooth run.

A proper 4:1 (with a 4-tick weapon) or 3:1 (with a 5-tick weapon) should avoid all attacks outside of the flame walls and acid pools for the melee hand. The magic hand can still be dealt with using normal methods. Crystal bombs should not be an issue unless one is within proximity of the running tiles. If the player wants to take no chances, the much slower 1:0 method (with any weapon) may be used, as this guarantees Olm will never be able to attack the player.

During phase 4, the teleport attack and crystal bombs are no longer used, but the flame wall and acid pools will still persist. A player can still safely attack Olm with ranged using a crossbow or twisted bow without fear of retaliation by the head. The falling crystals during this phase will not disqualify players from the achievement, though they can prove to be a problem if low on supplies.
Dying to Olm will not disqualify players from the task, as long as they died to a standard attack.

tasks.name: Perfect Olm (Trio)
tasks.description: Kill the Great Olm in a trio raid without any team member taking damage from any of the following: Teleport portals, Fire Walls, Healing pools, Crystal Bombs, Crystal Burst or Prayer Orbs. You also cannot let his claws regenerate or take damage from the same acid pool back to back.
context: Perfect Olm (Trio) is a master combat achievement which requires the team to kill the Great Olm without taking damage from his crystal burst, teleport, fire wall, healing pool, crystal bomb, and prayer orb attacks. The player must also not let his hands regenerate during phase 3 and not take consecutive damage from the same acid pool.
Duo Group Ironmen are not required to do this task, as they would lose prestige status. They also will not gain combat achievement points for completing this.
To do this in a solo raid, set scaling to 2. In a duo, set it to 1.
method: Solo: Follow the Perfect solo Olm strategy. As the task only requires Olm to be killed this way in a trio raid, one or two players can still handle the task, although extra time is likely to be needed due to the scaled stats.
Since the task doesn't disqualify players who die to Olm's standard attacks, players can suicide supplies if necessary.
Trio: If you want to do it as an actual trio, keep the following in mind:
- Lightning special attack hitting you does not fail the achievement. Still avoid it whenever you can since you might get stuck in a poison pool or flame wall.
- The every-other-tick falling crystal attack that can occur during crystal phase does not fail the achievement if it hits you. Tank the hits in order to ensure you do portal special successfully.

- Poison trails are the most likely thing to fail the achievement. Whenever Olm looks at you during acid phase and head phase, start walking and do not attack until he turns away. If you get the acid trail on you, just keep walking until it is gone.
- In order to minimise specials during phase 3, it is beneficial to directly set the head as you normally would during phase 1 and 2, and have the runner hybrid down the melee hand.

Hail Mary: If you do happen to get the portal special and acid trails at the same time, have the person with an acid trail walk from one side of the room to the other (ctrl-click). The other person can get a few tiles ahead and try to ctrl-click in the same direction at the proper tick. If you take poison damage, turn on run for one tick and then turn it off again.

tasks.name: Blind Spot
tasks.description: Kill Tekton without taking any damage.
context: Blind Spot is a master combat achievement which requires the player to kill Tekton without taking any damage.
method: You do not need to receive kill credit for Tekton in order to complete this achievement. So it is easiest to get a partner to tank him and do most of the damage while you land one damaging hit. In order to speed up the kill you can have the partner stand on the opposite side of Tekton and hit him only right after he swings at your partner then walk away like you would at guardians.

Lure Tekton to the centre of the arena, away from any pillars of smoke, as these have erratic hitboxes and can deal 1-3 damage when standing on them, disqualifying them from the achievement. Use one of the flinching or running methods to avoid Tekton's standard attacks. Be careful of the fireballs launched during his repair state as they have a 3x3 AoE; while they should generally hit together, they may occasionally desync and hit on different ticks due to travel distance.

Unlike other cox combat achievements, you need to be in the room at the end of the fight to complete the achievement. Entering through Tekton's fire will fail the achievement, meaning the player must be present the whole fight.
For solo-run attempts, be sure raid scaling is set to "0" for the easiest fight, as scaling a raid to "1" doubles boss health.

tasks.name: Blizzard Dodger
tasks.description: Receive kill-credit for the Ice Demon without activating the Protect from Range prayer.
context: Blizzard Dodger is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to receive kill-credit for the Ice Demon without activating the Protect from Range prayer.
method: For solo-run attempts, be sure raid scaling is set to "0" for the easiest fight, as scaling a raid to "1" doubles boss health.

By having another player use protect from range and dodge the demon's attacks in the centre of the room, additional players can stand on the north/eastern walls and avoid the demon's aggression completely. Using Fire Surge will help secure kill-credit over players using ranged.
Ironmen must be the only player damaging the Ice Demon to complete this combat achievement.

tasks.name: Kill It with Fire
tasks.description: Finish off the Ice Demon with a fire spell.
context: Kill It with Fire is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to finish the ice demon off with a fire spell.
For solo-run attempts, be sure raid scaling is set to "0" for the easiest fight, as scaling a raid to "1" doubles boss health.

tasks.name: Chambers of Xeric (Solo) Speed-Chaser
tasks.description: Complete a Chambers of Xeric (Solo) in less than 21 minutes.
context: Chambers of Xeric (Solo) Speed-Chaser is a master combat achievement which requires the player to complete a Chambers of Xeric solo run within 21 minutes.
method: Look for a raid with extremely easy and simple rooms, if possible, try to align this with the grandmaster variant. There is a 4 minute gap between this and the grandmaster variant, though taking either master or grandmaster variants are acceptable for this achievement.
Ideal layouts for a raid can include:
Vasa, Vespula, Tekton, Tightrope, Crabs Vasa, Vespula, Tekton, Crabs, Guardians Vanguards, Tekton, Vespula, Tightrope, Crabs

Vasa is a very fast room when a twisted bow is used alongside a dragon warhammer, assuming that the hammer does land at least once in the fight. Vespula can be easily taken out by using either the twisted bow or a Tumeken's shadow. Tekton can be easily dealt with using Osmumten's fang if no Scythe of Vitur or Inquisitor's mace is available. Tightrope can be skipped if needed and crabs are fairly straightforward to do, assuming the ideal layout. This will result in 4 brews, 2 restores, prayer enhances and overloads, which is more than enough for an experienced player at Olm.

Vanguards are only put on the list as it is possible to clear them fast with good gear. Vanguards can provide 3-6 brews, 0-3 restores and 1 overload, which is even more supplies, but they do take longer to kill compared to the other rooms.

Muttadiles can provide a full set of one brew, restore, prayer enhance and overload, however, due to the high variance in each fight this room can consume a lot of supplies if unlucky and thus discouraged from attempting this room for the sake of time.

tasks.name: Chambers of Xeric (Solo) Speed-Runner
tasks.description: Complete a Chambers of Xeric (Solo) in less than 17 minutes.
context: Chambers of Xeric (Solo) Speed-Runner is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to complete a solo Chambers of Xeric run in under 17 minutes.
method: Pick a raid with very fast to clear rooms while minimising supply usage, as the player is expected to no-prep Olm.

Layouts with fast rooms, at least 1 overload and some supplies are ideal. 3 combats and 2 puzzles is the smallest possible layout, Tightrope and crabs are the fastest puzzle rooms allowing 3 combat rooms for the other supplies. Commonly wanted combat rooms are: Vasa (2 Xeric's aid+ and an Overload+) and Vespula (2 Xeric's aid+, Revitalisation+, Prayer enhance+ and an Overload+). Tekton and Muttadile (Need to freeze both muttadiles) can still be used but are usually slower and are substituted for Shamans since the changes that allows Vasa and Vespula to drop overloads.

A (Vasa, Tekton, Vespula, Tightrope, Crabs) layout will provide the player with four brews, two restores, prayer enhances and overload, which should be more than enough for the player to use at Olm. A (Vasa, Shamans, Vespula, Tightrope, Crabs) is a slightly faster layout but results in 1 less restore. Make sure to make the most of your inventory to fit all the supplies, since it is more important to finish the raid than trying to organise in the chest. Tightrope skipping is highly encouraged to save additional time, as it significantly cuts the room's completion time and uses minimal supplies. Tightrope can be substituted for guardians if possible, which saves some supplies but will result in a slightly slower room.

The player should initiate the fight with Olm before 7 minutes as the half of the time needed completing this achievement will come from fighting Olm. Using thralls are highly recommended to deal additional damage.

Raid layouts that start with Vasa the player can start with the vengeance spell active. Someone else can use vengeance other on you inside or outside the raid (ironman can use the magic skillcape to cast vengeance on themselves and swap back to the Arceuus spellbook afterwards). When combining this with pre-eating an anglerfish and a phoenix necklace causes Vasa to take 115 damage immediately and the player will have 32 health so it's not in danger of getting trampled on if Vasa moves in their direction. Swap back to the Necklace of anguish afterwards.

Tightrope skipping is a method where the player completely ignores the deathly rangers and deathly mages. This is commonly done by prayer protect from missiles and augury and bringing 2 phoenix necklaces, one for the crossing towards the keystone crystal and one for the return crossing. The phoenix necklaces will nullify all incoming damage, but make sure to equip the phoenix necklace and cross the rope in the same tick for the return (otherwise your phoenix necklace will proc before you start crossing the tightrope). This method has a very low chance of failure when the player is 24 health or above and becomes increasingly unreliable if the player is below that threshold.
These methods are not required to get the grandmaster time but can massively help you in getting fast times into Olm, compensating for the lack of gear/skill.

tasks.name: Chambers of Xeric (5-Scale) Speed-Chaser
tasks.description: Complete a Chambers of Xeric (5-scale) in less than 15 minutes.
context: Chambers of Xeric (5-Scale) Speed-Chaser is a master combat achievement which requires the player to complete a Chambers of Xeric (5-scale) in under 15:00.
Like other tasks requiring a specific number of players, this combat achievement is not required for Group Ironmen with a smaller group size.

tasks.name: Chambers of Xeric (5-Scale) Speed-Runner
tasks.description: Complete a Chambers of Xeric (5-scale) in less than 12 minutes and 30 seconds.
context: Chambers of Xeric (5-Scale) Speed-Runner is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to complete a Chambers of Xeric (5-scale) in under 12:30.
Like other tasks requiring a specific number of players, this combat achievement is not required for Group Ironmen with a smaller group size.

tasks.name: Chambers of Xeric (Trio) Speed-Chaser
tasks.description: Complete a Chambers of Xeric (Trio) in less than 16 minutes and 30 seconds.
context: Chambers of Xeric (Trio) Speed-Chaser is a master combat achievement which requires the player to complete a trio-scaled Chambers of Xeric in under 16:30.

tasks.name: Chambers of Xeric (Trio) Speed-Runner
tasks.description: Complete a Chambers of Xeric (Trio) in less than 14 minutes and 30 seconds.
context: Chambers of Xeric (Trio) Speed-Runner is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to complete a Chambers of Xeric (Trio) in under 14:30.

Any raid layout with enough overload is doable by no-prepping, minimizing tick loss, staying overloaded, and using offensive prayers. Two overloads can be enough with a maximum of one iron: Everyone sips the first overload. One player, the iron if there is one, should pick up a Twisted(+) from Vanguards or Vasa for Olm head. Everyone sips the second overload. The players without Twisted(+) split the remaining two sips of overload. You can easily make time with layouts that include more overload.

tasks.name: Zalcano Veteran
tasks.description: Kill Zalcano 25 times.
context: Zalcano Veteran is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill Zalcano 25 times.

tasks.name: Perfect Zalcano
tasks.description: Kill Zalcano 5 times in a row without leaving or getting hit by the following: Falling rocks, rock explosions, Zalcano powering up, or standing in a red symbol.
context: Perfect Zalcano is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill Zalcano 5 times in a row without leaving or getting hit by the following: Falling rocks, rock explosions, Zalcano powering up, or standing in a red symbol.
method: The easiest way to obtain this achievement is in large teams, to minimise the amount of dangerous attacks Zalcano may spawn. When running across the room, the player should be ready to dodge red symbols if Zalcano spawns them, although the task is only failed if the player takes damage, and the red symbols do not damage players for three ticks after spawning.

Taking damage from Zalcano's unavoidable pebbles or from standing under her while she has fallen doesn't fail the task, and the streak is not lost if a player stays in the room but does not receive kill credit. It is not required to meet the threshold for a unique drop (indicated by receiving two crystal shards) for a kill to count towards the streak.

tasks.name: Team Player
tasks.description: Receive imbued tephra from a golem.
context: Team Player is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to receive imbued tephra from a golem.
method: The easiest way to obtain this achievement is to kill Zalcano solo, not using any imbued tephra on Zalcano but instead waiting for the golem to spawn and using your imbued tephra on the golem.

The most reliable way to complete this achievement is to attack golems when standing on a blue circle, in order to maximise damage. If there are no blue circles when the golem spawns, try to attack it as soon as possible, so that it's possible to fire multiple tephra at it. Without the blue circle damage boost, it will likely take several tephra to kill a golem.

tasks.name: The Spurned Hero
tasks.description: Kill Zalcano as the player who has dealt the most damage to her.
context: The Spurned Hero is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill Zalcano as the player who has dealt the most damage to her.

The achievement checks for the amount of mining damage dealt to Zalcano after breaking her stone armour, rather than checking whether the player is the MVP for that kill (i.e. the one who receives the infernal ashes upon defeating her).

tasks.name: K'ril Tsutsaroth Adept
tasks.description: Kill K'ril Tsutsaroth 50 times.
context: K'ril Tsutsaroth Adept is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to kill K'ril Tsutsaroth 50 times.

tasks.name: K'ril Tsutsaroth Veteran
tasks.description: Kill K'ril Tsutsaroth 100 times.
context: K'ril Tsutsaroth Veteran is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill K'ril Tsutsaroth 100 times.

tasks.name: Yarr No More
tasks.description: Receive kill-credit for K'ril Tsutsaroth without him using his special attack.
context: Yarr No More is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to receive kill-credit for K'ril Tsutsaroth without him using his special attack.
method: The easiest way to complete the combat achievement is to use the Scorching bow, as its special attack always freezes K'ril in place. With sufficient damage, K'ril can be killed without him being able to attack the player at all, guaranteeing the combat achievement. Alternatively, players can use a kiting method to stay out of melee range.

K'ril only uses his special attack against players using Protect from Melee. Therefore, a good strategy that uses melee only is to instead use Protect from Magic along with strong melee armour; a super combat potion and Emberlight or Arclight are also recommended.

tasks.name: Demonic Showdown
tasks.description: Finish off K'ril Tsutsaroth whilst all of his bodyguards are dead.
context: Demonic Showdown is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to finish off K'ril Tsutsaroth whilst all of his bodyguards are dead.
method: A good method to complete this task solo (and the similar tasks for each of the respective God Wars Dungeon bosses) is to use a Toxic blowpipe alongside a Serpentine helm to envenom the bodyguards between kills, which will put the minions at near-death by the time the boss is nearly dead.

tasks.name: The Bane of Demons
tasks.description: Defeat K'ril Tsutsaroth in a private instance using only demonbane spells.
context: The Bane of Demons is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to defeat K'ril Tsutsaroth in a private instance using only demonbane spells.
method: Recoil damage (i.e. ring of recoil, echo boots, or Vengeance), Undead Grasp, as well as thralls, will disqualify players from completing this achievement. Additionally, ironmen instances do not work; players must use private instances for this achievement.

While demonbane spells are effective against most demons, K'ril's magic defences still makes them fairly inaccurate, mandating players to also cast Mark of Darkness to increase their accuracy and damage further. A purging staff will further double their bonuses, though the staff of the dead or toxic staff of the dead are viable alternatives as they too can autocast demonbane spells, and have a special attack that reduces all melee damage by 50% for one minute. Lastly, a slayer helmet (i) may be worn while on a greater demon slayer task to further increase accuracy. Players can also cast Ward of Arceuus to reduce damage taken by 10%.

Most normal supplies can be forgone as this strategy is only to stay for the one kill needed for the combat achievement. A cheap form of antipoison, such as an araxyte venom sac 2-3 super restores or Sanfew serums if not bringing another form of antipoison Runes to cast Dark Demonbane, Mark of Darkness, and Ward of Arceuus Stat boosts such as an Imbued heart and Super defence Ghommal's hilt 1 or better to get there Any teleport to leave

tasks.name: Demonic Defence
tasks.description: Kill K'ril Tsutsaroth in a private instance without taking any of his melee hits.
context: Demonic Defence is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill K'ril Tsutsaroth in a private instance without taking any of his melee hits.
method: This can be achieved with the use of Protect from Melee and a bit of luck. K'ril Tsutsaroth has a 1/9 chance to use his 'prayer smash' special attack when praying against his melee attacks, which cannot be avoided and will fail the challenge. Maximising your damage output with the use of weapons such as Arclight and special attack weapons such as dragon claws is recommended to minimise the chance he can perform the attack before dying.
Ironman instances do not work, meaning that ironmen have to use the private instance to complete this task.

Another strategy is to walk under K'ril Tsutsaroth until his health bar disappears, and attacking him once before walking back under him again. If you can succesfully stand under him after every attack, he will never be able to hit you. Switching your NPC attack options to 'always right-click' will make this easier to do. Slower weapons with higher strength bonuses such as the elder maul, godswords and the crystal halberd can be very useful as their low attack speed does not matter when using this method, while they can hit very high on each attack.
Other flinching methods that K'ril doesn't hit at all (6:0, 8:0, 9:0, etc) are also viable options for this achievement and requires no luck if the method is done perfectly.

tasks.name: Demon Whisperer
tasks.description: Kill K'ril Tsutsaroth in a private instance without ever being hit by his bodyguards.
context: Demon Whisperer is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to kill K'ril Tsutsaroth in a private instance without ever being hit by his bodyguards.
method: A simple method to achieve this is to use the 5:0 method with a powerful weapon such as Tumeken's shadow, while replacing some damage-boosting gear (e.g., ancestral robe top, tormented bracelet, magus ring) with tank gear (e.g., blessed d'hide body/justiciar chestguard, barrows gloves, ring of suffering (ri)) for the ranged or mage minion not being prayed against. The damage output should still be high enough to kill K'ril in a few cycles, while offering enough defence to block most of the minions' attacks. An additional benefit of this strategy is that it can be used in a regular extended trip, saving the costs of repeatedly creating private instances for each attempt.

It is also possible to complete this challenge by prayer flicking the minions perfectly. To offset the attacks, start under either the mage minion or ranged minion, so it will attack one tick later than the other, and by kiting the melee minion while flicking the ranged and mage minion; alternatively, the player may start a fresh kill towards the east side of the arena, resulting in the ranged minion moving into attack range later. Another option is to focus on killing K'ril Tsutsaroth as quickly as possible using special attack weapons such as dragon claws without prayer flicking; however, as dumping special attacks alone will not be enough to kill K'ril, the player should bring tanky gear to finish K'ril off safely while under attack from the minions.

One last option is to keep either the mage or ranged alive and at low health between kills until just after K'ril Tsutsaroth spawns. Immediately kill the minion once the boss spawns and pray against the other minion as you defeat the boss.

tasks.name: Demonbane Weaponry II
tasks.description: Finish off K'ril Tsutsaroth with a demonbane weapon.
context: Demonbane Weaponry II is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to finish off K'ril Tsutsaroth with a demonbane weapon.
method: Killing him with demonbane spells will count towards completion, even without a Purging staff. Kril's health can be lowered with another weapon, but the final blow must be done with a demonbane weapon. Darklight, or its upgraded form, Arclight, are the most readily available for most players.

tasks.name: Ash Collector
tasks.description: Kill K'ril Tsutsaroth 20 times in a private instance without leaving the room.
context: Ash Collector is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to kill K'ril Tsutsaroth 20 times in a private instance without leaving the room.
method: As K'ril and his bodyguards drop ashes and not bones, the player's healing will primarily come from using Blood Barrage on stacked Tstanon Karlak and Zakl'n Gritch after each kill. The bodyguards can supplement (though not replace) healing with Sharks or Tuna Potatoes drops.

Due to K'ril's high and unpredictable damage, learning a kiting method (such as the 5:0 twisted bow/tumeken's shadow or the 8/9:0 Bow of Faerdhinen/scorching bow methods) is strongly recommended for this achievement. The scorching bow has the added benefit of binding K'ril with its special attack, with enough DPS to kill him within two specials, which allows for some much easier kills. A Lightbearer and Death Charge can regenerate further special attack for these easier kills (though Death Charge use conflicts with Blood spells, and should only be brought if the player is comfortable flicking the minions instead).
The shared instance for ironmen does not count for this achievement.

tasks.name: Half-Way There
tasks.description: Kill a Jal-Zek within the Inferno.
context: Half-Way There is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill a Jal-Zek within the Inferno. Jal-Zek is first encountered on wave 35 of the Inferno.

tasks.name: Inferno Grandmaster
tasks.description: Complete the Inferno 5 times.
context: Inferno Grandmaster is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to complete the Inferno 5 times.

tasks.name: The Floor Is Lava
tasks.description: Kill Tzkal-Zuk without letting Jal-ImKot dig during any wave in the Inferno.
context: The Floor Is Lava is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to kill TzKal-Zuk without letting Jal-ImKot dig during any wave in the Inferno.
method: A Jal-ImKot will burrow towards the player if they have not been able to attack them for 50 ticks after the start of a wave. Letting it attack you at any point instantly resets its dig-timer, and allows you more options than a DPS race to kill the enemy immediately after the start of the wave.

A simple approach for this task is to complete it alongside the Budget Setup grandmaster task, utilising a longer ranged weapon, such as the bow of Faerdhinen and full crystal armour, or Eye of Ayak or Tumeken's shadow with mage armour, as it is typically failed when Jal-ImKots spawn further south and cannot easily be reached with the toxic blowpipe.

Otherwise, it is important to be comfortable quickly off ticking common stacks to run within range of the Jal-ImKot soon after the start of the wave to blowpipe it down before it can dig, or letting it attack you so you gain additional time before it digs.

tasks.name: Playing with Jads
tasks.description: Complete wave 68 of the Inferno within 30 seconds of the first JalTok-Jad dying.
context: Playing with Jads is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to complete wave 68 of the Inferno within 30 seconds of the first JalTok-Jad dying.
method: Since healers spawn when a Jad reaches half health, it is recommended to trigger the spawn of healers for each Jad before killing the first one. Kill or trap each set of healers as they spawn. After all three Jads have spawned healers and their healers have been dealt with, lower each Jad's health carefully, ensuring not to kill any prematurely. Once each Jad is sufficiently weakened, swiftly kill each Jad in succession.

tasks.name: No Luck Required
tasks.description: Kill Tzkal-Zuk without being attacked by TzKal-Zuk and without taking damage from a JalTok-Jad.
context: No Luck Required is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to kill TzKal-Zuk without being hit by him and not taking any damage from a JalTok-Jad.
method: Jads will appear on waves 67-69. One Jad will appear on wave 67 and should prove to be no problem.
Three Jads will appear on wave 68 with an attack speed of 9 instead of 8 and attack in a staggered rotation to allow players to pray against all three.

While fighting Zuk, players must be behind the Ancestral Glyph before he attacks, as it will block the incoming attack meant for the player. Therefore, if his attack goes for the player instead, the achievement is voided. In addition, a final Jad will appear during the fight when Zuk reaches 480 health for the first time.

tasks.name: Nibblers, Begone!
tasks.description: Kill Tzkal-Zuk without letting a pillar fall before wave 67.
context: Nibblers, Begone! is a master combat achievement which requires the player to kill TzKal-Zuk while not letting any of the three pillars that are provided at the start of the fight be destroyed by the Jal-Nibs.

tasks.name: Wasn't Even Close
tasks.description: Kill Tzkal-Zuk without letting your hitpoints fall below 50 during any wave in the Inferno.
context: Wasn't Even Close is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to kill TzKal-Zuk without falling below 50 hitpoints at any point during the Inferno run.
method: All waves will need to be dealt with cautiously, as all of the Inferno monsters hit very hard and the later waves will consist of multiple monsters that use different combat styles, which can easily combo the player out if their attacks aren't protected against. The primary threats for this achievement generally involve double Jal-Aks, a Jal-Zek with a Jal-Xil, or any combination of the three monsters. Try to heal to full (and overheal if necessary) before the start of the next wave to minimise the chance of falling below 50 hitpoints.

Once the first Jal-Zek appears, players are highly encouraged to have Protect from Magic on before the start of the next wave, as the mager has a max hit of 70, which will drop the player below the threshold if they aren't fully boosted (120 or 121 hitpoints). The other monsters have lower max hits, with the ranger having a max hit of 46. Jal-ImKots have a max hit of 49, but they can only attack in melee distance. In these waves with magers, players can position the monsters and use justiciar armour and Protect from Magic to maximise ranged defence.

During Zuk's wave, the damage is more predictably avoided. When Zuk summons his Jal-MejJaks, their blasts will not void the achievement if they drop the player's health below 50, since it isn't a targeted attack. However, if any other monster attacks them off prayer while their health is below 50, they will void the achievement.

tasks.name: Budget Setup
tasks.description: Kill Tzkal-Zuk without equipping a Twisted Bow within the Inferno.
context: Budget Setup is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to kill TzKal-Zuk without using a twisted bow for the entire Inferno run.
method: Effective alternative ranged weapons to the twisted bow include the bow of Faerdhinen or Zaryte crossbow along with a toxic blowpipe. Using a Tumeken's shadow (optionally with an Eye of Ayak) is also viable, although care must be taken due to the lower defences of magic armour.

tasks.name: Nibbler Chaser
tasks.description: Kill Tzkal-Zuk without using any magic spells during any wave in the Inferno.
context: Nibbler Chaser is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to kill TzKal-Zuk without casting any spells in the Inferno.
method: Blood Barrage can no longer be used as a means to restore health, so alternate means of healing include the Saradomin godsword (also restores prayer), ancient godsword (less efficient) or toxic blowpipe.
Chinchompas or a venator bow will be needed to kill the Jal-Nibs.

While the achievement's description states that all spells cannot be used, there are some exceptions. For example, summoning thralls and Death Charge will not cause the achievement to be failed. Similarly, the eldritch Nightmare staff special attack does not fail the task despite it being a targeted attack and calculating damage based on magic level and magic strength.

tasks.name: Facing Jad Head-on II
tasks.description: Kill Tzkal-Zuk without equipping any range or mage weapons before wave 69.
context: Facing Jad Head-on II is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to kill TzKal-Zuk without using any ranged and magic weapons before fighting him.
method: Justiciar armour and Dinh's bulwark are recommended for the massive ranged defence bonus and passive damage reduction effect, reducing a good chunk of damage from the ranged mobs during the run. A Saradomin godsword is recommended to restore health and prayer points. Even then, try to get as few enemies as possible attacking to avoid the chances of getting combo'd out, since all of the monsters can hit very hard.

The player is still allowed to cast spells as long as they don't equip a wand or staff; as melee armour provides negative magic bonuses, they will need to be taken off in order for the spells to hit. Alternatively, a Voidwaker and Ancestral robe top likely provides enough positive magic accuracy to allow barrage spells to hit. Note that despite polestaves such as the pharaoh's sceptre and keris partisan being unable to autocast spells, they are still considered magic weapons and will fail the task if equipped.

It is highly recommended to bring both a noxious halberd and scythe of Vitur for this task if the player can manage the monsters. The halberd is very useful for players who don't want to flinch monsters without running the risk of other monsters attacking or getting melee'd by a ranger, mager, or Jad. This is especially true in the triple Jad wave, as letting one use melee will cause the Jads to potentially attack in sync when the player already has to focus on flicking incoming attacks.

DO NOT equip a magic or ranged weapon after clearing the triple Jad wave; wait for Zuk's cutscene to start before doing so. If the weapon is swapped to before Zuk's wave starts, the attempt will be void.

tasks.name: Jad? What Are You Doing Here?
tasks.description: Kill Tzkal-Zuk without killing the JalTok-Jad which spawns during wave 69.
context: Jad? What Are You Doing Here? is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to kill TzKal-Zuk without killing the JalTok-Jad which spawns during wave 69.
method: JalTok-Jad will appear during Zuk's fight when he reaches 480 or lower hitpoints. As the task requires players to not kill this particular Jad, players will need to watch Jad's animations while moving alongside the Ancestral Glyph to avoid getting killed by Jad. It is beneficial, although not completely required, to know when the Jal-Xil and Jal-Zek will spawn, as to minimise distractions as it is possible for them to attack in sync with each other.

tasks.name: Inferno Speed-Runner
tasks.description: Complete the Inferno in less than 65 minutes.
context: Inferno Speed-Runner is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to complete the Inferno in less than 65 minutes.

tasks.name: Tempoross Novice
tasks.description: Subdue Tempoross 5 times.
context: Tempoross Novice is an easy combat achievement which requires the player to subdue Tempoross 5 times.

tasks.name: Tempoross Champion
tasks.description: Subdue Tempoross 10 times.
context: Tempoross Champion is a medium combat achievement which requires the player to subdue Tempoross 10 times.

tasks.name: Dress Like You Mean It
tasks.description: Subdue Tempoross while wearing any variation of the angler outfit.
context: Dress Like You Mean It is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to subdue Tempoross while wearing all four pieces of the angler's outfit. Players may mix and match regular angler's outfit pieces with spirit angler's outfit pieces.
The outfit can either be obtained from the Fishing Trawler (15 Fishing minimum) or aerial fishing (43 Fishing and 35 Hunter). However, 34 Fishing is required in order to wear it.

tasks.name: Master of Buckets
tasks.description: Extinguish at least 5 fires during a single Tempoross fight.
context: Master of Buckets is an easy combat achievement which requires the player to extinguish at least 5 fires during a single Tempoross fight.

tasks.name: Calm Before the Storm
tasks.description: Repair either a mast or a totem pole.
context: Calm Before the Storm is an easy combat achievement which requires the player to repair either a mast or a totem pole.

tasks.name: Why Cook?
tasks.description: Subdue Tempoross, getting rewarded with 10 reward permits from a single Tempoross fight.
context: Why Cook? is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to subdue Tempoross, getting rewarded with 10 reward permits from a single Tempoross fight.

Both the solo 5 round strategy and the solo firefighting strategy can be used to get enough points per run. The former is outlined below and will not work with the Crystal Harpoon. Note that Humidify is highly recommended for this strategy: Fish 17 and cook all Load cannon Fish 19 and cook all if possible before 93% Storm Intensity Load cannon until you are out of fish Damage Tempoross until approximately ~50% Essence Fish 19 and cook all if possible before 93% Storm Intensity Load cannon until you are out of fish Damage Tempoross until approximately ~30% Essence Fish 19 and cook all Drop all 19 fish on the ground next to one of the nearby cannons Fish another 19 and cook all if possible before 93% Storm Intensity Load all 19 fish into one of the cannons Pick up the 19 fish you dropped earlier and load the other cannon until out of fish Finish Tempoross off.
10 reward permits are guaranteed when scoring at least 8,300 points in a single game. Starting from 7,600 points, any further points increase the chance of getting 10 permits.

Note: If you are having difficulty with the last round, for the last ~30% essence after step 8, it may instead help to drop all ropes and buckets, and fish and cook 28 fish for the last round, loading 14 each into 2 separate cannons. This way, if you do not finish off Tempoross on the third round, then when the storm intensity rapidly increases, the 2 cannons can burst Tempoross back down to 0% energy, allowing you another chance to finish Tempoross off.

tasks.name: The Lone Angler
tasks.description: Subdue Tempoross alone without getting hit by any fires, torrents or waves.
context: The Lone Angler is a medium combat achievement which requires the player to subdue Tempoross alone without getting hit by any fires, torrents or waves.

tasks.name: Fire in the Hole!
tasks.description: Attack Tempoross from both sides by loading both cannons on both ships.
context: Fire in the Hole! is an easy combat achievement which requires the player to attack Tempoross from both sides by loading both cannons on both ships.
method: This can be achieved by loading both cannons of one ship, then travelling across Tempoross Cove to load the cannons of the other ship. The four cannons do not need to fire simultaneously.
If attempted during the whirlpool phase, the player will be able to run between ships without the risk of being caught in a wave.

tasks.name: The II Jad Challenge
tasks.description: Complete TzHaar-Ket-Rak's second challenge.
context: The II Jad Challenge is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to complete TzHaar-Ket-Rak's second challenge.

tasks.name: The IV Jad Challenge
tasks.description: Complete TzHaar-Ket-Rak's fourth challenge.
context: The IV Jad Challenge is a master combat achievement which requires the player to complete TzHaar-Ket-Rak's fourth challenge.

tasks.name: The VI Jad Challenge
tasks.description: Complete TzHaar-Ket-Rak's sixth challenge.
context: The VI Jad Challenge is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to complete TzHaar-Ket-Rak's sixth challenge.

tasks.name: TzHaar-Ket-Rak's Speed-Trialist
tasks.description: Complete TzHaar-Ket-Rak's first challenge in less than 45 seconds.
context: TzHaar-Ket-Rak's Speed-Trialist is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to complete TzHaar-Ket-Rak's first challenge in less than 45 seconds.
method: An easy way to complete this challenge is to use full Dharok's, a Defence-lowering special attack weapon (elder maul, dragon warhammer, or Bandos godsword), Dinh's bulwark (optional), and Vengeance. Additionally, bring several anglerfish (you will need one for each attempt), super combat potions, and a locator orb. If you don't have a Dinh's bulwark, you can alternatively use chinchompas, darts or throwing knives to get the healers' aggression, which additionally has the benefit of being able to use two Defence-lowering special attacks per attempt, or bringing a DPS spec weapon such as Dragon claws.

Before you enter the challenge, equip the special attack weapon, cast Vengeance, drink a super combat potion, and eat an anglerfish. After you enter the challenge, activate Piety and activate your Defence-lowering special attack. When Jad spawns, instantly attack him. If the special attack does not land and/or Jad hits less than 80 damage, die or exit the challenge and try again. If the special attack lands and Jad hits high, activate Protect from Melee and switch to Dharok's greataxe. Lower your hitpoints to below 10 with the locator orb. If Jad attacks with magic or ranged, try changing your prayer as late as possible, especially if the healers are also attacking you. It should take at most 2-3 hits to spawn the healers. When they spawn, immediately lure them with darts, knives, or the Dinh's bulwark special attack. Switch back to your greataxe and finish off Jad.

Elder maul > dragon warhammer > Bandos godsword (enter with this weapon equipped) Dinh's bulwark to lure healers (optional, bring chinchompas, darts or throwing knives otherwise) Divine rune pouch/Rune pouch with the runes for casting Vengeance 4 Anglerfish 3 Super combat potions 8 Super restores 7 Saradomin brews

tasks.name: TzHaar-Ket-Rak's Speed-Chaser
tasks.description: Complete TzHaar-Ket-Rak's third challenge in less than 3 minutes.
context: TzHaar-Ket-Rak's Speed-Chaser is a master combat achievement which requires the player to complete TzHaar-Ket-Rak's third challenge in less than 3 minutes.

tasks.name: TzHaar-Ket-Rak's Speed-Runner
tasks.description: Complete TzHaar-Ket-Rak's fifth challenge in less than 5 minutes.
context: TzHaar-Ket-Rak's Speed-Runner is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to complete TzHaar-Ket-Rak's fifth challenge in less than 5 minutes.

tasks.name: Facing Jad Head-on III
tasks.description: Complete TzHaar-Ket-Rak's second challenge with only melee.
context: Facing Jad Head-on III is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to complete TzHaar-Ket-Rak's second challenge with only melee.
method: JalTok-Jad's melee attack speed is faster than its Ranged and Magic attacks. Melee attacks will alter the cycles with the other Jad making protection Prayer switches between two Jads much more difficult.

To avoid this, a halberd is highly recommended as it will allow players to maintain the necessary distance to prevent the Jads from attacking in sync with each other. The noxious halberd is the strongest choice due to its higher stats and faster attack speed over the crystal halberd. This is only needed for the first Jad, as the other Jad is less of an issue.

There is no restriction on manually casting magic spells, but a magic weapon cannot be equipped at any point during the fight. Using any dagger which has a +1 magic bonus, will not fail the challenge if used to manually cast spells while equipped; however a Pharaoh's sceptre or Keris partisan will, despite also not having autocast options. This can be useful for barraging the Yt-HurKots to grab their attention, as running out from the centre may result in the Jads attacking in sync.

tasks.name: Facing Jad Head-on IV
tasks.description: Complete TzHaar-Ket-Rak's fourth challenge with only melee.
context: Facing Jad Head-on IV is a master combat achievement which requires the player to complete TzHaar-Ket-Rak's fourth challenge with only melee.
method: JalTok-Jad can attack with melee every , as opposed to its normal attack speed when using Ranged or Magic attacks. Melee attacks will alter the cycles with the other Jads making protection prayer switches between four Jads much more difficult.

To avoid this and melee attacks from the first three JalTok-Jads, a halberd can be used to attack with melee from a distance. The last Jad can be killed with any melee weapon while praying protect from melee and switching when necessary. To lure the healers effectively, it is possible to use the special attack of Dinh's bulwark, which can hit all the healers in one attack. Because healers don't spawn on a Jad's east side, prepare for your spec by standing on the west side.
You can use any type of thralls for this Combat Achievement.

tasks.name: Supplies? Who Needs 'em?
tasks.description: Complete TzHaar-Ket-Rak's third challenge without having anything in your inventory.
context: Supplies? Who Needs 'em? is a master combat achievement which requires the player to complete TzHaar-Ket-Rak's third challenge without having anything in their inventory.
method: Using a twisted bow or even a bow of Faerdhinen (with full crystal armour) makes this challenge quite easy. Only attempt with a magic set-up if you own a Tumeken's shadow. Other set-ups will significantly increase kill times. You can pre-pot/eat prior to entering the challenge. It is recommended to use the ancient mace special attack in your POH with max melee gear, eat an anglerfish, and drink a dose of prayer regeneration potion prior to entering. With both 99 Prayer and Hitpoints, this will allow you to enter with 121 HP and up to 142 prayer points depending on gear available, plus an additional 1 prayer point restored every 12 ticks up to a maximum of an additional 66 prayer points. It is advised to also sip a combat style appropriate potion prior to entering.

Only use protection prayers without using any stat boosting prayers such as Rigour. At 99 prayer points, a +15 prayer bonus will allow you 445 seconds (7:24) of prayer during the challenge. At 139 prayer points and +20 prayer bonus, using just protection prayers will last over 11 full minutes allowing you to easily complete the challenge. If you are running out of prayer before you can kill all three, prioritise increasing prayer bonus over slight DPS increases, such as a ring of the gods (i) rather than a venator ring for an additional 8 prayer bonus.

A good strategy for healers is to tag each one, and try running through JalTok-Jad to block them on the opposite side. Good equipment can allow you to tank some of the healers, but it is not advised, as even one healer from each Jad is enough to kill you. To time your run-through, stand just outside Jad's melee range, and as the attack animation starts run through, praying accordingly. This allows you to take almost no damage from the healers.

tasks.name: It Wasn't a Fluke
tasks.description: Complete TzHaar-Ket-Rak's fifth and sixth challenges back to back without failing.
context: It Wasn't a Fluke is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to complete TzHaar-Ket-Rak's fifth and sixth challenges back to back without failing. The fifth challenge must be completed before the sixth challenge otherwise it will not be completed.
After completing the fifth challenge, player can safely logout and the progression wont be lost.

tasks.name: Multi-Style Specialist
tasks.description: Complete TzHaar-Ket-Rak's third challenge while using a different attack style for each JalTok-Jad.
context: Multi-Style Specialist is a master combat achievement which requires the player to complete TzHaar-Ket-Rak's third challenge while using a different attack style for each JalTok-Jad. The healers may be damaged with any combat style without failing the achievement.
method: Since JalTok-Jads are very resistant to magic, it is advisable to start with ranged. Because Jad's melee attacks are faster than the ranged and magic attacks, killing the second one with magic is advisable, as using melee will likely offset the attack cycles of the two remaining Jads or even synchronize them. Kill the last one with melee, and the challenge is complete.
Recoil damage from a ring of suffering (r) or echo boots along with the sacrifice damage from ancient godsword special attack will cause you to fail this combat achievement.

Thralls can be used, but the style of thrall summoned must match the attack style used to kill each Jad, or you will fail this combat achievement. Therefore, after killing a Jad, it is advised to summon a thrall of the next combat style as you switch your gear.

tasks.name: Stop Right There!
tasks.description: Defeat the Maiden of Sugadinti in the Theatre of Blood: Hard Mode without letting blood spawns create more than 15 blood trails.
context: Stop Right There! is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to defeat The Maiden of Sugadinti in hard mode without letting her blood spawns create more than 15 trails of blood.
method: Blood spawns can appear at random during the fight against the Maiden, but their chances of appearing significantly increase if the Maiden's splatter attack manages to hit someone; thus, any melee users should carefully watch the Maiden's animations, as they will have less time to react compared to those attacking from afar. As the Maiden is generally killed with melee (as it is significantly higher damage when her Defence level is drained), players should be careful.

If a blood spawn appears, the mager is responsible for freezing it in place; as they have near non-existent stats, there should be no issue of splashing in mage gear. An Ice ancient sceptre can be useful for the task, as it will bind the spawn for 21.6 seconds when using Ice Barrage compared to 19.2 seconds.

An alternate strategy takes advantage of the fact that blood spawns that spawn in the north-east corner of the arena cannot move. To take advantage of this, a player can enter, stand on the north-east corner of the area until a blood splat attack occurs, then intentionally step on it to spawn a blood spawn. Then finish the rest of the kill without stepping on another blood splat.

tasks.name: Personal Space
tasks.description: Defeat the Pestilent Bloat in the Theatre of Blood: Hard Mode with at least 3 people in the room, without anyone in your team standing on top of each other.
context: Personal Space is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to defeat the Pestilent Bloat, in hard mode, with at least three players in the room and without any of them standing on top of each other.
method: Being able to damage the bloat quickly is essential for this task to avoid spending time trying to avoid standing on top of each other. Try to use the first two set of tiles surrounding the centre piece, with one player following another. In hard mode, chunks of flesh will fall from the ceiling for the entire fight, so players should be mindful of this to avoid taking unnecessary damage and stuns, which can potentially allow the Bloat to damage them. If the bloat manages to attack someone, use Protect from Missiles to reduce damage, since everyone is likely to be hit.
When the bloat is inactive, be mindful to avoid death-dotting on each other, as this will disqualify the team if this occurs.
The team cannot enter after the first stomp(?), as it will fail the task saying "Player A has entered the room late."

tasks.name: Royal Affairs
tasks.description: In the Theatre of Blood: Hard Mode, complete the Nylocas room without ever letting the Nylocas Prinkipas change styles.
context: Royal Affairs is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to complete the Nylocas room without dying in hard mode without letting a Nylocas Prinkipas change styles.
method: Nylocas Prinkipas has 300/350/400 health (in <3, 4 and 5-man sizes) and like Nylocas Vasilias, will always spawn in its melee form. It functions much like Vasilias and will change combat styles after 10 ticks (6 seconds), so the team must focus it as soon as it appears in order to complete the achievement.

The required amount of damage per player on average decreases with team size, so attempting this achievement in a 5-man encounter should increase the chances of killing the Prinkipas before they can change combat styles. This should be done with dragon claws or a crystal halberd special as these deal the most amount of damage.
Players on the Arceuus spellbook can use Death Charge (ideally the upgraded variant) to get a lot of special energy without stalling waves. A surge potion is also helpful in restoring special attack.

tasks.name: Harder Mode I
tasks.description: Defeat Sotetseg in the Theatre of Blood: Hard Mode without anyone sharing the ball with anyone, without anyone dying, and without anyone taking damage from any of its other attacks or stepping on the wrong tile in the maze.
context: Harder Mode I is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to defeat Sotetseg in hard mode, without taking any damage from its attacks, sharing the large red ball damage, stepping on the wrong tile in the maze, and dying.
method: Pray according to Sotetseg's attacks and keep Protect from Melee on until a projectile requires the player to swap prayers. This achievement basically mirrors Perfect Sotetseg in normal mode, with the addition of needing to tick eat the large balls. Players targeted by the large balls must tick eat them as sharing them will disqualify the team from the achievement. It is possible to dodge the damage from these balls if the team manages to phase Sotetseg before they can damage them.
The maze works similarly as in normal mode, but it will be divided among the players sent into the realm; this shouldn't be a problem for anyone however with proper coordination.

tasks.name: Harder Mode II
tasks.description: Defeat Xarpus in the Theatre of Blood: Hard Mode after letting the exhumeds heal him to full health and without anyone in the team taking any damage.
context: Harder Mode II is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to defeat Xarpus in hard mode after letting the exhumed heal him to full and without anyone taking any damage from him.
method: Harder Mode II is essentially the same as following Perfect Xarpus in normal mode, apart from having much less space to move around in general. As with normal mode, landing dragon warhammer and bandos godsword hits are essential for this task, which is fortunately easier in hard mode as Xarpus' Defence drops to 200 from 250.
Once Xarpus starts the screeching phase, the achievement can be easily completed.

tasks.name: Nylo Sniper
tasks.description: Defeat Verzik Vitur's in the Theatre of Blood: Hard Mode without anyone in your team causing a Nylocas to explode by getting too close.
context: Nylo Sniper is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to defeat Verzik Vitur in a Theatre of Blood: Hard Mode run without letting a nylocas explode during the fight.
method: Nylocas will spawn in phase 2 and 3 of the fight. Up to three nylocas may spawn, consisting of a mix of Nylocas Hagios, Nylocas Ischyros or Nylocas Toxobolos. The nylocas change styles in hard mode, looping from melee, ranged, and magic every 3 ticks, always in that order. The nylocas will pursue a random player upon spawning, though it is possible for them to focus on one player instead. Use the respective weapon against each nylocas to kill them. Binding the nylocas can make it easier for players to take them down without needing to run a lot.
