context: You're a wizard is a medium combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Hueycoatl using only earth spells. Only the player seeking the achievement must use earth spells; other players fighting the boss can use any gear.
Note that rings of recoil will fail this task; all damage must be done via earth spells.
method: While the Hueycoatl has a 60% weakness to earth spells, its +200 Magic Defence makes it much less efficient than melee attacks, especially during the tail phase.

As such, this task is best done on worlds 340 or 517, which are designated by the game as "Varlamore PvM" worlds and are the likeliest worlds where masses of players are fighting the boss. World 330 and 420 are also unofficial general mass worlds due to their higher player counts.

tasks.name: I'm your son
tasks.description: Kill the Hueycoatl whilst wearing two pieces of Hueycoatl armour.
context: I'm your son is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Hueycoatl whilst wearing two pieces of Hueycoatl hide armour. Only the player seeking the achievement must do this; other players fighting the boss can use any gear.
method: This achievement is straightforward to complete; notably, the armour does not need to be equipped for the entire fight for the achievement to count and can be equipped just before defeating the Hueycoatl to complete. Ironmen are advised to craft a coif and vambraces for the achievement, as those two items are required for a master clue.

tasks.name: Hueycoatl Speed-Trialist
tasks.description: Kill the Hueycoatl in 2:30
context: Hueycoatl Speed-Trialist is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Hueycoatl in 2:30.
method: As this task can be completed in any team size, it is best done on world 340 or 517, which are designated by the game as "Varlamore PvM" worlds and are the likeliest worlds where masses of players are fighting the boss.

tasks.name: Hueycoatl Speed-Chaser
tasks.description: Kill the Hueycoatl in 2:30 with five or fewer players.
context: Hueycoatl Speed-Chaser is a master combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Hueycoatl in 2:30 with five or fewer players.

tasks.name: Hueycoatl Speed-Runner
tasks.description: Kill the Hueycoatl in 2:30 with three or fewer players.
context: Hueycoatl Speed-Runner is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Hueycoatl in 2:30 with three or fewer players.
method: All players should have Blood moon armour (for phase 3) and thralls. Each player should camp a specific prayer for the entire kill (as the Hueycoatl barely deals any damage on hit).

Having the pillars active at all times provides a 30% damage increase until the next seer cycle, and thus this will make weapons such as dragon claws, crimson kisten and scythe of Vitur hit much harder. Thralls are helpful for dealing additional damage.

tasks.name: Amoxliatl Champion
tasks.description: Kill Amoxliatl once.
context: Amoxliatl Champion is a medium combat achievement which requires the player to kill Amoxliatl once.

tasks.name: Amoxliatl Adept
tasks.description: Kill Amoxliatl 20 times.
context: Amoxliatl Adept is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to kill Amoxliatl 20 times.

tasks.name: Amoxliatl Speed-Trialist
tasks.description: Kill Amoxliatl in less than 1 minute.
context: Amoxliatl Speed-Trialist is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to kill Amoxliatl in less than 1 minute. Unlike most speed achievements, this can be done on a Slayer task.
method: For strategies on this achievement, see Amoxliatl Speed-Chaser.

tasks.name: Amoxliatl Speed-Chaser
tasks.description: Kill Amoxliatl in less than 30 seconds.
context: Amoxliatl Speed-Chaser is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill Amoxliatl in less than 30 seconds. Unlike most speed achievements, this can be done on a Slayer task.
method: Without a Scythe of Vitur this is considered to be one of the hardest achievements in the Elite tier.

For players without access to a scythe or soulreaper axe, and are not on a nagua slayer task, the dual macuahuitl with full Blood moon armour is the best option due to the Bloodrager set effect allowing the macuahuitl to attack faster. If beginning with a ruby bolt proc and high-hitting special attacks from dragon claws/burning claws or a Bandos godsword, the task will eventually be achieved with enough Bloodrager activations.

A more reliable strategy is to use Burning claws, thralls and the Dharok's armour set at 1 hp, with the Dharok's greataxe set to crush. Use a Divine super combat potion and locator orb or dwarven rock cake to get to one hp at the door. Then do the following: Activate the burning claws special attack before entering, and activate piety and Protect from Magic While running towards Amoxliatl, summon a mage thrall Directly after using the first special attack, drink a Surge potion Use the burning claws special attack two more times Switch to the Dharok's greataxe after the third special attack and kill Amoxliatl in 5 more hits to stay under 30 seconds. This method can be done without resetting for ruby bolt procs, making it much more consistent. If Dragon claws are used instead, the same can be done by using a dragon dagger for the final special attack. Note that this third 4-tick attack is effectively free, as 6 greataxe hits would exceed the 30-second limit by one tick, due to the single tick delay when running towards the boss.

If not using a Surge potion for an additional special attack, it is recommended to follow up the two claw special attacks with a single Noxious halberd attack, or another strong weapons with a speed of 5-ticks or faster.

tasks.name: Nagua Negation
tasks.description: Kill Amoxliatl without taking any damage.
context: Nagua Negation is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to kill Amoxliatl without taking any damage.
method: The initial ice spikes that strike the player can be negated with Protect from Magic, and all other sources of damage deal typeless damage, but are avoidable.
Players can also easily avoid icy pools by dragging her two tiles after she initiates her attack:

tasks.name: Temotli Triumph
tasks.description: Kill Amoxliatl using only glacial temotli as a weapon.
context: Temotli Triumph is a medium combat achievement which requires the player to kill Amoxliatl using only glacial temotli as a weapon.
method: Glacial temotli requires level 55 Attack to equip, and is a straightforward task to complete given Amoxliatl's weakness to crush weapons and negative flat armour stats.

Players without the required Attack level, or under self-imposed restrictions, can complete the task using only thralls alongside using a -100 accuracy fun weapon as missed hits do not disqualify players. However, the player will likely have to "re-rag" frozen tiles in order to avoid having the room fill up completely. You can use Cast Vengeance and ring of recoils alongside thralls to speed this kill up significantly.

tasks.name: Without Ralos' Light
tasks.description: Kill Amoxliatl without losing any prayer points.
context: Without Ralos' Light is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill Amoxliatl without losing any prayer points.
method: For players familiar with 1-tick prayer flicking, this achievement is straightforward. Otherwise, the player may simply not use prayers at all; keep in mind that her regular magic attack can deal up to 22 damage, and her Icicle Crash special can deal up to 34 damage.
Alternatively, lazy flicking can be used to avoid damage. Activate Protect from Magic one tick before an attack and deactivate it before dodging the spikes. Amoxliatl attacks on an 8-tick cycle.
Summoning a thrall does not fail the task.

tasks.name: Kemo Makti
tasks.description: Kill Amoxliatl 10 times without leaving her chamber.
context: Kemo Makti is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to kill Amoxliatl 10 times without leaving her chamber.
method: As long as players have enough prayer restoration and keep Protect from Magic active, they can easily last 10 kills if properly dealing with her special attacks, from which all damage is avoidable.

tasks.name: Totally Shattered
tasks.description: Kill Amoxliatl without any of her unstable ice shattering.
context: Totally Shattered is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to kill Amoxliatl without any of her unstable ice shattering.
method: Players have 9 seconds to destroy all the unstable ice that Amoxliatl launches. By using melee weapons, each can be instantly destroyed in succession:

tasks.name: Perfect Royal Titans
tasks.description: Kill the Royal Titans without getting hit by any avoidable damage. This includes: Melee attacks, Explosions from the ice or fire elemental, Icicle or fire spawn damage, and Ice or fire pulse attacks.
context: Perfect Royal Titans is a hard combat achievement requiring the player to kill the Royal Titans without getting hit by any avoidable damage.
method: Avoidable damage from the bosses include: Melee and self-destruct damage from the ice and fire elementals Standing on fires and icicles as they fully form Standing on the three rows of tiles where the Titans will be upon phase 2 starting The Titans' melee stomp and Elemental Blasts

Note that in a duo kill, players will fail this task by taking damage through prayer from an enraged Titan, so it is recommended to bring both their health as low as possible before killing them quickly. However, in a solo kill, damage from an enraged Titan does not fail this achievement.

tasks.name: Royal Titan Champion
tasks.description: Kill the Royal Titans 10 times.
context: Royal Titan Champion is a medium combat achievement requiring the player to kill the Royal Titans 10 times.

tasks.name: Royal Titan Adept
tasks.description: Kill the Royal Titans 25 times.
context: Royal Titan Adept is a medium combat achievement requiring the player to kill the Royal Titans 25 times.

tasks.name: One by one
tasks.description: Kill one Titan at a time, without attacking the other.
context: One by one is an easy combat achievement requiring the player to kill one of the Royal Titans at a time, without attacking the other.
method: The task effectively requires killing a full-health enraged Branda or Eldric. Aside from their melee attacks dealing up to 10 damage through Protect from Melee, the safespot for the Elemental Blast is always placed at the furthest row from them.

tasks.name: Royal Titan Speed-Runner
tasks.description: Kill the Royal Titans in less than 1:30 minutes.
context: Royal Titan Speed-Runner is a hard combat achievement requiring the player to kill the Royal Titans in under 1 minute and 30 seconds.
method: The speed time effectively mandates having a partner to complete the achievement with. Some strategies for getting the time include: Ignoring the elementals entirely, as they do not deal much damage Attacking only one of the Titans in phase 1 to hit the phase 2 threshold (210 health) as soon as possible Getting both Titans low on health before killing one of them Note that a time of exactly 1:30 will not complete the task

tasks.name: Titan Killer
tasks.description: Kill the Royal Titans 15 times without anyone leaving the instance. If a player joins the fight, the current streak will be reset to 0. If a player leaves the fight, the task will be failed and a new instance will need to be created.
context: Titan Killer is a hard combat achievement requiring the player to kill the Royal Titans 15 times without anyone leaving the instance. If a player joins the fight, the current streak will be reset to 0. If a player leaves the fight, the task will be failed and a new instance will need to be created.
method: All damage from the bosses is avoidable (aside from enraged attacks), so bring additional prayer potions and some food for mistakes.

The most notable pain point would be dealing with the elementals, since their explosion can add up to deal a lot of damage. Bringing a twinflame staff with Wave spells is more than enough to kill them off with minimal hassle.

tasks.name: Elemental Company
tasks.description: Kill the Royal Titans without attacking any elementals.
context: Elemental Company is an easy combat achievement requiring the player to kill the Royal Titans without attacking the ice or fire elemental.
method: Players may simply carry on the kill while praying Protect from Melee, and keep running around the arena whilst attacking the titans to avoid their self-destruct attack.
During the second phase, players may also lure elementals to their opposing Titan in order to position them to be killed by the Elemental Blast attack, which will not fail this task.

tasks.name: I need room
tasks.description: Kill the Royal Titans while extinguishing all fires and melting all icicles before they dissipate naturally.
context: I need room is a hard combat achievement requiring the player to kill the Royal Titans while extinguishing all fires and melting all icicles before they dissipate naturally.
method: Players will always need to cast spells at least twice to remove a row of obstacles. As there are no attack delays for doing so, players may opt to remove them in between their regular attacks.
A twinflame staff will simplify this task further due to its spell-switching effect.
You can also earn this achievement if you manage to line up the spawn of fires and icicles. They will melt/extinguish the other elemental allowing you to earn the achievement.
For solo players, focusing one titan to get to Phase 2 as quickly as possible will minimise the time spent focusing on this achievement.

tasks.name: No time to pray
tasks.description: Kill the Royal Titans without losing any prayer points.
context: No time to pray is an elite combat achievement requiring the player to kill the Royal Titans without losing any prayer points.
method: For players familiar with 1-tick prayer flicking, this achievement is straightforward. Otherwise, the player may simply not use prayers at all; the kill will be longer and more damage will be taken, but with high-end gear and high combat stats, this should not pose an issue. Players may flinch the Titan when it does its melee attacks during phase 1 to avoid damage.
While fighting the Titans in a duo, both players must avoid losing any prayer points during the fight.

tasks.name: Let them fight
tasks.description: Kill the Royal Titans while having the Royal Titans kill a total of 10 elementals.
context: Let them fight is an easy combat achievement requiring the player to kill the Royal Titans while having them kill at least 10 ice or fire elementals.
method: During the second phase, players must lure elementals towards the opposing Titan, positioning them to be killed during the Titans' Elemental Blast. Elementals can also be killed by having them stand on fires and icicles before they fully form, though this is unreliable and random.

tasks.name: It takes too long
tasks.description: Kill both Royal Titans while they are charging up their area attack. Both titans must die during the same charging phase.
context: It takes too long is a medium combat achievement requiring the player to kill both the Royal Titans while they are charging up their area attack. Both titans must die during the same charging phase.
method: Having a partner is recommended for this task. Players must whittle down the Titans' health as low as possible, or have them at low health and proceeding to use high-hitting special attacks as the charging starts.

tasks.name: Yama Adept
tasks.description: Defeat Yama once.
context: Yama Adept is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to defeat Yama once.

tasks.name: Yama Veteran
tasks.description: Defeat Yama 50 times.
context: Yama Veteran is a master combat achievement which requires the player to defeat Yama 50 times.

tasks.name: Yama Speed-Trialist
tasks.description: Defeat Yama in an average time of under 3:38 over your last four kills.
context: Yama Speed-Trialist is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to defeat Yama in an average time of under 3:38 over the player's most recent four kills.
method: For strategies on this achievement, see Yama Speed-Runner.

tasks.name: Yama Speed-Chaser
tasks.description: Defeat Yama in an average time of under 3:00 over your last four kills.
context: Yama Speed-Chaser is a master combat achievement which requires the player to defeat Yama in an average time of under 3:00 over the player's most recent four kills.
method: For strategies on this achievement, see Yama Speed-Runner.

tasks.name: Yama Speed-Runner
tasks.description: Defeat Yama in an average time of under 2:34 over your last four kills.
context: Yama Speed-Runner is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to defeat Yama in an average time of under 2:34 over the player's most recent four kills.
method: The speed time effectively mandates having a partner to complete the achievement with, which works by calculating the average kill time of the players most recent four kills. This means that: Players do not have to stay in the same instance for all four kills. Players can teleport out after a kill to start another kill with full supplies and statuses. Players can teleport out mid-kill if the kill time appears unfavourable to preserve the streak.

Players can use various methods to speed up kills further: Spellbook Swap - players can bring runes for Spellbook Swap, Vengeance, Resurrect Greater Ghost, Mark of Darkness, and Death Charge to maximise damage output. Vengeance - casting Vengeance before starting the kill and not standing on a glyph to recoil damage back. For the Meteor Strike in phase 2, both players must stand in the centre of the attack in order to split the damage to 80 each. Judge self-bombing - players can stand under the Judge of Yama before it attacks so that the fireball lands on them. Special attacks - players using the soulflame horn should switch to burning claws right after using its special attack to guarantee their partner's dragon warhammer/elder maul special attack. Using surge potions and Death Charge can increase the number of usable special attacks, especially in phase 3. Melee phase 3 - using melee for phase 3 with methods such as the donofly and dumping special attacks (without getting out of cycle) will substantially increase the chance of a fast time.

tasks.name: No toppings, no drinks, thanks
tasks.description: Defeat Yama without anybody healing using anything other than plain pizza and without anybody drinking any potions.
context: No toppings, no drinks, thanks is a master combat achievement which requires the player to defeat Yama without anybody healing using anything other than plain pizza and without anybody drinking any potions.
method: Prior to challenging Yama, players can overheal with an anglerfish, as well as pre-pot an antidote++, prayer regeneration potion, and a super combat potion or forgotten brew in advance without penalty.

During the fight, ruby harvests, sapphire glacialis, and black warlocks can be used to boost Attack, Defence, and Strength, respectively, without failing the task. Their hunter's mix versions cannot be used, as hunter's mixes are considered potions and will fail the task.

If preserving prayer points is an issue, consider using an ancient mace special attack on a combat dummy with the best melee equipment in hand. Additionally, moonlight moths and the Falador shield 4 can be used to restore prayer freely. Moonlight moths may be used, but not moonlight moth mixes.

Any healing sources not named plain pizza will fail this achievement; this includes weapons with healing special attacks (eg. Saradomin godsword and toxic blowpipe), items such as the amulet of blood fury, and healing butterflies or moths such as snowy knights and sunlight moths.
Note that failing this achievement in a duo fight will cause the partner to fail as well.
This achievement is best paired with Contract Choreographer, as performing a perfect kill will require little to no food with plenty of prayer to spare.

tasks.name: Shadow dancer
tasks.description: Defeat Yama without getting hit by shadows and without being more than one tile away from the center[sic] of his shadow crash attack.
context: Shadow dancer is a master combat achievement which requires the player to defeat Yama without getting hit by shadows and without being more than one tile away from the centre of his shadow crash attack.
method: The achievement requires that the player avoid the following: Taking damage from ranged attacks off-prayer Taking damage from shadow-based special attacks in phases 1 and 2 Taking damage from Shadow Waves Taking damage from Shadow Crash Being more than one tile away from the centre fireball during the Shadow Crash attack
In a duo fight, a player failing this achievement will not cause their partner to fail.
Yama - dodging shadow flame wall.mp4|A pair of players skip over the shadow waves. Yama - phase 3 dodging.mp4|Players avoid both the shadow crash and shadow wave during the final phase of the fight.

tasks.name: Fire fighter
tasks.description: Defeat Yama without getting hit by fire and having only killed void flares with special attacks.
context: Fire fighter is a master combat achievement which requires the player to defeat Yama without getting hit by fire and having only killed Void Flares with special attacks.
method: The achievement requires that the player avoid the following: Taking damage from magic attacks off-prayer Taking damage from fire-based special attacks in phases 1 and 2 Taking damage from Fire Streaks Taking damage from the Judge of Yama's fire spells and fire bombs Void flares can be attacked normally, but must be killed with a special attack. The typical purging staff strategy works well here: with Mark of Darkness active and at least 20% magic damage bonus, cast Dark Demonbane on a void flare once, then use the purging staff's special attack to finish it off.

Alternatively, players can deal with void flares that spawn during phases 1 and 2 by using the corresponding glyphs to avoid having to attack the void flare, or by simply ignoring them, as taking damage from void flares does not fail the achievement.
In a duo fight, a player failing this achievement will not cause their partner to fail.

tasks.name: Back so soon?
tasks.description: Defeat Yama without the judge being attacked with the wrong style and without taking more than one instance of damage each time you are exiled from the arena.
context: Back so soon? is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to defeat Yama without the Judge of Yama being attacked with the wrong style, and without taking more than one instance of damage each time you are exiled from the arena.
method: The Judge of Yama must be perfectly defeated for this achievement.
This means that the player cannot: Attack the Judge with a combat style that it is praying against Take damage from the Judge's fire spells and fire bombs Take too long to kill the Judge

The only source of damage outside of the player's control is the 5-7 damage taken from the chamber periodically shaking, which gives the player a limited amount of time to kill the Judge. As the Judge's health pool is shared in duos, completing this with a partner is recommended. In a duo fight, a player failing this achievement will not cause their partner to fail.

tasks.name: Contract Choreographer
tasks.description: Defeat Yama whilst completing 'Shadow Dancer', 'Fire Fighter', 'Back so soon?' and without taking any other avoidable damage.
context: Contract Choreographer is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to defeat Yama without taking avoidable damage whilst also completing the Shadow dancer, Fire fighter, and Back so soon? tasks in the same kill.
method: This achievement effectively requires the player to perform a perfect kill for Yama. As kill times can be long for solo fights, having a partner is recommended to shorten the fight and have fewer opportunites to make errors. Additionally, in a duo fight, a player failing this achievement will not cause their partner to fail.

tasks.name: Contractually Unbound
tasks.description: Defeat Yama under the elevated conditions of one of his non-standard contracts.
context: Contractually Unbound is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to defeat Yama under the elevated conditions of one of his non-standard contracts.
method: Players may choose to complete this achievement with any one of the following contracts: Contract of Bloodied Blows Contract of Divine Severance Contract of Familiar Acquisition Contract of Forfeit Breath Contract of Glyphic Attenuation Contract of Sensory Clouding

The Contract of Forfeit Breath is generally considered the easiest out of the six as maintaining run energy for the fight is not as complex as dealing with the mechanical changes in the other four contracts. The baseline changes for all sigil contracts are as follows: Yama does two standard attacks before a special attack; glyphs respawn faster. Shadow Waves and Fire Streaks appear more frequently. Special attacks in phase 1 land 1 tick earlier than usual. Phase transition thresholds trigger at 75% and 50% health. The Judge of Yama throws fire bombs every 3 ticks, and throws two per attack. Shadow Waves and Shadow Crashes are more frequent in phase 3.

tasks.name: Doom Adept
tasks.description: Defeat the Doom of Mokhaiotl at delve level 3.
context: Doom Adept is an elite combat achievement which requires defeating the Doom of Mokhaiotl at delve level 3.

tasks.name: Doom Veteran
tasks.description: Defeat the Doom of Mokhaiotl at delve level 8.
context: Doom Veteran is a master combat achievement which requires defeating the Doom of Mokhaiotl at delve level 8.

tasks.name: It's Dark Down Here
tasks.description: Defeat the Doom of Mokhaiotl at delve level 16.
context: It's Dark Down Here is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires defeating the Doom of Mokhaiotl at delve level 16.
method: Doom after delve 8 will have 625 hitpoints (same as delve 5/6) while retaining the difficulty of delve 8. Because of the lower Hitpoints and having three zooms instead of two, players with high-end gear may find themselves defeating Doom before the earthen shield attack has a chance to be used. It is important to use the Rockblock technique in order to make the most use of falling rocks, as they start to become less frequent.

Use saradomin brews as the main source of healing and bring enough super restores to be able to reach delve 16. Prayer flicking the lower delves helps preserve prayer for deeper delves. Anti-venom+ is highly recommended. Use a single-hit weapon such as a noxious halberd for melee punishes, as multi-hit weapons will splatter acid on a significantly higher amount of tiles.

Players who can minimise acid splatters should not have much difficulty when descending deep down, but the chances of this is very unlikely since each delve splatters in a random cardinal direction. If many acid splatters are present, avoid damaging Doom outside of charges and allow the earthen shield to clear as many tiles as possible. It is possible to get the achievement without having to clear acid, although this will require a lot of movement and conserving supplies.

tasks.name: Exposed Doom
tasks.description: Defeat the Doom of Mokhaiotl during its Melee charge phase.
context: Exposed Doom is an elite combat achievement which requires defeating the Doom of Mokhaiotl during its melee charge phase at any delve level.

tasks.name: Mokhaiotl Drift
tasks.description: Defeat the Doom of Mokhaiotl at level 8 or above before he finishes the first burrow phase.
context: Mokhaiotl Drift is a master combat achievement which requires defeating the Doom of Mokhaiotl at delve level 8+ before it finishes its first burrow phase.
method: At delve 8, Doom will initiate the shield phase upon reaching around ~500 or so hitpoints. However, it is possible to bring Doom below the 75% health threshold through luck, such as a prayer rock when Doom is near the phase threshold; the player can deal a minimum of 48 damage with a scythe of Vitur punish and also have enough time to attack once with their other weapon before Doom initiates shield phase.

Although slow, players can deal extra damage to Doom during shield phase by delaying it as long as possible, making sure to hit Doom with a weak demonbane to prevent the charge attack from going off and killing larvae before they reach the boss. This is capped at 50 damage.

During the burrow phase, dumping a zaryte crossbow special as soon as it starts will deal around ~100 or so damage, or several dragon knives if Doom's health was low enough at the start of the phase. The player will have three charges before Doom surfaces. If the player lures Doom to a corner and then moves to another, players can squeeze in an additional attack during these transitions.
Delaying going past 75% hp until the volatile earth spawn can allow extra attacks before the boss begins the shield phase, as he cannot enter shield phase during this attack.
The achievement will be counted towards if Doom is defeated just as it surfaces, though the time gap is incredibly tight since it is a few ticks from surfacing and ending the burrow phase.

tasks.name: Grub Patrol
tasks.description: Defeat the Doom of Mokhaiotl levels 1-8 without ever letting a grub be absorbed.
context: Grub Patrol is a master combat achievement which requires defeating the Doom of Mokhaiotl at delve levels 1 through 8 whilst never letting a Demonic larva be absorbed.
method: Kill off larvae as soon as they appear; don't let them get too close to Doom, or the player may attack it instead of them when they get under the boss.

The greatest amount of larvae appear during shield phases, but this should not be a problem in most cases. The only issue will be melee larvae when many acid splatters are surrounding the boss or if two grubs stack on each other. In the case of the former, drinking Anti-venom potions will mitigate venom, while in the case of the latter, it may be beneficial to kill one earlier to avoid misclicks.

tasks.name: Perfect Doom
tasks.description: Defeat the Doom of Mokhaiotl levels 1-8 without taking any damage from the boss, letting any grubs be absorbed, or stepping in acid blood.
context: Perfect Doom is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to defeat the Doom of Mokhaiotl at delve levels 1 through 8 without taking damage from the boss or larvae explosions, letting any demonic larvae be absorbed, or stepping on acid blood.
method: This achievement additionally requires players to meet the requirements of Grub Patrol.
Lower delve levels should not prove a problem to most players, but delves 7 and 8 require more attention in order to avoid failing the task.
Players should:

Kill melee larvae as far away as possible if acid is surrounding Doom. The scorching bow special attack is highly recommended; it will not bind melee larvae, but the burn damage from its special attack can kill them. Kill larvae that appear as soon as they appear outside of shield phase rather than trying to hit Doom. Use the Double Rockblock technique to spend more time damaging the boss and less time evading during burrow phase Time the spawning of the earthen shield to avoid getting hit by shockwave Find safe tiles to use during boulder tosses, as the amount of debris scattered at higher delves makes it harder to avoid them

tasks.name: The Praying Mantis
tasks.description: Defeat the Doom of Mokhaiotl levels 1-8 without restoring your prayer points through any method.
context: The Praying Mantis is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires defeating the Doom of Mokhaiotl at delve level 8 without restoring any prayer points.
method: Having a high Prayer level is beneficial for this achievement. While possible to do with base 99 Prayer, it is strongly encouraged players pre-boost pray with an ancient mace special inside their home against a combat dummy.

As Doom's attacks deal damage on impact, players can simply flick the incoming standard attacks. Avoid using offensive prayers outside of the car phase unless you are flicking. If having trouble flicking, a combination of Devout Boots, Ring of the gods (i), and Dragonbone necklace combined with the typical Elite Void will give a prayer bonus of +31, which halves prayer drain at the cost of some DPS.

This achievement additionally includes prayer restoration caused by melee punishes if applicable; if the holy water that results from a melee punish restores prayer, the player will fail the achievement. This will not occur if the player's prayer is at or above their base level; e.g if the player's Prayer level is 88 but their boost puts them at 122, they would not fail the achievement as no prayer points were restored. Using the Ancient mace special attack to boost prayer above one's level during the encounter, however, will fail the achievement.

Otherwise, try to unequip the main weapon and attack Doom unarmed; unless Doom has very little health, a melee punish is unlikely to kill. To be extra safe, a melee splash weapon such as the cursed goblin hammer can be used, which is guaranteed to do zero damage.
Saradomin brews can still be used, though this requires regular restore potions or menaphite remedies. The latter is more consistent, although it only restores on 15 second intervals.

tasks.name: Duel of Mokhaiotl
tasks.description: Defeat the Doom of Mokhaiotl levels 1-8 whilst only damaging the boss with one-handed melee attacks.
context: Duel of Mokhaiotl is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires defeating the Doom of Mokhaiotl at delve levels 1 through 8, whilst only damaging the boss with one-handed melee attacks.

Damaging the boss with grubs outside of shield phase will fail the achievement, however grubs that hit during shield phase will not. Damage from the Scorching bow or demonbane spells during the shield phase will fail the achievement. Poison and burn damage are both allowed, as well as zombified thralls.
method: Doom is weakest to crush weapons and demonbane, so it is recommended to use an Inquisitor's mace and Inquisitor's armour or Emberlight with oathplate armour. The mace provides best damage outside of the shield and car phases, while Emberlight is best during those phases. The Doom will use a very accurate melee attack if the player is in melee distance, which is halved with Protect from Melee. However, the attack can still hit up to 20 through prayers, so flinching is required to avoid taking too much damage. Doom's attack speed changes based on the delve level, as follows: Larvae explosions will fail the achievement if they damage the boss outside of the shield phase. Therefore, they must be killed as soon as they appear, lest one gets too close to the boss. If the larvae gets too close to the boss, let them heal it. However, do not let too many of them heal the boss or the damage taken will be unrecoverable. It's recommended to bring an Eye of Ayak rather than demonbane spells, as it will still kill magic larvae in one hit but cannot damage Doom during the shield phase in case of a misclick. For ranged larvae, use blisterwood stakes.

After delve level 6+, the player will have guaranteed accuracy during the burrow phase. It is highly recommended that Doom only travels one quadrant (the arena can be divided into 3x3) to spend more time attacking the boss rather than running from rocks. During the slam attack, start with a pile closest to Doom and attack with one furthest away so less time is needed to return to the boss. Alternatively, the slams can be tanked, with each slam dealing around ~30-40 damage.

Zombified thralls can be used for the task, however they are not recommended as their attacks will cause more tiles to be sprayed with acid, which can make the achievement impossible if all tiles surrounding Doom are splattered in acid.
This achievement may be paired with Mine's Better, as players can use a shield with a strength bonus, such as the Toktz-ket-xil or dragonfire shield, to complete both achievements in one run.

Although unlikely, players who bring a two-handed weapon (such as a bow) to attack larvae should be careful and make sure that they have a mainhand melee weapon equipped before attacking Doom, as punching Doom will cause the achievement to fail despite using a "one-handed" melee attack.

tasks.name: Darkness Is Your Ally?
tasks.description: Defeat the Doom of Mokhaiotl levels 1-8 without equipping a demonbane weapon.
context: Darkness Is Your Ally? is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires defeating the Doom of Mokhaiotl at delve levels 1 through 8 without equipping a demonbane weapon.
method: This achievement is best tackled with a twisted bow. Players can opt for the bow of Faerdhinen otherwise, but note that deeper delves will be much more difficult with lower DPS.
Players are prohibited from using demonbane weapons such as Darklight, Arclight, Emberlight, scorching bow, holy water and purging staff for the duration of the achievement.

In order to handle demonic larvae, players are recommended to bring fast-hitting melee and ranged weapons (any 4-tick multi-hit weapons, such as sulphur blades and Tonalztics of Ralos or a 2-tick ranged weapons such as knives on rapid), as players will incur an attack delay when killing larvae without demonbane weapons or spells. For a magic weapon, players should bring a weapon that can autocast Arceuus spells (such as the skull sceptre, slayer's staff, or Ahrim's staff) with runes for Superior Demonbane. Note: A purging staff cannot be used as it will fail the task. When demonbane spells are used against larvae, players will experience no attack delay, making the attack speed of the weapon irrelevant.

Because of the task's restrictions, players must use a demonbane spell (instead of a scorching bow or demonbane sword) to reset Doom's charge progress during the shield phase on delves 3+. Players need to make sure to attack Doom with a demonbane spell at least once before Doom reaches the 75% threshold.
Powered staves, such as the Eye of Ayak, are not recommended due to the strength and necessity of demonbane spells throughout the fight.

tasks.name: Mine's Better
tasks.description: Defeat the Doom of Mokhaiotl levels 1-8 whilst always wearing a shield.
context: Mine's Better is a master combat achievement which requires defeating the Doom of Mokhaiotl at delve levels 1 through 8 with a shield always equipped.
method: Players have the option of using melee or ranged for this achievement. Defenders, God Books and the antler guard are not considered shields and will not count towards the task.

Because players will not be able to use most bows, and melee is already a poor method for the boss (unless additionally attempting the Duel of Mokhaiotl achievement), players are recommended to use ranged with a crossbow instead. With full best-in-slot ranged gear, dragon knives have the highest DPS but will likely prove difficult to use due to their fast attack speed and short attack range.
Diamond bolts are helpful against the Doom's higher ranged defence despite its lower Defence level, while ruby bolts can deal a lot of damage in earlier parts of the fight.

During shield phases, make sure to bring both Darklight and a staff that can autocast demonbane spells, such as a slayer's staff. For melee punishes, bring a one-handed weapon with high strength bonus. Melee punish damage is equal to the player's strength bonus divided by 5. Osmumten's fang and the zombie axe are good candidates, with a +103/107 strength bonus respectively, meaning a minimum of 20/21 damage per melee punish. A dragon warhammer is also worth considering despite its lesser strength bonus of +85, as the special attack can be used on melee punishes for extra damage and guaranteed defence reduction.

tasks.name: Doom Crawler
tasks.description: Defeat the Doom of Mokhaiotl level 1 in less than 30 seconds.
context: Doom Crawler is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to defeat the Doom of Mokhaiotl at delve level 1 in less than 30 seconds.
Unlike many other speedrun Combat Achievements, a kill of exactly 30 seconds will not complete the task.

tasks.name: Doom Chaser
tasks.description: Defeat the Doom of Mokhaiotl levels 1-8 in less than 10:00.
context: Doom Chaser is a master combat achievement which requires the player to defeat the Doom of Mokhaiotl at delve levels 1 through 8 in less than 10 minutes.
method: For strategies on this achievement, see Doom Racer.

tasks.name: Doom Racer
tasks.description: Defeat the Doom of Mokhaiotl levels 1-8 in less than 7:15.
context: Doom Racer is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to defeat the Doom of Mokhaiotl at delve levels 1 through 8 in less than 7 minutes and 15 seconds.
method: The player must deal a total of 4,850 damage to the Doom, which can be rather daunting and is nearly impossible to complete under normal circumstances.

Fortunately, there are some strategies that can be used to save time, though this comes at the cost of less supplies to recover from mistakes: Pre-potting a super strength potion and trying to pray Piety for melee punishes Minimising tick loss during melee punishes by immediately attempting to melee the Doom whenever it does its rock throwing animation, as the melee punish is always accompanied by a rock throw 3-ticking attacks by attacking the Doom, then immediately attacking larvae with a 2-tick weapon (e.g. toxic blowpipe) to reset the attack cooldown This will still work even if the larvae is praying range Intentionally letting the Doom charge to full during shield phase and tanking the beam at delve levels 3-5 (dealing 60 damage at delve level 3 and 80 damage at levels 4 and 5) While possible to do so at delve level 6 and above, this requires the player to overheal beyond 99 Hitpoints; if choosing to tank these beams, phoenix necklaces should be used, some pieces of high-healing food (e.g. cooked moonlight antelope) may also be brought to eat if uncomfortable with being at low health after the beam Note that this beam attack does not proc Vengeance Waiting at the end of every wave to use Death Charge, as the achievement's timer is paused between waves

tasks.name: Mopping up
tasks.description: Clear at least 8 acid splats in a single Volatile Earth special attack.
context: Mopping Up is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires clearing eight or more acid blood with one earthen shield during the fight against the Doom of Mokhaiotl.
The achievement is completed as soon as the earthen shield clears any eight tiles with acid blood in them, rather than being completed upon defeating the Doom once the criteria is satisfied.
method: Acid blood begins to appear after delve level 3. However, it is only possible to get the achievement starting from delve 4.

Whenever Doom takes damage from any attack, it will splatter two or three tiles with its blood in one random cardinal direction for that delve level. To cause a lot of splatter, players can opt to use weak or multihit weapons and thralls to increase the amount of blood that Doom will splatter. Doom will not move at delve 3 and 4, so it is more common to attempt the achievement at delve 5, where Doom can be repositioned during the burrow phase. This additionally depends on the direction that blood was splattered during the previous two delves; if they were splattered across from each other (north/south or west/east), the achievement becomes a lot easier to obtain as players simply need to ensure that Doom is placed accordingly after the burrow phase ends.

After finishing the burrow phase, Doom will immediately prepare for the shockwave attack, spawning volatile earth around it. It is best to keep Doom towards the centre of the arena as best as possible so the earth is more likely to spawn in a desirable spot. Select two earth to destroy, making sure that the centre tile of earthen shield will overlap with the acid blood, as it will only clear acid from that tile. Doom will perform 3 slams at delve 5, so it is important to set the shield off early so it clears enough blood in time. Each shockwave will deal around ~35 or so damage if not protected.
Players who do very deep delves do not need to be as concerned for the achievement, as they will get it passively while creating safe tiles for subsequent delves.

tasks.name: Shellbane Adept
tasks.description: Kill the Shellbane Gryphon 25 times.
context: Shellbane Adept is an easy combat achievement which requires the player to kill the shellbane gryphon 25 times.

tasks.name: Shellbane Veteran
tasks.description: Kill the Shellbane Gryphon 50 times.
context: Shellbane Veteran is a medium combat achievement which requires the player to kill the shellbane gryphon 50 times.

tasks.name: Perfect Shellbane
tasks.description: Kill the Shellbane Gryphon without taking damage.
context: Perfect Shellbane is a medium combat achievement which requires the player to kill the shellbane gryphon without taking damage.
method: All of the boss' attacks are avoidable when weighing ≥40kg, with the exception of its ranged attack, which it may use at random even when at melee distance.
Given that the player should be wearing melee armour and weighing ≥40kg to fight the boss anyway, the moderate accuracy of this attack should not pose too many problems for this achievement.

tasks.name: Shellbane Speedrunner
tasks.description: Kill the Shellbane Gryphon 10 times within 12:30 minutes of entering the cave.
context: Shellbane Speedrunner is a medium combat achievement which requires the player to kill the shellbane gryphon 10 times within 12 minutes and 30 seconds of entering its cave.
method: This achievement includes the boss' respawn time of 20 ticks (12s), meaning that the player must defeat the boss in an average time of under 1:04 over ten kills.

tasks.name: Shellbane Survivor
tasks.description: Kill the Shellbane Gryphon 25 times without leaving the cave.
context: Shellbane Survivor is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to kill the shellbane gryphon 25 times without leaving the cave.
method: All of the boss' attacks are avoidable when weighing ≥40kg. This excludes its ranged attack, which it may use even when in melee distance. Consider bringing more food instead of prayer potions. Alternatively, consider bringing runes or tablets to cast bones to peaches. This achievement must be done in one sitting since logging out places the player outside the cave.

tasks.name: Dry Cleaning
tasks.description: Kill the Shellbane Gryphon after clearing its corrosive spit from your armour.
context: Dry Cleaning is an easy combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Shellbane gryphon after having cleared its corrosive spit.
method: The boss is more likely to use this attack if the player's equipped weight is ≥40kg.

When the boss uses its corrosive spit attack, take the hit and unequip ALL items or it won't work. Once the game message appears, re-equip all items and finish the kill. If your game chat is set to "Filtered", this message will not appear.

Note: It is recommended to unequip the Tortugan shield last, as the Shellbane gryphon is capable of dealing high damage without one equipped (roughly 30 on top of corrosion damage). It is also recommended to re-equip everything as quick as possible starting with the Tortugan shield to avoid taking extra heavy damage, especially from a knockback attack.

tasks.name: Featherweight Fighter
tasks.description: Kill the Shellbane Gryphon 5 times without leaving the cave, while wearing gear weighing less than 40kg.
context: Featherweight Fighter is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to kill the shellbane gryphon 5 times without leaving the cave, while wearing gear weighing less than 40kg.
method: Because your equipped weight must be less than 40kg, the knockback attack cannot be protected against, even when wearing a tortugan shield. As such, rather than focusing on heavy gear, bring gear with melee bonuses to focus on killing the boss quickly, to minimize the time it has to use its knockback attack. To take less damage, bring a stamina potion and kite the boss around the room.

tasks.name: Brutus Novice
tasks.description: Kill Brutus.
context: Brutus Novice is an easy combat achievement which requires the player to kill Brutus once after the completion of The Ides of Milk.

tasks.name: Brutus Champion
tasks.description: Kill Brutus 10 times.
context: Brutus Champion is an medium combat achievement which requires the player to kill Brutus 10 times. The kill during The Ides of Milk does not count towards this combat achievement.

tasks.name: Brutus Speed-Trialist
tasks.description: Kill Brutus in less than 2 seconds.
context: Brutus Speed-Trialist is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill Brutus in less than 2 seconds.
method: The achievement requires players to kill Brutus immediately as soon as he spawns. Attacks that have a delay, such as ranged, magic or some special attacks like the dragon dagger will be unable to kill Brutus, even if they can kill him in one hit.

Brutus must be killed once upon entry of the instance before attempting this achievement, so that it can be killed immediately on spawn. Ideally use a dragon halberd special attack, crystal halberd special attack, or Dharok's equipment at low hitpoints. Alternatives include the scythe of Vitur, noxious halberd, soulreaper axe, any godsword, elder maul, Arkan blade, or even a dragon warhammer special attack.
Despite being a free-to-play achievement, it is impossible to achieve on free-to-play worlds in the regular game mode due to the lack of gear to one-hit Brutus.

tasks.name: Beef vs Beef
tasks.description: Kill Brutus whilst neither equipping nor consuming anything.
context: Beef vs Beef is an medium combat achievement which requires the player to kill Brutus whilst wearing no gear or consuming any food or potions.
method: Potions consumed before Brutus spawns do not fail the combat achievement, so you can drink combat potions (such as a super strength or super combat potion) to boost your stats between attempts. Prayers also do not fail the achievement. With Protect from Melee and stepping out of the way of Brutus' special attacks, all damage can be avoided. Offensive prayers such as Piety or Ultimate Strength can also be used to boost damage and accuracy.
This task can also be completed using magic by manually casting spells, as using runes does not fail the achievement.

tasks.name: Smarter than a Cow
tasks.description: Kill Brutus without being attacked.
context: Smarter than a Cow is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to kill Brutus without being attacked.
method: You will not be able to complete this Combat Achievement if Brutus has successfully attacked you once, even if he does not deal any damage.

As Brutus cannot be flinched, he must be safespotted with Ranged, Magic, or a halberd for the kill. The plant near his spawn will work as a safespot, as well as the warning sign near the gate, troughs around the sides of the pen, a rock in the southern part of the cow field, etc.

Be aware that after several seconds out of melee range, Brutus will either use his charge attack or pathfind around obstacles to reach you. Being hit with the charge attack will fail the achievement. To avoid this, be ready to move out of the way and re-safespot Brutus when his overhead text appears. indicates he is going to use his charge attack, while indicates he will pathfind to you.

It is possible to get the achievement without safespotting by kiting Brutus--that is, hitting him from a distance and running away such that he never is able to perform a melee attack. However, this is much more difficult to execute properly than the safespot method.
This achievement can be completed simultaneously with Brutus Speed-Trialist, as killing Brutus in under 2 seconds won't give him time to retaliate.

tasks.name: Maggot Squasher
tasks.description: Kill the Maggot King.
context: Maggot Squasher is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Maggot King.

tasks.name: Maggot Exterminator
tasks.description: Kill the Maggot King 25 times.
context: Maggot Exterminator is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Maggot King 25 times.

tasks.name: Camping the King
tasks.description: Kill the Maggot King 12 times without leaving the arena.
context: Camping the King is a master combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Maggot King 12 times without leaving the arena.
method: A magic/melee hybrid setup is highly recommended for this achievement, as magic kills are faster than ranged kills on average while incurring significantly less damage. Players can prepot before entering an instance with super combat, overheal with anglerfish and drinking a dose of antipoison. Extended anti-venom+ will allow for up to 17.7 minutes of poison immunity, assuming that no poisonous bile is stepped on. 2-3 Sanfew serums should suffice for subsequent poison protection. As these also restore prayer similarly to that of super restores, try to avoid wasting these and only drink them when the potion can restore as much prayer as possible.

When playing as perfect as possible, the player will mostly be limited by prayer restoration. It is recommended to bring an amulet of blood fury to heal from any mistakes or chip damage incurred from carrion piles. The first kill should have 1-2 pieces of food on hand for emergencies.

With the supplies shown below, the player should have more than enough potions to last 12 kills, with an average of ~2:30-2:45 per kill. The boss frequently has a supply drop of 1 Dull ancient medal and 2-4 Stymphike tartares. The dull medal will restore prayer to full over a short period of time and usually equates to one additional kill, while the food is welcome in the event of additional mistakes in subsequent kills.

tasks.name: Maggot King Speed Chaser
tasks.description: Complete the first 5 kills of the Maggot King within 9 minutes after entering the arena.
context: Maggot King Speed Chaser is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Maggot King 5 times in under 9 minutes, which requires the player to defeat the boss in an average time of under 1:48 over the player's first 5 kills in the same instance.
method: The achievement must be completed without leaving, and be the first five kills of the instance. It is highly recommended to take a magic and melee setup for the boss, as ranged setups are highly reliant on ruby bolt procs, whereas using fire spells weakens the boss' magic defence and inflicts a burn on it.

In particular, performing melee punishes with Dharok the Wretched's equipment during the boss' melee slams provides the highest damage output when at low health. If the players first two kills are over 1:48 even with Dharok's, consider resetting; ideally, players should aim for 1:30-1:40 kill times as to allow some wiggle room for bad kill times in later kills.

The time tracked for the achievement only takes into account the time spent in combat with the boss; as such, players can hold off on interacting with the Maggot King Corpse until their special attack energy is sufficiently restored, and the cooldown for drinking surge potions to expire, before starting the next kill.
Completing this achievement on-task is an option, so a slayer helmet (i) can be used in place of magic/ranged headgear if players are assigned a Maggot King boss task.

tasks.name: Trying to fit in
tasks.description: Kill the Maggot King using only weapons that can be found in Vampyrium.
context: Trying to fit in is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Maggot King using only weapons that can be found in Vampyrium.
method: It is highly recommended to use magic for this achievement, as the Maggot King is more susceptible to fire spells. Magic spells are acceptable despite not having a mainhand to autocast, as fire spells deal more damage on average compared to ranged. Alternatively, if the player chooses to use range, they can bring thralls as an additional source of damage as this will not fail the achievement. As the player's only ranged option are blisterwood stakes, which are light weapons, they are very unlikely to hit the boss as it has high resistance to light and standard ranged attacks. It is still recommended to bring stakes to deal with Ur-maggot larvae, as they are more resistant to magic than ranged.

Note that off-hand items such as the dragon defender and Tome of Fire can be used without failing the achievement. If using a 6-tick melee punish, the dragon battleaxe set to crush provides a decent option.

Less skilled players are recommended to avoid attempting this achievement until they obtain a crimson kisten as it has the highest damage out of all the possible weapons to use during melee punish, most of which are stronger in stab or slash, which the Maggot King is more resistant to.
The following table lists weapons which are allowed for the achievement:
Below are all noteable weapons that cannot be used, despite being obtainable on Vampyrium:

Dragon spear, from the rare drop table from venators Mist battlestaff, from blood-starved venators Dust battlestaff, from blood-starved venators Dragon dart, dragon dart tips from venator teeth traded to the aranei, along with stymphike feathers.

tasks.name: King-sized clobbering
tasks.description: Kill the Maggot King without missing a single melee punish.
context: King-sized clobbering is a master combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Maggot King without missing a single melee punish.

tasks.name: Digging in
tasks.description: Kill the Maggot King without moving more than 40 tiles.
context: Digging in is a master combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Maggot King without moving more than 40 tiles.
method: This achievement is best paired with Cordoned Off, as the strategies to complete them overlap.

As the player's movements for this achievement becomes more restricted, wearing a serpentine helm alongside an inoculation bracelet will help in dealing with the poisonous and sticky biles by minimising necessary movement and avoiding damage. Without a serpentine helmet, players should bring greater amounts of antipoison to offset the immunity drain.

During the boss' melee slams, the player may wish to only utilise melee punishes to attack the boss to avoid excessive movement. If using melee punishes to complete this achievement, consider taking the opportunity to complete King-sized clobbering alongside this achievement.

If attempting Cordoned Off simultaneously, the player must solely use melee punishes to attack the boss during its melee slams, as only melee punishes can be used from the back row of the playable area.

It is highly recommended to bring a standard ranged weapon in order to snipe the Ur-maggot larvae as usual maggot skipping techniques result in being forced to move, however this becomes less of an issue after the boss enters its final (melee) phase as it forces the player to constantly move regardless.

tasks.name: Cordoned Off
tasks.description: Kill the Maggot King without moving beyond the back row of tiles.
context: Cordoned Off is a master combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Maggot King without moving beyond the back row of tiles in the playable area.
method: This achievement is best paired with Digging in, as the strategies to complete them overlap.

As the playable area for this achievement becomes more restricted, wearing a serpentine helm alongside an inoculation bracelet will help in dealing with the poisonous and sticky biles by minimising necessary movement. Without a serpentine helmet, players should bring greater amounts of antipoison to offset the immunity drain.

During the boss' melee slams, the player is able to perform a melee punish from the back row, but must only utilise melee punishes to attack the boss, as regular attacks will force you to move forward, failing the achievement. Alternatively, players can use heavy ranged attacks during this period, due to its magic defence bonus increasing from +150 to +400 when it closes in to melee.
If using melee punishes to complete this achievement, consider taking the opportunity to complete King-sized clobbering alongside this achievement.

tasks.name: Perfect Maggot King
tasks.description: Kill the Maggot King without taking any avoidable damage or him ever being healed.
context: Perfect Maggot King is a master combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Maggot King without taking any avoidable damage or him ever being healed. A charged serpentine helm can be used to avoid damage from grounded poison, but the player must still avoid all projectiles as they fall to the ground or the task will fail, even if no damage is registered. The Inoculation Bracelet prevents damage, but stepping in Yellow Bile will still result in failing the Achievement.
method: While normal play should be enough to dodge most attacks, players must be mindful of some extra aspects of the fight to achieve a perfect kill: Aim to shoot the ur-maggot larvae as soon as possible. If attacking too late, the maggot can land and heal the boss before getting hit by the player's ranged projectile, failing the achievement. Shooting the larvae at the first opportunity can give players a little more time to find tiles that are safe from carrion projectiles. Alternatively, players can find safe tiles to stand on first before shooting larvae. When preparing to perform melee punishes, be mindful of poisonous and sticky biles that may occupy tiles the player intends to use. Move east or west to a set of safe tiles before starting melee punishes.

tasks.name: Mad Angel Adept
tasks.description: Kill the Mad Angel 25 times.
context: Mad Angel Adept is a medium combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Mad Angel 25 times.

tasks.name: Mad Angel Veteran
tasks.description: Kill the Mad Angel 50 times.
context: Mad Angel Veteran is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Mad Angel 50 times.

tasks.name: Perfect Mad Angel
tasks.description: Kill the Mad Angel without taking any avoidable damage.
context: Perfect Mad Angel is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Mad Angel without taking any avoidable damage.

tasks.name: This Is Madness
tasks.description: Kill the Mad Angel 15 times without leaving her arena.
context: This Is Madness is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Mad Angel 15 times without leaving her arena.
method: Successfully performing the Mad Angel's mechanics for nearly all kills will be required for most players, to minimise damage taken. It is recommended to bring Saradomin brews to maximise available healing, and 8-12 super restores. There is approximately a 10% chance of receiving a supply drop. Otherwise, killing the Mad Angel normally should be sufficient.
Players who are struggling, could consider bringing blood spells which can be used during punish phases for guaranteed healing, although this shouldn't typically be necessary.
Alternatively, consider using the amulet of blood fury to recover from any chip damage taken.

tasks.name: Mad Angel Speed-Runner
tasks.description: Kill the Mad Angel 5 times within 10 minutes of entering her arena.
context: Mad Angel Speed-Runner is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Mad Angel 5 times within 10 minutes of first entering her arena.

tasks.name: Dancing Queen
tasks.description: Kill the Mad Angel after getting 6 consecutive enhanced attacks by dodging the sweep attack successfully during her enrage phase.
context: Dancing Queen is a medium combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Mad Angel after getting 6 consecutive enhanced attacks by dodging the sweep attacks successfully during her enrage phase.
method: This does not need to be done immediately prior to the Mad Angel dying; it just needs to be done at any point in the fight after she becomes enraged.
The enhanced attack is only activated by standing on the side opposite the swing. Running through or behind the boss will dodge the attack but will not grant the bonus damage and accuracy.
As the sweep attack is 4 tick during the enrage phase, a 4-tick or faster weapon should be used for this achievement.
This task can be completed in conjunction with The Pen Is Mightier, as the unarmed styles are all 4 tick.

tasks.name: Smite Fight
tasks.description: Kill the Mad Angel after getting 3 consecutive enhanced attacks by successfully praying against the smite attacks during her enrage phase.
context: Smite Fight is a medium combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Mad Angel after getting 3 consecutive enhanced attacks by successfully praying against the smite attacks during her enrage phase.
method: This achievement requires attacking between her smite triple attacks. This does not need to be done immediately prior to the Mad Angel dying; it just needs to be done at any point in the fight after she becomes enraged.

Due to the timing of the smite attack during the enrage phase, this combat achievement is most easily completed by disabling offensive prayers (to avoid killing early) and equipping a 3 tick weapon such as a Ham joint or Goblin paint cannon.

It can be completed with a 4 or 5 tick weapon with more precise timing. Attacking right after the first lightning bolt will allow your follow-up attack to land in-between the 2nd and 3rd strike, allowing you to receive 3 instances of bonus damage.

tasks.name: Juggling Act
tasks.description: Kill the Mad Angel after attacking her between each bounce of the blast attack during her enrage phase. This does not need to be done immediately prior to the Mad Angel dying; it just needs to be done at any point in the fight after she becomes enraged.
context: Juggling Act is a medium combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Mad Angel after attacking her between each bounce of the blast attack during her enrage phase.

tasks.name: The Pen Is Mightier
tasks.description: Kill the Mad Angel without equipping any weapon.
context: The Pen Is Mightier is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Mad Angel without equipping any weapon.
method: Thralls, off-hand equipment, and recoil effects are allowed to be used within the fight, and are recommended. This combat achievement may be paired well with Dancing Queen, as the enrage portion of the fight is likely to take longer, and successfully dodging her attacks for a damage boost will make a significant difference to the length of the fight.
This task can also easily be completed by manually casting combat spells against her, especially when utilising her 15% earth spell weakness.
